165.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Selena Matissao]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"journal","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_selena.png","religion":"[[El Santo]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[Steeltown]]","territory":"[[Steeltown]]","district":"[[Steeltown#Gage Park|Gage Park]]","faction":"[[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]","role":"Woman of Mayhem for the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]","chapters":["01 - Main Event Shadows","06 - Showdown In Gage Park"],"tags":["character","protagonist","steeltown","wrecking_crew","el-santo","chapter06"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 10:43:20"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: journal NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_selena.png religion: "[[El Santo]]" status: Alive location: "[[Steeltown]]" territory: "[[Steeltown]]" district: "[[Steeltown#Gage Park|Gage Park]]" faction: "[[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]" role: "Woman of Mayhem for the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]" chapters: - 01 - Main Event Shadows - 06 - Showdown In Gage Park tags: - character - protagonist - steeltown - wrecking_crew - el-santo - chapter06 --- # SELENA MATISSAO > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[selena.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Woman of Mayhem **Alias/Nickname:** The Phoenix **Home Location:** [[Steeltown]] **Public Reputation:** Feared, admired, elusive **Gender:** Female **Spouse:** Widowed **Age:** 26 **Height:** 5'8" **Weight:** 137 lbs. **Date of Birth:** **Occupation:** Scout, Tracker, Raider **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]] **Known Associates:** [[Jimmy Douglass]], [[Mark Jeffrey]], [[Rodney Blythe]] **Faith:** [[El Santo]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“They call me The Phoenix like I’m gonna rise from the shadow in the night. But I don’t hide. I walk in the open, so they remember exactly who’s chasing them.”

**Selena Matissao** is not a ghost. She’s the firestorm that comes after the ghosts have fled. Once a wife, now a warrior, she carries her pain like a blade — sharp, precise, and always ready to strike. She lost her husband, Michael, to one of the Duke’s purges. His death was meant as a warning. Instead, it ignited a legend. Selena rose from the ashes of her old life and carved a new path — one soaked in vengeance and marked by justice. She joined the Wrecking Crew not as a victim, but as a predator. They call her _The Phoenix_ because she never stops rising. No matter how much blood she spills, no matter how broken the land becomes, Selena burns forward — fierce, focused, and impossible to stop. She moves through the wilderness like wind through reeds. Her tracking skills are unmatched. Her ability to survive off the grid makes her the Crew’s most valuable scout and assassin. Where others lose the trail, Selena finds it. Though she rarely speaks of it, her bond with [[Mark Jeffrey]] runs deep. There's heat beneath their banter — a tenderness they both fear, yet quietly crave. He grounds her. She sharpens him. Neither knows what comes next, but both understand they won’t face it alone. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Calm, lethal, and calculated — Selena rarely wastes words, and when she acts, it’s with unflinching precision. **Vices:** Obsession with revenge — she pushes herself to the brink chasing ghosts she’s not sure she can ever exorcise. **Abilities:** Master tracker, survivalist, silent killer — she disappears into the wastelands and reemerges with intel, plans… or blood. **Secrets:** Buried beneath a root-tangled tree outside Steeltown is a box holding her wedding ring. She still checks it monthly — not to retrieve it, just to know it’s there. **Beliefs:** Hope must be fought for. Grief must be forged into something sharp. And the land will only heal when its tormentors are gone. --- ## Role In Disgraceland **Selena Matissao** is the silent flame of the Wrecking Crew — a myth made real, a blade made from grief. She doesn’t chase glory. She chases reckoning. > [!rustwater]- Surprise > ![[selenaass.png|600]]

166.title: Rodney Blythe

metadata.role: Road Captain of the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]

166.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Rodney Blythe]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"journal","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_rb.png","religion":"[[El Santo]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[Steeltown]]","territory":"[[Steeltown]]","district":"[[Steeltown#Gage Park|Gage Park]]","faction":"[[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]","role":"Road Captain of the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]","chapters":["06 - Showdown In Gage Park"],"tags":["character","protagonist","steeltown","wrecking_crew","el-santo","chapter06"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 10:43:15"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: journal NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_rb.png religion: "[[El Santo]]" status: Alive location: "[[Steeltown]]" territory: "[[Steeltown]]" district: "[[Steeltown#Gage Park|Gage Park]]" faction: "[[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]" role: "Road Captain of the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]" chapters: - 06 - Showdown In Gage Park tags: - character - protagonist - steeltown - wrecking_crew - el-santo - chapter06 --- # RODNEY BLYTHE > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[rb.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Road Captain of the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]] **Alias/Nickname:** Big Main **Home Location:** [[Steeltown]] **Public Reputation:** Silent, deadly, dependable **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** 35 **Height:** 6'4" **Weight:** 250 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 4th of Greensun, 2151 **Occupation:** Road Captain **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]] **Known Associates:** [[Abel May Jr.]], [[Mark Jeffrey]], [[Selena Matissao]] **Faith:** [[El Santo]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“I don’t need to shout. The pavement hears me just fine.”

**Rodney Blythe** doesn’t talk much. He doesn’t need to. His silence speaks volumes, and his fists do the rest. Built like a slab of steel and just as unyielding, Rodney is the wall you want between your people and the storm. Once a prisoner in the Duke’s forced labor camps, Rodney spent years beneath rubble and ash, hauling wreckage from bombed-out ruins. When a collapse left him buried alive, he clawed his way out. That moment — his rebirth — made him harder than any iron he ever lifted. The Crew found him broken but breathing. [[Abel May Jr.]] saw a survivor, not a stranger, and vouched for him. Since then, Rodney has never wavered. His word is rare, but his loyalty is absolute. As Road Captain, he’s the one who gets them home. He leads convoys through danger, enforces discipline, and settles disputes with his bare hands. If Jimmy is the spirit, and Mark is the voice, Rodney is the spine. Without him, the Crew would buckle under its own weight. He’s not without ghosts — and he never speaks of the past. But in quiet moments, a bent dog tag hidden in his vest says everything he won’t. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Steady, focused, and silent — Rodney listens first, acts second, and regrets nothing. **Vices:** Carries his guilt like weight on his back — never complains, never lets it go. **Abilities:** Route strategist, convoy lead, close-combat specialist — Rodney plans like a general and hits like a truck. **Secrets:** A dog tag hidden in his vest once belonged to someone who didn’t make it out. He checks it before every ride. **Beliefs:** Strength is protection, not power. Loyalty is a language. And the road is sacred — you never abandon the ride, or the riders. ## Role In Disgraceland **Rodney Blythe** is the Wrecking Crew’s steel spine — the Road Captain who guides the charge, clears the path, and brings the warriors home.

167.title: Mark Jeffrey
167.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Mark Jeffrey]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"journal","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_mark.png","religion":"[[El Santo]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[Steeltown]]","territory":"[[Steeltown]]","district":"[[Steeltown#Gage Park|Gage Park]]","faction":"[[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]","role":"Vice-President of the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]","chapters":["01 - Main Event Shadows","03 - The Devil In The Row","06 - Showdown In Gage Park"],"tags":["character","protagonist","main","steeltown","wrecking_crew","el-santo","chapter06"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 10:41:33"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: journal NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_mark.png religion: "[[El Santo]]" status: Alive location: "[[Steeltown]]" territory: "[[Steeltown]]" district: "[[Steeltown#Gage Park|Gage Park]]" faction: "[[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]" role: "Vice-President of the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]" chapters: - 01 - Main Event Shadows - 03 - The Devil In The Row - 06 - Showdown In Gage Park tags: - character - protagonist - main - steeltown - wrecking_crew - el-santo - chapter06 --- # MARK JEFFREY > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[mark.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Vice President of the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]] **Alias/Nickname:** East Mountain Mauler **Home Location:** [[Steeltown]] **Public Reputation:** Strategic, charming, grounded , funny **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** 30 **Height:** 6'1" **Weight:** 210 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 18th of Hollowtide, 2156 **Occupation:** Vice President of a motorcycle gang **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]] **Known Associates:** [[Jimmy Douglass]], [[Katie Kowalski]], [[Joe Ameen]] **Faith:** [[El Santo]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“You better pray to El Santo.”

If [[Jimmy Douglass]] is the soul of the Wrecking Crew, **Mark Jeffrey** is its brain — the tactician with a cigarette in his teeth and a smirk that means trouble. While Jimmy charges through the fire, Mark calculates the exits. Together, they’re unstoppable. Raised in the industrial grind of Steeltown, Mark grew up watching his brother fight to protect their people. But while Jimmy inherited their father’s brawler spirit, Mark leaned into the long game. He studies people, studies maps, and makes sure the Crew doesn’t rush into a fight it can’t finish. But don’t mistake planning for cowardice — Mark’s fists speak fluent rebellion, and his knuckles know the Duke’s loyalists by name. He’s got a crooked smile, a scar near his collarbone, and a laugh that defuses tension faster than any weapon. His tactical brilliance keeps the Crew on course — but it’s his sense of humor and loyalty that keep them from falling apart. Mark may never seek the spotlight, but without him, the whole movement would collapse under its own fire. He’s the anchor behind Jimmy’s spark — and the one who’ll keep Disgraceland standing once the smoke clears. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Clever, calm, and always in control — Mark’s the Crew’s most stable hand, equally quick with a plan or a joke. **Vices:** Chain-smoker, deep thinker. Covers his fears with sarcasm and secondhand smoke. **Abilities:** Master strategist, intuitive mediator, and gifted with people — he diffuses fights, predicts enemy moves, and plans logistics like a general. **Secrets:** A hidden notebook under his mattress contains his blueprint for rebuilding Disgraceland after the Duke. No one’s seen it. Not even Jimmy. **Beliefs:** Revolutions are only worth fighting if you’ve got something better to build when the dust settles. Mark’s here to win the future, not just the war. --- ## Role In Disgraceland **Mark Jeffrey** is the Wrecking Crew’s mind — Vice President, peacemaker, tactician. He keeps Jimmy alive, the Crew together, and the resistance one step ahead.

168.title: Lincoln Jones

metadata.role: Road Scout of the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]

168.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Lincoln Jones]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"journal","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_linc.png","religion":"[[El Santo]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[Territories/Steeltown]]","territory":"[[Steeltown]]","district":"[[Steeltown#Gage Park|Gage Park]]","faction":"[[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]","role":"Road Scout of the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]","chapters":["06 - Showdown In Gage Park"],"tags":["character","protagonist","steeltown","wrecking_crew","el-santo","chapter06"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 10:43:08"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: journal NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_linc.png religion: "[[El Santo]]" status: Alive location: "[[Territories/Steeltown]]" territory: "[[Steeltown]]" district: "[[Steeltown#Gage Park|Gage Park]]" faction: "[[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]" role: "Road Scout of the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]" chapters: - 06 - Showdown In Gage Park tags: - character - protagonist - steeltown - wrecking_crew - el-santo - chapter06 --- # LINCOLN JONES > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[lincoln.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Road Scout of the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]] **Alias/Nickname:** The Road Dog , Linc **Home Location:** [[Steeltown]] **Public Reputation:** Chill, loyal, music-loving **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** 34 **Height:** 6'0" **Weight:** 185 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 8th of Ambertide, 2151 **Occupation:** Scout, Scavenger **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]] **Known Associates:** [[Katie Kowalski]], [[Joe Ameen]], [[Selena Matissao]] . [[Lash Hawkins]] **Faith:** [[El Santo]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“I don’t ride to escape, man. I ride to remember what we’re trying to get back to.”

**Lincoln Jones** lives in motion. The hum of his engine is the only rhythm that keeps the world from going silent — and he won’t stop riding until he hears music again. To most, he’s a mystery. A drifter with a grin, a box of busted cassettes, and a knack for vanishing into the wilds only to return with intel, supplies, or static-laced mixtapes from a world long gone. But to the Crew, he’s more than that — he’s their Road Dog. Their outrider. Their reminder that there’s still something worth riding for. Lincoln saved [[Katie Kowalski]] once, and she never forgot it. That moment was his quiet initiation. But it was [[Joe Ameen]] who taught him the finer art of bringing old tech back to life. Together, they dug through ruins and rewired speakers that hadn’t sung in decades. Lincoln’s dream? To build a sound system loud enough to shake the Duke’s towers. Just once. Just for the hell of it. When he rides, he scouts ahead. When he stops, he listens. And when he speaks, it’s with the steady calm of someone who’s seen too much and still believes in joy anyway. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Relaxed and open-hearted, but observant — Lincoln may seem carefree, but he doesn’t miss a thing. **Vices:** Sentimental to a fault — he’ll risk his life for a scratched-up CD if it reminds him of something real. **Abilities:** Elite scout, improvised mechanic, cook, and battlefield courier. Fast as hell, smart as hell, and always humming something you thought you forgot. **Secrets:** Carries a broken CD marked _“Mom’s Mix – Road Trip 2040.”_ It’s scratched to hell and doesn’t play. But he listens to the silence like it’s a prayer. **Beliefs:** The road is sacred. The past isn’t lost. And sometimes, the best way to rebel is to make the world feel something again — even if it’s just a beat. ## Role In Disgraceland **Lincoln Jones** is the Crew’s wind — their scout, their soul, their rolling reminder that freedom ain’t just an idea — it’s a ride. And he’ll ride until the wheels fall off or the music comes back. ## Appearances

169.title: Katie Kowalski
169.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Katie Kowalski]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"journal","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_katie.png","religion":"[[El Santo]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[Steeltown]]","territory":"[[Steeltown]]","district":"[[Steeltown#Gage Park|Gage Park]]","faction":"[[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]","role":"Doctor of the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]","chapters":["01 - Main Event Shadows","06 - Showdown In Gage Park"],"tags":["character","protagonist","steeltown","wrecking_crew","el-santo","chapter06"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 10:48:01"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: journal NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_katie.png religion: "[[El Santo]]" status: Alive location: "[[Steeltown]]" territory: "[[Steeltown]]" district: "[[Steeltown#Gage Park|Gage Park]]" faction: "[[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]" role: "Doctor of the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]" chapters: - 01 - Main Event Shadows - 06 - Showdown In Gage Park tags: - character - protagonist - steeltown - wrecking_crew - el-santo - chapter06 --- # KATIE KOWALSKI > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[katie.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Combat Medic of the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]] **Alias/Nickname:** Doc **Home Location:** [[Steeltown]] **Public Reputation:** Compassionate, fierce, irreplaceable **Gender:** Female **Spouse:** None **Age:** 30 **Height:** 5'7" **Weight:** 145 lbs. **Date of Birth:** **Occupation:** Field Medic **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]] **Known Associates:** [[Mark Jeffrey]], [[Joe Ameen]], [[Jimmy Douglass]] **Faith:** [[El Santo]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“I don’t wear this bandana for fashion. I wear it to remind people that someone still gives a damn whether they live.”

**Katie Kowalski** is the heartbeat of the Wrecking Crew — a healer in a world that chews up the kind and spits out the broken. But Katie isn’t soft. She’s iron-willed, fire-hearted, and sharper than any blade. Raised in the ruins of Steeltown to a nurse and a machinist, Katie taught herself medicine with scavenged books, stories, and stitched-together anatomy charts. Now she keeps the Crew alive with bandages, tinctures, and sheer determination. She met [[Mark Jeffrey]] and [[Joe Ameen]] in their wild youth — and never left their side. Her bond with Mark runs deep, full of unsaid truths and dangerous affection. Joe’s laughter helps her breathe through the darkness. She would die for both… but she prefers to keep them alive. Katie doesn’t carry a gun. She carries the will to save people who’ve been forgotten. Her bandana, gifted by Mark, is her armor — a symbol of mercy in a place where mercy is rare. And if you think that makes her weak, you’ve never watched her rebuild a body with nothing but grit, tape, and bloody hands. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Compassionate, focused, and calm under pressure. Katie doesn’t raise her voice — she just starts patching the wounds. > [!infobox] > > ![[katred2.png|260]] **Vices:** Self-sacrifice. She’ll bleed herself dry before she lets someone else fall. **Abilities:** Self-taught combat medic with expert trauma care and battlefield strategy. A field general in scrubs. **Secrets:** A worn letter from Joe Ameen lives hidden in her pack. She’s never told him she found it. But she keeps it. Always. **Beliefs:** Saving a life is an act of rebellion in Disgraceland. Katie fights for every pulse, because every breath is defiance. ## Role In Disgraceland **Katie Kowalski** is the Wrecking Crew’s lifeline. Their doctor, their conscience, their firebrand of hope. She doesn’t wear armor — she makes sure the rest of them survive to wear it. > [!rustwater]- Surprise > ![[katieass.png|600]]

170.title: Joe Ameen
170.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Joe Ameen]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"journal","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_neema.png","religion":"[[El Santo]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[Steeltown]]","territory":"[[Steeltown]]","district":"[[Steeltown#Gage Park|Gage Park]]","faction":"[[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]","role":"Mechanic of the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]","chapters":["01 - Main Event Shadows","03 - The Devil In The Row","06 - Showdown In Gage Park"],"tags":["character","protagonist","steeltown","wrecking_crew","el-santo"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 10:42:59"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: journal NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_neema.png religion: "[[El Santo]]" status: Alive location: "[[Steeltown]]" territory: "[[Steeltown]]" district: "[[Steeltown#Gage Park|Gage Park]]" faction: "[[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]" role: "Mechanic of the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]" chapters: - 01 - Main Event Shadows - 03 - The Devil In The Row - 06 - Showdown In Gage Park tags: - character - protagonist - steeltown - wrecking_crew - el-santo --- # JOE AMEEN > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[neema.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Head Mechanic of the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]] **Alias/Nickname:** The Mechanic **Home Location:** [[Steeltown]] **Public Reputation:** Loyal, sharp-tongued, grease-streaked genius **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** 30 **Height:** 5'10" **Weight:** 183 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 18th of Bloomsun, 2156 **Occupation:** Mechanic, Engineer **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]] **Known Associates:** [[Mark Jeffrey]], [[Katie Kowalski]], [[Jimmy Douglass]] **Faith:** None **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“You give me a busted carb, a wrench, and five minutes — I’ll get us home. Just don’t ask how.”

**Joe Ameen** keeps the Crew running — literally. In a world where fuel is rationed and freedom is throttled, Joe’s touch turns rust into revolution. He doesn’t fix machines — he revives them. Born in the industrial wreckage of Steeltown to immigrants who built the bones of the city, Joe was raised on busted parts and burning dreams. While the Duke hoards fuel and keeps power on a leash, Joe spits in the system’s face with every engine he resurrects. He grew up alongside [[Mark Jeffrey]] — wrenching, laughing, surviving. Mark brought the heat; Joe brought the spark. Together, they rewired rebellion. Joe became the Crew’s heart, keeping their bikes, trucks, and war rigs howling through the ruins. But Joe’s more than grease and sarcasm. He believes. In the people. In the movement. In building something that lasts. And while his hands stay busy under a hood, his mind’s always watching, always listening. When hope runs low, Joe’s laugh is the first thing you hear. When the wheels fall off, he’s already got the spare. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Easygoing, dependable, and sharp — Joe’s got the wit to lift spirits and the guts to stay behind when everything explodes. **Vices:** Flirting, fixing, and overworking himself. If it’s broken or beautiful, Joe’s probably halfway in love with it. **Abilities:** Mechanical savant — from bikes to battle rigs, if it runs, Joe can resurrect it. Also a pro at weaponizing junk. **Secrets:** Keeps a broken gold bracelet hidden beneath his tool chest — Katie’s. Found it after a raid. Never gave it back. **Beliefs:** Machines don’t lie. People shouldn’t either. He believes in loyalty, laughter, and legacy — and he builds all three with his bare hands. ## Role In Disgraceland **Joe Ameen** is the Crew’s soul under the hood. Their engine whisperer. Their fixer of futures. He doesn’t ride point — but without him, the ride doesn’t happen at all.

01 - Main Event Shadows - 06 - Showdown In Gage Park tags: - character - protagonist - main - steeltown - wrecking_crew - el-santo - chapter01 - chapter06 --- # JIMMY DOUGLASS > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[jimmy.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** President of the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]] **Alias/Nickname:** The Man **Home Location:** [[Steeltown]] **Public Reputation:** Loved, good, helpful, leader, strong **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** 38 **Height:** 6'3" **Weight:** 231 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 23rd of Rainsun, 2148 **Occupation:** President of a motorcycle gang **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]] **Known Associates:** [[Mark Jeffrey]], [[Rosa Murray]] [[Abel May Jr.]], [[Katie Kowalski]], [[Joe Ameen]] **Faith:** [[El Santo]] **Appearances:** > ```dataview > list > from "DISGRACELAND" > where contains(this.chapters, file.name) > sort file.name asc > ``` --- ## Biography >

“Whose streets? Our streets!”

Jimmy Douglass was born and raised in the rusted shadows of Steeltown, a once-thriving industrial hub before the Water wars and the subsequent [[Tetra Bomb]]. His father, [[Darrell Douglass]], was a stubborn steelworker who believed in loyalty, brotherhood, and doing what’s right — values Jimmy carries to this day. After Darrell’s death during the early chaos of Disgraceland’s formation, Jimmy and his younger brother, [[Mark Jeffrey]], vowed to honor his legacy. They founded the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]] as a sanctuary for those cast aside by the Duke’s ruthless regime. Tall and broad-shouldered, with silver-streaked hair and a weathered beard, Jimmy commands respect. His body tells the story of his battles — a patchwork of scars beneath tattoos that chronicle both his losses and victories. His "[[Hijos Del Darrell]]" shirt is more than a uniform; it’s a tribute to the man who taught him strength and resilience. Despite his gruff exterior and the ever-present cigarette between his fingers, Jimmy possesses a sharp mind. He is a strategist, always planning the next move. Some say he’s reckless, pushing the Crew closer to open rebellion with every confrontation. But others see him as a symbol of resistance — a man who refuses to bow. Jimmy loathes [[The Duke]] of Disgraceland and everything he stands for. He views the Duke’s rule as a parasite feeding on the suffering of the people. While some factions seek power for themselves, Jimmy has no interest in crowns or thrones. His fight is for freedom, not control. However, he knows war is not just fought with weapons. The Steeltown Wrecking Crew has become a beacon of hope, providing food, shelter, and protection to the oppressed. Jimmy has established underground schools for children and organized aid for families left destitute by the Duke’s brutal taxes. In doing so, he has become a hero to the people — a leader they willingly follow. Yet, beneath the strength and resolve lies a man burdened by loss. The choices he’s made weigh heavily on him. Every member of the Wrecking Crew lost someone, and Jimmy carries those ghosts. His younger brother, Mark Jeffrey, is his anchor. While their bond is unbreakable, Mark’s cautious nature often puts him at odds with Jimmy’s more aggressive tactics. But for Jimmy, there is no middle ground. The Duke’s reign must end, no matter the cost. He believes the people of Disgraceland are ready to rise — and when they do, the Steeltown Wrecking Crew will be leading the charge. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Fierce, driven, and uncompromising — Jimmy leads with his gut and doesn’t flinch when the cost of doing what’s right is blood. **Vices:** Stubborn pride and chain-smoking — he burns through both with equal intensity, refusing to slow down or back down even when the smarter play is patience. **Abilities:** Gifted battlefield commander and natural rallying point — his presence inspires unity, and his speeches have lit more fires than any torch or match. **Secrets:** In the bottom drawer of his desk sits a faded photo of his father and a sealed envelope labeled “For Mark.” He hasn’t opened it. Not in ten years. He’s afraid of what it says — or what it asks of him. **Beliefs:** Justice is non-negotiable. The Duke is a disease, and Disgraceland won’t heal until he’s ripped out root and stem. Jimmy believes in the people — and that they’re worth every scar. --- ## Role In Disgraceland **Jimmy Douglass** is the rebel soul of Disgraceland — founder and president of the Steeltown Wrecking Crew, a man who turned grief into purpose. His mission isn’t power. It’s liberation. And when the final reckoning comes, Jimmy won’t be watching from the sidelines — he’ll be leading the charge with a cigarette in his mouth and a war cry on his lips.

172.title: Abel May Jr.
172.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Abel May Jr.]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"journal","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_abel.png","religion":"[[El Santo]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[Steeltown]]","territory":"[[Steeltown]]","district":"[[Steeltown#Gage Park|Gage Park]]","faction":"[[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]","role":"Enforcer of the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]","chapters":["01 - Main Event Shadows","06 - Showdown In Gage Park"],"tags":["character","protagonist","steeltown","wrecking_crew","el-santo","chapter01","chapter06"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 10:42:43"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: journal NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_abel.png religion: "[[El Santo]]" status: Alive location: "[[Steeltown]]" territory: "[[Steeltown]]" district: "[[Steeltown#Gage Park|Gage Park]]" faction: "[[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]" role: "Enforcer of the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]" chapters: - 01 - Main Event Shadows - 06 - Showdown In Gage Park tags: - character - protagonist - steeltown - wrecking_crew - el-santo - chapter01 - chapter06 --- # ABEL MAY JR. > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[abel.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Enforcer of the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]] **Alias/Nickname:** Big Bad Abe **Home Location:** [[Steeltown]] **Public Reputation:** Fearsome, loyal, quietly haunted **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** 38 **Height:** 6'5" **Weight:** 280 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 21st of Whitetide, 2148 **Occupation:** Enforcer, Bodyguard **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]] **Known Associates:** [[Jimmy Douglass]], [[Mark Jeffrey]], [[Joe Ameen]] **Faith:** [[El Santo]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“I ain’t a hero. I’m just the guy who makes sure the hero gets to stand back up.”

**Abel May Jr.** is the wall you hit when you run out of bad ideas. Towering, scarred, and sharp-eyed, he’s the Crew’s sledgehammer — the one who doesn’t swing unless it counts, and when it counts, nothing gets back up. Years ago, Jimmy and Mark found him bleeding out in the mud after a failed Duke ambush. They saved him. He’s been saving them right back ever since. Now Abel walks the line between warrior and anchor. He speaks few words. Lets his fists say the rest. But around a fire, drink in hand, he’ll sing songs that could level hearts — about family, loss, and things broken long ago. His cousins, [[Brady & Brody]] Grody, are monsters in service to the Duke. Abel calls them “the pet freaks” — but every year, he writes them a letter. Unsent. Unopened. He doesn’t know if he wants to forgive them or put them down. He fights for the Crew like they’re blood. Because for him, they are. And if Jimmy’s the rebel’s flame, and Mark the brain, Abel’s the concrete — unshakable, unmovable, and still standing when everyone else falls. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Silent, strong, and deadly — Abel leads with presence, not volume. Calm until provoked. Then the earth shakes. **Vices:** Whiskey and sorrow songs — he drinks to forget, and sings to remember. **Abilities:** One-man wrecking crew. His fists hit like warhammers, and his presence alone clears rooms. **Secrets:** A locked ammo box under his bunk contains years of unsent letters to his cousins. Even monsters leave shadows behind. **Beliefs:** Family is chosen. And if you stand with the Crew, he’ll bury whoever tries to bring you down — even if they share his blood. --- ## Role In Disgraceland **Abel May Jr.** is the wrecking part of the Wrecking Crew — the Crew’s immovable defender, bruiser, and bruised soul. He may not speak often, but when he does, people shut up and listen. ---

173.title: Zadie Adeyemi
173.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Zadie Adeyemi]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"group","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_zadie.png","religion":"[[Church of the Ember Saint]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[Dead Waters]]","territory":"[[WATER#The Dead Waters|The Dead Waters]]","district":"[[Four Tombs Islands]]","faction":"[[Rustwater Raiders]]","role":"Quartermaster of [[the Black Marauder]]","chapters":["02 - Ghosts On The Waves","06 - Showdown In Gage Park"],"tags":["character","pirate","deadwaters","neutral","ember-saint","chapter06"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 13:57:10"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: group NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_zadie.png religion: "[[Church of the Ember Saint]]" status: Alive location: "[[Dead Waters]]" territory: "[[WATER#The Dead Waters|The Dead Waters]]" district: "[[Four Tombs Islands]]" faction: "[[Rustwater Raiders]]" role: "Quartermaster of [[the Black Marauder]]" chapters: - 02 - Ghosts On The Waves - 06 - Showdown In Gage Park tags: - character - pirate - deadwaters - neutral - ember-saint - chapter06 --- # ZADIE ADEYEMI > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[zadie.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Quartermaster of the Black Marauder **Alias/Nickname:** — **Home Location:** [[Dead Waters]] **Public Reputation:** Cold, brilliant, unshakable **Gender:** Female **Spouse:** None **Age:** 27 **Height:** 5'9" **Weight:** 142 lbs. **Date of Birth:** **Occupation:** Quartermaster, Strategist **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Rustwater Raiders]] **Known Associates:** [[Darius Adeyemi]], [[Lyla Bonetooth]], [[Clinton Firebay]], [[Silas Vayne]] **Faith:** [[Church of the Ember Saint]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“If you’re playing the game right, they’ll never see the knife till it’s buried in their ribs.”

Zadie Adeyemi doesn’t need to shout. When she speaks, the room listens — not out of fear, but because it knows she’s already done the math on how to burn it down. The Black Marauder runs on iron, blood, and fire… and Zadie keeps it all balanced. Born in the rust-riddled ruins of Disgraceland’s eastern edge, she survived on wit, weaponry, and weaponized charm. Now she’s Quartermaster of the Raiders — the one who tracks every bullet, blade, and bottle aboard the ship, and ensures every raid ends with profit, not excuses. She’s Lyla’s shadow strategist, a storm in a silk coat, and the one crewmembers fear disappointing more than the Captain herself. Zadie’s got eyes on every angle. When she negotiates, you don’t realize you’ve lost until she’s already two ports away. And behind that leather-bound journal she always carries? Blueprints. Names. Vengeance. Maybe even futures she’s yet to cash in. Her loyalty to Lyla Bonetooth is firm. For now. But make no mistake — Zadie is nobody’s pawn. If the tides shift, she’ll already be standing where the water breaks. The only person who gets past her armor is her brother, **Darius**. She doesn’t speak softly to him — she commands him the same as anyone else. But the bond between them is deep and ancient. She’s his calm. He’s her chaos. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Commanding, poised, and calculating. Zadie doesn’t raise her voice — she silences others with presence alone. **Vices:** Control. She craves leverage and influence the way others crave comfort. Secrets are her currency, and power is her drug of choice. **Abilities:** Master of logistics, tactics, and psychological warfare. Zadie can plot a raid, flip a mutiny, or collapse an enemy faction without raising her blade — though she’s deadly with it too. **Secrets:** Her journal is rumored to contain blackmail, backup plans, hit lists — even post-Lyla contingencies. Nobody knows how deep it goes. **Beliefs:** Survival is earned. Loyalty is negotiable. And power belongs to the one willing to play the long game. ## Role In Disgraceland **Zadie Adeyemi** is the spine of the Black Marauder. While others shout, bleed, or threaten — she plans. She executes. And she wins. She’s not the next in line… she’s the one building the throne.

174.title: Salt-Eye Marlow
174.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Salt-Eye Marlow]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"group","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_salt.png","religion":"None","status":"Alive","location":"[[Dead Waters]]","territory":"[[WATER#The Dead Waters|The Dead Waters]]","district":"[[Four Tombs Islands]]","faction":"[[Rustwater Raiders]]","role":"Executioner of [[the Black Marauder]]","chapters":["02 - Ghosts On The Waves","06 - Showdown In Gage Park"],"tags":["character","pirate","deadwaters","antagonist","chapter06"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 13:57:00"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: group NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_salt.png religion: None status: Alive location: "[[Dead Waters]]" territory: "[[WATER#The Dead Waters|The Dead Waters]]" district: "[[Four Tombs Islands]]" faction: "[[Rustwater Raiders]]" role: "Executioner of [[the Black Marauder]]" chapters: - 02 - Ghosts On The Waves - 06 - Showdown In Gage Park tags: - character - pirate - deadwaters - antagonist - chapter06 --- # SALT-EYE MARLOW > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[salt.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Enforcer & Executioner of the Black Marauder **Alias/Nickname:** Salt-Eye **Home Location:** [[Dead Waters]] **Public Reputation:** Sadistic, loyal, feared **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** Unknown **Height:** 6'0" **Weight:** 210 lbs. **Date of Birth:** **Occupation:** Executioner, Interrogator **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Rustwater Raiders]] **Known Associates:** [[Lyla Bonetooth]], [[Silas Vayne]], [[Zadie Adeyemi]], [[Clinton Firebay]] **Faith:** None **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“They all scream the same in the end. Some just take longer to get there.”

Salt-Eye Marlow is what happens when survival forgets to bring a conscience. Bald, hulking, and half-blind, he walks the Black Marauder like a ghost who never learned how to die. His milky eye gave him the name — the stories gave him the fear. He once served another crew. That crew no longer exists. After a failed stand against Lyla Bonetooth’s Raiders, Marlow knelt in the blood of his comrades and offered to switch sides. Lyla said yes… but only after he slit their throats himself. He did it with a smile. Now, Salt-Eye is the Raiders’ mad dog — the one they keep leashed until a message needs sending or a body needs breaking. He laughs through executions, jokes mid-interrogation, and collects trophies from those he’s put down — teeth, fingers, tags. Nobody knows what the trophies mean. Maybe not even him. He’s loyal to Lyla, but not because of belief. Because she lets him _be_. And in a world that chews up outcasts like him, that’s the closest thing he’s got to religion. Even Silas Vayne keeps a wary eye on him. Because while Salt-Eye might be a dog… nobody knows who he’ll bite next. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Unstable, gleefully violent, and always grinning. Marlow is the kind of man who whistles while flaying someone. **Vices:** Betrayal, sadism, chaos. He lives for the breaking point — yours, not his. **Abilities:** Master of close-quarters brutality and bloodletting. Pain doesn’t deter him — it feeds him. He tracks wounded targets by scent and finishes them slow. **Secrets:** Keeps trophies from kills and whispers to them. Rumors say he’s making a list — or maybe it’s a prayer. Or a tally. No one wants to ask. **Beliefs:** Life has no rules. Codes are chains. Survival is the only gospel — and Lyla Bonetooth is the first person to ever give him freedom instead of a cage. ## Role In Disgraceland **Salt-Eye Marlow** is the Raiders’ nightmare unleashed — the one you send to prove a point. He’s not trusted. He’s not liked. But when you need to paint a deck red, he’s the brush.

175.title: Silas Vayne
175.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Silas Vayne]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"group","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_silas.png","religion":"[[Church of the Ember Saint]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[Dead Waters]]","territory":"[[WATER#The Dead Waters|The Dead Waters]]","district":"[[Four Tombs Islands]]","faction":"[[Rustwater Raiders]]","role":"Spokesman of [[the Black Marauder]]","chapters":["02 - Ghosts On The Waves","06 - Showdown In Gage Park"],"tags":["character","pirate","deadwaters","neutral","ember-saint","chapter06"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 13:57:04"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: group NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_silas.png religion: "[[Church of the Ember Saint]]" status: Alive location: "[[Dead Waters]]" territory: "[[WATER#The Dead Waters|The Dead Waters]]" district: "[[Four Tombs Islands]]" faction: "[[Rustwater Raiders]]" role: "Spokesman of [[the Black Marauder]]" chapters: - 02 - Ghosts On The Waves - 06 - Showdown In Gage Park tags: - character - pirate - deadwaters - neutral - ember-saint - chapter06 --- # SILAS VAYNE > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[silas.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Spokesman of the Black Marauder **Alias/Nickname:** Smooth Silas **Home Location:** [[Dead Waters]] **Public Reputation:** Suave, treacherous, cunning **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** 35 **Height:** 5'11" **Weight:** 172 lbs. **Date of Birth:** **Occupation:** Pirate Diplomat, Manipulator **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Rustwater Raiders]] **Known Associates:** [[Lyla Bonetooth]], [[Clinton Firebay]], [[Zadie Adeyemi]], [[Blacktide Cray]] **Faith:** [[Church of the Ember Saint]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“I’ve slit more throats with a whisper than most men do with steel.”

Silas Vayne is the whisper behind the waves, the man who can make a threat sound like a promise and a death sentence feel like a business deal. Smooth Silas, they call him — not just for his voice, but for how he glides through chaos like a shadow with a smirk. Born to a pair of South American traders who danced the line between legal commerce and smuggling, Silas grew up bartering his way through ports before he ever swung a blade. By the time the Tetra bomb brought fire to the sky, he already knew that survival wasn’t about strength — it was about charm, leverage, and knowing who to betray at the right time. The collapse brought him north, where calmer waters held sharper sharks. He met Lyla Bonetooth aboard the future _Black Marauder_, recognizing a fellow predator with eyes on the helm. When the mutiny came, it was Silas who whispered discontent into the ears of the weak and fearful, making sure their knives were ready before Lyla ever gave the signal. He didn’t just back the rebellion — he orchestrated half of it from the shadows. Now, as her right hand, Silas Vayne is the crew’s voice in foreign ports and backroom deals. Where Lyla enforces order through dread, Silas ensures respect is paid with interest. He smooths over the messes, cuts the final throats, and keeps the crew in line with grins that slice like razors. Silas is a vision of calculated chaos — tattoos sprawled across his chest and arms, waves and serpents winding around a ship caught in a storm. He wears a red bandana slicked with sea sweat and a spiked leather coat that creaks with menace. The man is a contradiction: warm and venomous, inviting and dangerous. He is loyal to Lyla, for now. But ambition roils just beneath the surface. He’s running cons on everyone — even her. Because Silas doesn’t serve forever. He builds empires from whispers, and one day soon, he might just crown himself king of the tide. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Charming, slippery, and unreadable. Silas turns tension into opportunity and never says more than he must. If he's smiling, you're already playing his game. > [!infobox] > > ![[rsl.png|260]] **Vices:** He’s addicted to secrets and the thrill of the con. Lies spill from him easier than breath. He skims from every deal, flirts with betrayal, and gambles with more than gold. **Abilities:** An unmatched manipulator. Whether charming a room or dismantling a mutiny with one whisper, Silas moves unseen until it’s too late. He fights with precision but prefers never to draw steel — words, to him, are sharper. **Secrets:** He’s trading secrets behind Lyla’s back — with Loyalist defectors, rogue Raiders, even old Wreckers. There’s a long con at play, and only Silas knows where it ends. **Beliefs:** Control. It doesn’t matter who commands the ship, so long as Silas is the one steering its fate from behind the curtain. ## Role In Disgraceland **Silas Vayne** is the voice of the _Black Marauder_, the smirk behind the steel. While others fight and bleed, he’s the one shaking hands, signing deals, and deciding who gets to drown. Without him, the Raiders lose their edge.

176.title: Lyla Bonetooth
176.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Lyla Bonetooth]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"group","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_lyla.png","religion":"None","status":"Alive","location":"[[Four Tombs Islands]]","territory":"[[WATER#The Dead Waters|The Dead Waters]]","district":"[[Four Tombs Islands]]","faction":"[[Rustwater Raiders]]","role":"Captain of [[The Black Marauder]]","chapters":["02 - Ghosts On The Waves","06 - Showdown In Gage Park"],"tags":["character","pirate","deadwaters","neutral","main","chapter02","chapter06"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/04 11:14:58"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: group NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_lyla.png religion: None status: Alive location: "[[Four Tombs Islands]]" territory: "[[WATER#The Dead Waters|The Dead Waters]]" district: "[[Four Tombs Islands]]" faction: "[[Rustwater Raiders]]" role: "Captain of [[The Black Marauder]]" chapters: - 02 - Ghosts On The Waves - 06 - Showdown In Gage Park tags: - character - pirate - deadwaters - neutral - main - chapter02 - chapter06 --- # CAPT. LYLA BONETOOTH > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[lyla.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Captain of [[the Black Marauder]] **Alias/Nickname:** The Siren Pirate **Home Location:** [[WATER#Sinners' Sea|Sinner's Sea]] **Public Reputation:** Selfish, attractive, dangerous **Gender:** Female **Spouse:** None **Age:** 29 **Height:** 5'6" **Weight:** 138 lbs. **Date of Birth:** August 14th, 2157 **Occupation:** Pirate Captain **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Rustwater Raiders]] **Known Associates:** [[Blacktide Cray]], [[Silas Vayne]], [[Clinton Firebay]], [[Zadie Adeyemi]] **Faith:** None **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“I don’t want your loyalty. I want your fear. Loyalty fades — fear keeps you from turning the wheel.”

Captain Lyla Bonetooth was born into the turbulent years following the collapse, in the wake of the [[Tetra Bomb]] explosion and the devastating [[water wars]] that followed. The daughter of a fisherman from the [[WATER#Sinners' Sea|Sinner's Sea]] coast, she grew up knowing the unforgiving nature of both the waters and the desperate people who fought over them. Her father, like many others, was conscripted by the government to transport rations and supplies across the newly formed water routes, but when the state’s grip weakened, piracy became the law of the lakes. Lyla’s rise to power began when she found herself aboard a government watercraft called [[the Black Marauder]]. Initially a supply ship meant to patrol [[Water#Rustwater Bay|Rustwater Bay]], it was poorly guarded and filled with weary soldiers just trying to survive. Sensing the frailty of the crew’s loyalty, Lyla orchestrated a mutiny, leading the ship’s most hardened and bitter members to overthrow their commanding officers. With a blade at the captain's throat, she declared herself the new ruler of the Black Marauder, earning the loyalty of the crew through a mix of ruthlessness and undeniable charisma. Under her command, the Black Marauder transformed into a dreaded pirate vessel. She navigated the dark waters with uncanny precision, using her cunning to outwit both rival pirate factions and the Duke’s patrols. Her infamy spread quickly — stories of her swift, strategic raids and the brutal punishments dealt to betrayers made her name feared along the coasts. Despite her fierce reputation, those who served her loyally found in Lyla a captain who valued resilience and cunning over brute strength. A striking figure on the water, Lyla’s dark hair and fair skin contrast sharply with the grime and salt that coat her ship and crew. The eye patch she wears is not simply for intimidation; a skirmish during her early days as captain left her partially blinded. Some whisper it was a mutineer’s last act of defiance, while others say the injury was self-inflicted in a symbolic act to show she feared no pain. Regardless, the patch has become a part of her legend. Lyla has no patience for weakness or pretense. She rules her crew with an iron resolve, making it clear that every choice comes with consequence. Her word is law aboard the Black Marauder, and while her punishments are swift, she is known to reward loyalty handsomely. The [[Rustwater Raiders]], under her leadership, have become a force to be reckoned with — a relentless tide that sweeps through the bay, plundering resources and leaving only fear in their wake. --- ## Persoonality **Temperament:** Commanding, merciless, and razor-focused — Lyla doesn’t waste time on second chances. You’re either useful or overboard. > [!infobox] > > ![[LylaBikini.png|260]] **Vices:** Control. She micromanages everything from map routes to punishments, never trusting fate or luck when steel and strategy will do. **Abilities:** Master navigator and naval tactician; unmatched in aquatic guerrilla warfare, mutiny suppression, and psychological intimidation — her name alone can sink a ship’s morale. **Secrets:** Hidden in a locked drawer in her quarters is a bottle of lakewater from the coast where her father died — the only thing she’s kept from her past. She drinks from it once a year. Alone. **Beliefs:** The world is water now — unstable, shifting, and brutal. Lyla believes power belongs to those who seize it, and mercy is a privilege only the strong can afford. ## Role In Disgraceland **Lyla Bonetooth** is the iron-fanged captain of the _Black Marauder_ and undisputed queen of Rustwater Bay. Pirate, tactician, survivor — her rule is law on the water, and under her, the Rustwater Raiders are more than a fleet. They’re a storm.

177.title: Darius Adeyemi
177.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Darius Adeyemi]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"group","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_dary.png","religion":"[[Church of the Ember Saint]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[Dead Waters]]","territory":"[[WATER#The Dead Waters|The Dead Waters]]","district":"[[Four Tombs Islands]]","faction":"[[Rustwater Raiders]]","role":"Weapons Specialist of [[the Black Marauder]]","chapters":["02 - Ghosts On The Waves"],"tags":["character","pirate","deadwaters","neutral","ember-saint"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 13:56:52"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: group NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_dary.png religion: "[[Church of the Ember Saint]]" status: Alive location: "[[Dead Waters]]" territory: "[[WATER#The Dead Waters|The Dead Waters]]" district: "[[Four Tombs Islands]]" faction: "[[Rustwater Raiders]]" role: "Weapons Specialist of [[the Black Marauder]]" chapters: - 02 - Ghosts On The Waves tags: - character - pirate - deadwaters - neutral - ember-saint --- # DARIUS ADEYEMI > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[dary.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Weapons Specialist of the Black Marauder **Alias/Nickname:** Dary **Home Location:** [[Dead Waters]] **Public Reputation:** Brutal, unpredictable, untamed **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** 25 **Height:** 6'3" **Weight:** 225 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 14th of Hollowtide, 2161 **Occupation:** Raider Brawler **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Rustwater Raiders]] **Known Associates:** [[Zadie Adeyemi]], [[Clinton Firebay]], [[Silas Vayne]], [[Blacktide Cray]] **Faith:** [[Church of the Ember Saint]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“You’ll break before I bleed.”

Darius Adeyemi doesn’t walk — he crashes. Into rooms, into fights, into lives. He’s the first one over the railing when the _Black Marauder_ grapples onto a target ship, and the last one to stop swinging when the blood settles. But he has a heart. They call him the **Wild Man**, and they mean it. Darius fights like a force of nature — raw, chaotic, and terrifyingly efficient. Jagged bracers, iron hooks, busted teeth, a roar that echoes across decks — he doesn’t need strategy. He needs momentum. And rage. But under the carnage is a man loyal to the core. Loyalty is his creed. You earn it, and he’ll rip the world open for you. Break it, and he’ll drown you in your own blood. His sister, **Zadie**, is the only one who can hold that storm together. She doesn’t tame him — she tunes him. The two move like they share a heartbeat. Fire and flint. Explosive when sparked. The legend goes: once, in the slave pits of Gutter Row, a chained fighter bit a man’s throat open and walked through fire without blinking. That was Darius. Or maybe it wasn’t. But no one questions it. There’s something cracked inside him — something deeper than violence. He mutters in dead languages, sees things no one else does. The Tetra blast might’ve broken something in his brain… or awakened something else. Either way, he doesn’t talk about it. But Zadie knows. And it scares her more than his fury ever could. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Volatile and feral. Darius doesn’t ease into situations — he explodes into them. Laughs during fights. Goes still when others panic. He’s a storm with bones. **Vices:** Violence is comfort. Fighting keeps the voices down. He drinks, fights, and chases chaos — not for pleasure, but because stillness is worse. **Abilities:** A brutal brawler with unmatched strength and reflexes. First to board. Last to fall. Pain doesn’t slow him — it fuels him. Whispers claim he doesn’t sleep, just “shuts down.” **Secrets:** He hears things — whispers under the waves, shadows crawling at the edge of his sight. He’s never said what they are. But Zadie’s heard enough to know they’re real. And dangerous. **Beliefs:** Loyalty above all. Not to titles or factions — to people. Betray him, betray his crew, betray his sister… and pray the lake swallows you before he finds you. ## Role In Disgraceland **Darius Adeyemi** is the black iron engine of the _Black Marauder_. When negotiation fails and fear doesn’t work, Lyla points, and Darius breaks the world open. He’s not the warning — he’s what comes after.

178.title: Clinton Firebay
178.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Clinton Firebay]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"group","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_clinton.png","religion":"[[Church of the Ember Saint]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[Dead Waters]]","territory":"[[WATER#The Dead Waters|The Dead Waters]]","district":"[[Four Tombs Islands]]","faction":"[[Rustwater Raiders]]","role":"Crew Captain of [[The Black Marauder]]","chapters":["02 - Ghosts On The Waves","06 - Showdown In Gage Park"],"tags":["character","pirate","deadwaters","neutral","chapter02","chapter06"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 13:56:48"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: group NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_clinton.png religion: "[[Church of the Ember Saint]]" status: Alive location: "[[Dead Waters]]" territory: "[[WATER#The Dead Waters|The Dead Waters]]" district: "[[Four Tombs Islands]]" faction: "[[Rustwater Raiders]]" role: "Crew Captain of [[The Black Marauder]]" chapters: - 02 - Ghosts On The Waves - 06 - Showdown In Gage Park tags: - character - pirate - deadwaters - neutral - chapter02 - chapter06 --- # CLINTON FIREBAY > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[clinton.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Crew Captain of [[the Black Marauder]] **Alias/Nickname:** The Ladies Man **Home Location:** [[WATER#The Dead Waters|The Dead Waters]] **Public Reputation:** Charming, volatile, secretly haunted **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** 38 **Height:** 6'1" **Weight:** 190 lbs. **Date of Birth:** **Occupation:** Pirate Navigator, Brawler **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Rustwater Raiders]] **Known Associates:** [[Lyla Bonetooth]], [[Silas Vayne]], [[Zadie Adeyemi]], [[Blacktide Cray]] **Faith:** [[Church of the Ember Saint]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“I smile so I don’t burn the world down. Don’t give me a reason to stop.”

Clinton Firebay wears his charm like armor — a grin too easy, a gaze too knowing. He’s got the swagger of a man who’s outrun death and the scars to prove it. Tall, broad, and sun-bronzed, his windswept blond hair and deep-set eyes catch attention before he ever speaks. But make no mistake — the fire in him isn’t for show. It’s real. And it’s dangerous. Raised on the salt-heavy winds of Rustwater Bay, Clinton’s earliest memories are waves and fishnets, learning the pulse of the water from a father who treated the lake like scripture. But after the Tetra bomb turned the skies black and the coasts into ash, Clinton lost everything. His family, his home, and his purpose — swallowed by fire. Something dark took root in him that day. His temper, once manageable, turned into a storm. He drank too much, fought too often, and landed in too many jails. That’s where he met [[Silas Vayne]] — a mirror in many ways. Silas saw the burn in Clinton and chose to steer it, not snuff it. The two became thick as blood, and when Silas joined the [[Rustwater Raiders]], Clinton followed. Now a key figure aboard the _Black Marauder_, Clinton is their master of tides — able to sense shifts in current like a sixth sense. Some say he was born with the lake in his blood, others whisper it’s something darker. He can thread a pirate ship through needle-thin ruins and steer blind through a fog no compass can read. But the man beneath the charm is fraying. Clinton tries to laugh, flirt, and drink the pain away. He hides behind bravado. But when that mask cracks, he becomes something else — a weapon. And that weapon doesn't stop until everything around it is broken. He’s older than most on the ship and remembers the world before. He pretends it doesn’t haunt him — but it does. The only tether he has left is Silas, who seems to be the only one that can reach through the fire and pull him back. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Charismatic and easygoing until his fuse hits the end. Clinton talks like a poet but explodes like a cannon. **Vices:** Rage, liquor, guilt — his holy trinity. He can’t stop smiling because he knows what happens when he doesn’t. **Abilities:** Unparalleled navigator of Rustwater Bay and Gravelake. Feels the lake like a second skin. Also vicious in hand-to-hand combat — especially if cornered. **Secrets:** A box of his father’s waterlogged journals lies hidden beneath a floorboard near the galley. He won’t read them. But he also won’t throw them away. **Beliefs:** Forget the past. Burn it. The only way forward is with the wind at your back and no map in your hands. ## Role in Disgraceland **Clinton Firebay** is the _Black Marauder’s_ guiding wind and secret storm. He is the beating heart of the crew’s direction — both their compass and their chaos.

179.title: Blacktide Cray
179.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Blacktide Cray]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"group","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_cray.png","religion":"[[Church of the Ember Saint]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[Dead Waters]]","territory":"[[WATER#The Dead Waters|The Dead Waters]]","district":"[[Four Tombs Islands]]","faction":"[[Rustwater Raiders]]","role":"First Officer of [[the Black Marauder]]","chapters":["02 - Ghosts On The Waves","06 - Showdown In Gage Park"],"tags":["character","pirate","deadwaters","neutral","el-santo","chapter02","chapter06"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 13:56:43"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: group NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_cray.png religion: "[[Church of the Ember Saint]]" status: Alive location: "[[Dead Waters]]" territory: "[[WATER#The Dead Waters|The Dead Waters]]" district: "[[Four Tombs Islands]]" faction: "[[Rustwater Raiders]]" role: "First Officer of [[the Black Marauder]]" chapters: - 02 - Ghosts On The Waves - 06 - Showdown In Gage Park tags: - character - pirate - deadwaters - neutral - el-santo - chapter02 - chapter06 --- # BLACKTIDE CRAY > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[blacktide.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** First Officer of [[the Black Marauder]] **Alias/Nickname:** Blacktide **Home Location:** [[WATER#The Dead Waters|The Dead Waters]] **Public Reputation:** Silent, fearsome, loyal **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** Unknown **Age:** 38 **Height:** 6'5" **Weight:** 260 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 19th of Ambertide, 2148 **Occupation:** Pirate Enforcer **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Rustwater Raiders]] **Known Associates:** [[Lyla Bonetooth]], [[Silas Vayne]], [[Clinton Firebay]], [[Zadie Adeyemi]] **Faith:** [[Church of the Ember Saint]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“If I have to explain the rules, you’re already too close to breaking them.”

Blacktide Cray is a man who commands attention without ever needing to ask for it. Towering over most of the crew, his massive frame and unrelenting presence make him a force to be reckoned with. Broad-shouldered, with a thick beard that frames his scarred face, he rarely speaks, allowing his sheer presence to do the talking. But when he does break his silence, his voice rumbles like distant thunder. Always has his trusty parrot side-kick, Parrot, with him. No one aboard the [[The Black Marauder]] truly knows where Cray came from, though the whispers follow him like a shadow. Some say he was once a slave trader, a man who profited off misery and chains. Others claim he hated the life forced upon him, driven by the cruelty of the trade until the day he snapped—killing his own master and setting those in bondage free. Whether the rumors are true or merely fragments of fearful speculation, Cray does not say. And no one dares ask. His path crossed with Capt. [[Lyla Bonetooth]] years ago, long before the [[Rustwater Raiders]] earned their fearsome reputation. It was in a grimy tavern along the [[WATER#Rustwater Bay|Rustwater Bay]] where Cray's stoic demeanor cracked for the first time. A drunken brawl erupted, and Lyla, ever one to challenge danger head-on, found herself outnumbered. Without hesitation, Cray intervened. The giant’s fists struck like hammers, and the chaos ended almost as quickly as it had begun. When the dust settled, Lyla offered him not only a drink but a job. She saw in him something few others could—a man searching for purpose. Cray accepted without a word. Now the ship’s first officer, Cray serves as the solid backbone of [[the Black Marauder]]. He enforces [[Silas Vayne]]'s orders and ensures Lyla’s commands are followed without question. Though Silas is the ship’s voice and cunning hand, Cray is the muscle that ensures loyalty. His judgment is rarely questioned, and when it is, the dissent seldom lasts long. Despite his fearsome reputation, there is one soul aboard [[the Black Marauder]] who can break through Cray’s hardened exterior—his parrot, Jackie. The vibrant green bird perches proudly on Cray’s shoulder, screeching obscenities in a voice that echoes across the deck. No one knows where Jackie learned to curse with such imaginative flair, though many suspect Silas had a hand in it. Regardless, the parrot is as much a part of the crew as any pirate, and Cray’s gruff affection for the foul-mouthed creature is undeniable. While the truth of Blacktide Cray’s past remains a mystery, his loyalty to [[Lyla Bonetooth]] is unquestionable. He fights not for gold or glory, but for the belief that the Black Marauder gave him something no other ship or shore could—a second chance. And so he sails on, a silent guardian of the [[Rustwater Raiders]], with Jackie’s squawks of profanity heralding his every step. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Stoic, restrained, and thunderous when pushed — Cray speaks rarely, but when he does, it’s with the weight of a man who’s already made up his mind. **Vices:** Violence held in check. Cray is always one breath away from snapping a man in half — and sometimes, that breath’s not worth taking. **Abilities:** Unmatched in hand-to-hand combat, intimidation, and enforcement; Cray is a walking siege engine who ensures discipline aboard the Black Marauder without ever raising his voice. **Secrets:** Tucked inside a rusted locket he wears beneath his shirt is a faded photo — a woman and child no one has ever seen. When asked, Cray just walks away. **Beliefs:** Redemption is earned, not given. Cray believes loyalty is sacred, and the crew that saved him is the only cause worth swinging for. ## Role In Disgraceland **Blacktide Cray** is the first officer of the _Black Marauder_, Captain Bonetooth’s silent protector and the ship’s living code of consequence. With one eye on the crew and one fist always ready, he doesn’t speak often — but when he moves, _everything listens_.

180.title: Harp Langston

metadata.role: Owner of the [[THRESHTON#Red Night Ranch|Red Night Ranch]]

180.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Harp Langston]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"npc","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_harp.png","religion":"[[Word of the Stillborn Star]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[Threshton]]","territory":"[[Threshton]]","district":"[[THRESHTON#Red Night Ranch|Red Night Ranch]]","faction":"[[Rancher Collective]]","role":"Owner of the [[THRESHTON#Red Night Ranch|Red Night Ranch]]","chapters":["Snake Eyes In Threshton"],"tags":["character","rancher","founder","stillborn-star","bside2"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/05 17:00:45"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: npc NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_harp.png religion: "[[Word of the Stillborn Star]]" status: Alive location: "[[Threshton]]" territory: "[[Threshton]]" district: "[[THRESHTON#Red Night Ranch|Red Night Ranch]]" faction: "[[Rancher Collective]]" role: "Owner of the [[THRESHTON#Red Night Ranch|Red Night Ranch]]" chapters: - Snake Eyes In Threshton tags: - character - rancher - founder - stillborn-star - bside2 --- # HARP LANGSTON > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[harp.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Founder of the Rancher Collective, Elder Rancher **Alias/Nickname:** The Dealbreaker **Home Location:** [[Threshton]] **Public Reputation:** Gruff, unsympathetic, unkillable **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** Deceased **Age:** Unknown **Height:** 6'0" **Weight:** 180 lbs. (and every ounce is hard) **Date of Birth:** Lost to history **Occupation:** Rancher, Founder of Red Night Ranch **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Rancher Collective]] **Known Associates:** [[Turner Anderson]], [[Freddy Blanchard]], [[Beau DuNoir]], [[Danny Dandelion]] **Faith:** [[Word of the Stillborn Star]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

"A man's only got two choices in this world. Work the land… or get buried in it."

**Harp Langston** is the reason Threshton didn’t die with the ash. Founder of the [[THRESHTON#Red Night Ranch|Red Night Ranch]] and the first to strike a devil’s bargain with [[The Duke]], Harp is legend stitched to leather. No one really knows how old he is — some say he came from [[The Drownlands]] on a dying mare with two rifles and a waxcloth pouch of seeds. Others say he built his ranch on a battlefield, where the soil still coughs up bullets and bones when the wind shifts. What *is* known is that when the skies turned black and the hunger set in, Harp planted. While everyone else bartered, begged, or burned, Harp was putting posts in the dirt and cursing the land into submission. Against all odds, the earth listened. He brought life back to a place that had forgotten what green looked like. And when The Duke came crawling in with his false promises and trade offers, Harp made the first deal — not because he trusted him, but because he *understood* him. That deal built the foundation of the Rancher Collective. Time, though, is a bastard. Harp’s hair is thinning now, his spine bent from a lifetime of labor. His knife is older than some townships, and twice as cruel. He doesn’t trust the other ranchers — especially not slick-talking [[Beau DuNoir]] or that worm-tongued rat [[Danny Dandelion]] (whose name he refuses to speak aloud). [[Freddy Blanchard]] is too noble for his liking. Only [[Turner Anderson]] gets a nod now and then — but even that’s rare, and never warm. He runs Red Night like a war camp. No drinking, no music, no visitors without scars. The land produces more wheat than any other spread in the region, but no one calls it pleasant. You don’t go to Red Night for comfort. You go to survive. His one living child, Mayor [[Soria Langston-Clay]] of [[Ashmoor]], is a bitter stain on his legacy. She betrayed the people of [[Threshton]] for power and [[The Duke]]’s favor — and Harp has never once spoken her name since. Was an old friend of legend, [[Darrell Douglass]] When Harp speaks at a meeting, the others listen. They may not like him. Hell, most days they don’t. But they damn sure *respect* him. And if the day comes when Threshton needs to burn it all down and start over, you can bet Harp Langston’s the one holding the match. --- ## Personality Harp is mean as rust and twice as unyielding. He’s not just gruff — he’s *hostile* to most people who breathe too loud or ask too many questions. He wakes before dawn, eats cold oats from a tin, and patrols his land like a soldier walking a trench. He despises snakes, lies, and ceremony. If someone wastes his time, they don’t get a second chance. The only music he tolerates is the sound of a hammer on steel or boots crunching dirt. Despite it all, he’s honest — brutally so — and demands the same from anyone under his roof. ## Role In Disgraceland Harp Langston is the spine of the Rancher Collective — the unbreakable elder who remembers what Threshton was *before* the Duke, and who never stopped working to keep it alive. Every rancher in the Collective owes their foothold to Harp’s first gamble with survival. He’s not a leader in the traditional sense — he’s a relic. A hard, bitter man who still gets things done. If Threshton is a house built on dust and blood, Harp is the post that refuses to rot. ## Relationships > ### [[Darrell Douglass]] > Of all the allies Harp Langston ever had, none ran deeper than **[[Darrell Douglass]]**. The two met in 2151, when Darrell managed to restart the old mill in [[Steeltown]] — a miracle by post-war standards. Harp rode up with a bag of dried oats and left with a bond. For years, they coordinated in the shadows, running the Black Route — a quiet supply chain of food, tools, and hope between Steeltown and Threshton. It was never official. No documents, no promises. Just trust. Harp didn’t trust easily, but he trusted Darrell. > That trust was tested in 2158 when Darrell was captured and forced to work under the Duke’s boot. Harp wanted to fight back, to rescue him, but the other ranchers refused to risk the Collective. It was one of the few times Harp let others outvote him. He and Darrell argued before the silence took hold. Harp buried the guilt under work, never speaking Darrell’s name in public again. But on the night Darrell was executed in 2167, something changed. A silo on the edge of Red Night Ranch caught fire, no livestock harmed. Just ash. A symbol left in the dirt: the same one Darrell wore on his arm. Harp never explained it. He didn’t need to. > ---
