182.title: Danny Dandelion

metadata.role: Owner of the [[THRESHTON#Snake Kiss Ranch|Snake Kiss Ranch]]

182.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Danny Dandelion]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"npc","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/tth_danny.png","religion":"[[Church of the Ember Saint]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[Threshton]]","territory":"[[Threshton]]","district":"[[THRESHTON#Snake Kiss Ranch|Snake Kiss Ranch]]","faction":"[[Rancher Collective]]","role":"Owner of the [[THRESHTON#Snake Kiss Ranch|Snake Kiss Ranch]]","chapters":["Snake Eyes In Threshton"],"tags":["character","antagonist","rancher","bside2"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 13:55:16"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: npc NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/tth_danny.png religion: "[[Church of the Ember Saint]]" status: Alive location: "[[Threshton]]" territory: "[[Threshton]]" district: "[[THRESHTON#Snake Kiss Ranch|Snake Kiss Ranch]]" faction: "[[Rancher Collective]]" role: "Owner of the [[THRESHTON#Snake Kiss Ranch|Snake Kiss Ranch]]" chapters: - Snake Eyes In Threshton tags: - character - antagonist - rancher - bside2 --- # DANNY DANDELION > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[danny.png|400]] ## Biography **Titles:** Rancher (barely), Snake Oil Salesman **Alias/Nickname:** The Sweet-Tongued Bastard **Home Location:** [[THRESHTON#Snake Kiss Ranch|Snake Kiss Ranch]], [[Threshton]] **Public Reputation:** Shady, slick, unwanted **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** Mid 30s (probably) **Height:** 5'10" **Weight:** 172 lbs. **Date of Birth:** Unknown **Occupation:** Conman, Landowner **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Rancher Collective]] (begrudgingly) **Known Associates:** [[Beau DuNoir]] **Faith:** "[[Church of the Ember Saint]]" **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

"Cattle die. Crops wither. But a good lie? A good lie’ll outlive the both of us."

A man with a too-slick grin and a voice like honey poured over a cactus, **Danny Dandelion** drifted into [[Threshton]] under one name and left with another. No one knows where he came from. Some say he once rode with the [[Rustwater Raiders]], others claim he used to work Duke’s checkpoints before skipping out with a pouch of stolen ration chits. Either way, he ain’t from around here — and everyone wishes he’d leave the same way he came: quietly and fast. The [[THRESHTON#Snake Kiss Ranch|Snake Kiss Ranch]] was once a peaceful patch of land run by a kindly widow named Miss Greta Harp. Danny showed up selling some miracle tonic to help her ailing lungs, and within six months, she’d “voluntarily” handed over the deed. A week later, she was found dead from a “fall.” No one could prove a damn thing. But everybody knows. He wears a fake name like he wears his smile — big, loud, and distracting. He talks a mile a minute, never stops moving, and somehow always ends up with more cards in his hand than he started with. The townsfolk don’t trust him, and the [[Rancher Collective]] sure as hell doesn’t respect him, but [[Beau DuNoir]] keeps him around for the entertainment — and maybe, just maybe, because Danny knows a thing or two Beau doesn’t want whispered. Danny has no cattle to speak of, and the land he owns ain’t worth half what the deed says. But he’s got charm, hustle, and an uncanny ability to walk away from things other men would get buried over. [[Turner Anderson]] would shoot him on sight if it wouldn’t start something ugly. [[Freddy Blanchard]] won’t shake his hand without checking his fingers afterward. But somehow… Danny’s still standing. --- ## Personality Danny is a born talker — fast, oily, and always one step ahead of someone else’s suspicion. He dresses like a merchant prince on market day, but he smells like dust and old rum. He thrives in chaos and disappears when things get too real. His habits include cheating at cards, sipping stolen liquor, flirting with danger, and worming into conversations where he doesn’t belong. He lies like other men breathe, and he enjoys every second of it. He can't sit still, always pacing, always plotting. He’s the type to toast you with one hand while robbing you with the other. No one knows if he sleeps — and if he does, it’s probably with a knife under the pillow and a back door left open. ## Role In Disgraceland Danny Dandelion is the rot on the roots of the Rancher Collective — tolerated only because removing him might cause more trouble than he’s worth. He brings nothing to the table but secrets, survival instincts, and just enough blackmail to keep himself out of a shallow grave. He is the wildcard no one trusts, yet no one can quite afford to kill. His true value might lie in what he knows — and who he’s willing to betray when the time comes. ## Appearances > - [[Snake Eyes In Threshton]]

183.title: Freddy Blanchard
183.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Freddy Blanchard]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"npc","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_freddy.png","religion":"[[Church of the Ember Saint]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[Threshton]]","territory":"[[Threshton]]","district":"[[THRESHTON#Bonebreak Ranch|Bonebreak Ranch]]","faction":"[[Rancher Collective]]","role":"Owner of the [[THRESHTON#Bonebreak Ranch|Bonebreak Ranch]]","chapters":["Snake Eyes In Threshton"],"tags":["character","protagonist","rancher","farmer","ember-saint","bside2"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 13:55:20"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: npc NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_freddy.png religion: "[[Church of the Ember Saint]]" status: Alive location: "[[Threshton]]" territory: "[[Threshton]]" district: "[[THRESHTON#Bonebreak Ranch|Bonebreak Ranch]]" faction: "[[Rancher Collective]]" role: "Owner of the [[THRESHTON#Bonebreak Ranch|Bonebreak Ranch]]" chapters: - Snake Eyes In Threshton tags: - character - protagonist - rancher - farmer - ember-saint - bside2 --- # FREDDY BLANCHARD > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[Freddy.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Rancher of the [[Rancher Collective]] **Alias/Nickname:** The Iron Nail **Home Location:** Bonebreak Ranch, [[Threshton]] **Public Reputation:** Fiercely loyal, intimidating, salt-of-the-earth **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** 39 **Height:** 6'2" **Weight:** 258 lbs. **Date of Birth:** **Occupation:** Rancher/Farmer **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Rancher Collective]] **Known Associates:** [[Turner Anderson]], [[Danny Dandelion]], [[Beau DuNoir]], [[Harp Langston]] **Faith:** "[[Church of the Ember Saint]]" **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

"I don't need a reason to feed the hungry. I need a reason not to burn this whole goddamn deal down."

They say Freddy Blanchard was born in a storm — his mother died giving birth, and his father died trying to raise him. He grew up dirt-covered and half-starved, shoveling coal and breaking wild horses for pennies in the cracked shadow of Charspire. By the time he was fifteen, Freddy could lift more than a grown man and take a punch that’d kill one too. But he wasn’t just muscle — he had purpose. He earned every acre of Bonebreak Ranch with blood and grit. When the water wars came, and the bombs fell, Freddy didn’t run or loot. He planted. Dug wells. Slaughtered meat. Built shelter. Folks came to him starving and hopeless — he fed ‘em, no questions asked. The Duke calls it charity. Freddy calls it survival. Bonebreak Ranch is the largest in Threshton, and Freddy works every inch of it with his own damn hands. The other ranchers got foremen and hired guns — Freddy’s up at dawn slinging hay bales and breaking fence with a rusted hammer and a stronger will. His back is covered in scars, his hands thick with callus, but his people swear they’ve never gone hungry under his watch. Underneath that gruff, stoic jawline and cannonball chest is a fire — a deep hatred for the Duke’s taxes, rations, and cruelty. Freddy’s the reason whole families are still alive, thanks to backdoor cattle runs and secret crop shipments smuggled through Gutter Row by moonlight. He’s made deals with pirates, bartered with outcasts, and strongarmed corrupt checkpoint guards, all without taking a single coin for himself. The other ranchers respect him like a lion — Turner Anderson may be the glue of the Collective, but Freddy’s the iron nail. And when the fighting finally comes, folks say Blanchard’ll be the one leading the charge, shovel in one hand, Duke’s blood in the other. --- ## Personality > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Rancher Meeting > ![[bf1.png|400]] **Temperament:** Gruff and intense, but fiercely loyal. Freddy doesn’t speak unless it’s worth saying, and when he does, it lands like a punch. He leads by example, not instruction. **Vices:** Sleeps in the barn more than his own bed. Carries guilt like a second skin. Hates being idle — work is his only medicine. **Abilities:** Physically powerful, borderline unstoppable in a fight. Skilled rancher, hunter, and makeshift engineer. Unshakable willpower; doesn’t fear pain, loss, or the Duke. Tactical thinker when it comes to smuggling and logistics. **Secrets:** Keeps a hidden stash of weapons buried under the north field in case war breaks out. Still communicates with someone inside Gutter Row — likely one of the pirate clans. Had a brother who joined the Loyalist Guard and was later executed by the Duke for defiance. **Beliefs:** No man should go hungry. The land belongs to those who work it. The Duke's rule is built on fear, and fear burns like anything else. ## Role In Disgraceland Freddy Blanchard is the enforcer spirit of the Rancher Collective — the man who does what others won’t, to protect what matters most. While Turner Anderson balances the ledger and charts the course, Freddy keeps the wolves at bay and the people fed by any means necessary. His silent rebellion feeds families from the shadows, and if the time for open war comes, he won’t wait for permission — he’ll lead the first charge himself. ## Appearances > - [[Snake Eyes In Threshton]]

184.title: Turner Anderson

metadata.role: Owner of [[THRESHTON#Double Cross Ranch|Double Cross Ranch]]

184.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Turner Anderson]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"npc","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_turner.png","religion":"[[Church of the Ember Saint]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[Threshton]]","territory":"[[Threshton]]","district":"[[THRESHTON#Double Cross Ranch|Double Cross Ranch]]","faction":"[[Rancher Collective]]","role":"Owner of [[THRESHTON#Double Cross Ranch|Double Cross Ranch]]","chapters":["Snake Eyes In Threshton"],"tags":["character","protagonist","bside2","rancher","farmer","ember-saint"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 13:55:34"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: npc NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_turner.png religion: "[[Church of the Ember Saint]]" status: Alive location: "[[Threshton]]" territory: "[[Threshton]]" district: "[[THRESHTON#Double Cross Ranch|Double Cross Ranch]]" faction: "[[Rancher Collective]]" role: "Owner of [[THRESHTON#Double Cross Ranch|Double Cross Ranch]]" chapters: - Snake Eyes In Threshton tags: - character - protagonist - bside2 - rancher - farmer - ember-saint --- # TURNER ANDERSON > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[turner.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Head Rancher of the [[Rancher Collective]] **Alias/Nickname:** Black Turner **Home Location:** [[Threshton]] **Public Reputation:** Helpful. sympathetic, tough **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** 40 **Height:** 6'4" **Weight:** 241 lbs. **Date of Birth:** **Occupation:** Rancher/Farmer **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Rancher Collective]] **Known Associates:** **Faith:** "[[Church of the Ember Saint]]" **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“A man’s worth ain’t counted in coin or cattle. It’s in how many mouths he’s fed and how many devils he’s held off ‘til the sun comes up.”

Turner Anderson was born under a copper sky in the scorched outskirts of [[Threshton]], back when the region was still choking on dust and lawlessness in the immediate fallout of the [[Tetra Bomb]]. His father was one of the first to settle after the skies cleared, carving a patch of land out of the dead soil and coaxing life from it with blood and fire. Turner grew up with blisters on his hands and a rifle slung across his back — by age thirteen, he’d already buried two rustlers and a mother lost to the cough. The [[Double-Cross Ranch]] became legend during the first wave of post-bomb settlements. Named after the cattle brand his father carved from scrap iron — two crude Xs overlapping — the ranch stood for resilience and survival. Turner led efforts to irrigate the fields using a jerry-rigged network of salvaged piping and old-world farm tech. He was the first to successfully grow wheat in Tetra-scorched soil and the first to trade cattle beyond Threshton’s borders. But it was never just about survival for Turner — it was about pride. Dignity. Feeding people who’d never known anything but hunger. As the [[Rancher Collective]] formed to organize the increasingly fragile supply lines, Turner naturally stepped into a leadership role. The other four ranchers — each tough in their own right — respected his steady hand, his iron-bound code, and his willingness to ride into danger to protect a shipment of grain or a rusted-out water pump. Some say the first meeting of the Collective was settled over whiskey and blood in Turner’s barn, after he challenged a land baron to a knife duel to stop a water hoarding scheme. Turner won — didn’t kill the man, but left him without his trigger finger. He’s seen the Duke’s claws tighten around Threshton year after year — tariffs, fuel rations, guards posted at silo checkpoints. He understands the deal: the Duke supplies power, fuel, and some semblance of order in exchange for the region’s food. But Turner knows damn well that it’s extortion dressed up as stability. Still, breaking from [[The Duke]] would mean starvation for half the map. That conflict lives in his eyes — every time he signs off on a shipment destined for [[Ashmoor]]. He wears black like mourning cloth. Lost his only son in a skirmish near [[GUTTER ROW]] — a fight over food the boy never should’ve been in. That grief made Turner harder, quieter. Now he rides alone most days, inspecting the herds, keeping the young ranch hands in line, making sure no one skims from the weight scales. Some say if there ever is a rebellion in Threshton, it won’t start with the loud mouths or the gun hawks. It’ll start when Turner Anderson stops sending crates of grain to Ashmoor. And when that happens, the whole damn food chain might come crashing down. --- ## Personality > [!infobox] > > ![[duke3.png|260]] **Temperament:** Stoic and principled. Turner speaks little, listens deeply, and weighs every decision like it could break a man. He is the calm in the storm — until pushed too far. **Vices:** Whiskey before sunup. Long, lonely rides. The need to fix everything himself. **Abilities:** Master survivalist and rancher; pioneered post-Tetra agriculture in Threshton. Skilled marksman and knife fighter; once ended a land dispute with a blade, not a bullet. - Natural leader; commands respect without ever asking for it. **Secrets:** Has met privately with **Freddy Blanchard** more than once to discuss what happens _after_ the Duke falls. **Beliefs:** Justice is non-negotiable. The Duke is a disease, and Disgraceland won’t heal until he’s ripped out root and stem. Jimmy believes in the people — and that they’re worth every scar. ## Role In Disgraceland Turner Anderson is the heart and backbone of Threshton. A living symbol of what the land used to be — and what it still could become. He holds the food supply chain together by sheer will and grit, walking the razor’s edge between obedience to the Duke and quiet rebellion. If Turner ever tips the scales, Disgraceland won’t be able to ignore it. ## Appearances > - [[Snake Eyes In Threshton]]

185.title: Beau DuNoir
185.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Beau DuNoir]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"npc","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_beau.png","religion":"[[Church of the Ember Saint]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[Threshton]]","territory":"[[Threshton]]","district":"[[THRESHTON#Hangman's Ranch|Hangman's Ranch]]","faction":"[[Rancher Collective]]","role":"Owner of [[THRESHTON#Hangman's Ranch|Hangman's Ranch]]","chapters":["Snake Eyes In Threshton"],"tags":["character","protagonist","rancher","gambler","ember-saint","bside2"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 13:55:09"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: npc NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_beau.png religion: "[[Church of the Ember Saint]]" status: Alive location: "[[Threshton]]" territory: "[[Threshton]]" district: "[[THRESHTON#Hangman's Ranch|Hangman's Ranch]]" faction: "[[Rancher Collective]]" role: "Owner of [[THRESHTON#Hangman's Ranch|Hangman's Ranch]]" chapters: - Snake Eyes In Threshton tags: - character - protagonist - rancher - gambler - ember-saint - bside2 --- # BEAU DuNOIR > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[beau.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Rancher, Gambler, Negotiator **Alias/Nickname:** The Velvet Vulture **Home Location:** Hangman's Ranch, [[Threshton]] **Public Reputation:** Charming, manipulative, dangerous **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None (plenty of scandal) **Age:** 42 **Height:** 5'11" **Weight:** 197 lbs. **Date of Birth:** **Occupation:** Rancher, Gambler, Negotiator **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Rancher Collective]] **Known Associates:** [[Turner Anderson]], [[Freddy Blanchard]], [[Danny Dandelion]], [[Harp Langston]] **Faith:** [[Church of the Ember Saint]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

"Life's just a crooked hand of cards, darlin'. I don't cheat. I just play smarter."

One day, few years back, Beau found himself seated at the infamous Red Widow table — a high-stakes game hosted by a dying cattle baron named **Olin Vex**, too proud to admit his empire was crumbling under the weight of his addictions. Beau, ever the opportunist, kept his tells hidden behind gold-rimmed glasses and a honeyed drawl. When the dust settled, Vex was broke, crying, and dead of a heart attack. Beau walked out with the deed to [[Hangman's Ranch]] in one hand and a glass of Widow’s Whiskey in the other. Since then, Beau’s made Hangman’s Ranch into a place of mystique. It ain't the biggest spread in Threshton, but it *feels* like it is. The saloon girls drift in and out of his halls, and the locals whisper tales about what really happens in his smoke-filled parlor. Nobody knows how he keeps his cattle so well-fed while other ranchers starve — some say he’s got deals with the pirates out of [[Rustwater Bay]], or even with [[The Duke’s]] men. Others say he cheats death at the same table he cheated Vex. Beau dresses like a king, even if his boots are scuffed with blood. Emerald coats, ruffled shirts, rings on every finger — it’s all part of the performance. He likes being seen, likes the spotlight. But he’s got that killer instinct under the charm. The man smiles when he talks, even if he’s promising to burn your barn down. The [[Rancher Collective]] sees him as a necessary evil — valuable when negotiating, dangerous when crossed. [[Turner Anderson]] trusts him about as far as he can spit, but damn if Beau ain’t handy at turning the odds. He'll fight if he has to, but he’d rather win with cards or charm. And if he does pull a blade… you won’t see it coming. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Flamboyant and silver-tongued. Loves theatrics, hates boredom, always five steps ahead. Never lets you see the real hand he’s playing. **Vices:** Whiskey, games of chance, beautiful trouble. Lies like he breathes — effortlessly and often. **Abilities:** Master manipulator and world-class gambler. Excellent negotiator and speaker — can talk a guard into dropping his rifle. Skilled with hidden blades and sleight of hand. Knows how to move goods (and secrets) through dangerous territory. **Secrets:** Keeps coded ledgers of every secret deal he's made — including one with a Loyalist Guard captain. Still corresponds with a widow in Gutter Row whose son he once saved — and may have fathered. Believes the Duke’s downfall will be economic, not bloody — and is already moving to profit from it. **Beliefs:** Chaos is a ladder, and he intends to climb. The gods are gamblers, and he’s their favorite piece. Trust is just another currency — and it's always inflating. ## Role In Disgraceland Beau DuNoir is the wildcard of the Rancher Collective — the man who wins wars before the shooting starts. He’s the negotiator, the wheeler-dealer, the man you send when you need a dirty job cleaned up with style. While Turner builds, and Freddy protects, Beau ensures Threshton stays just slippery enough to survive. He’s a snake in a velvet coat — and sometimes, that’s exactly what you need. ## Appearances > - [[Snake Eyes In Threshton]]

186.title: Soria Langston-Clay
186.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Soria Langston-Clay]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":null,"NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_soria.png","religion":"[[Word of the Stillborn Star]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[ASHMOOR]]","territory":"[[Ashmoor]]","district":"[[ASHMOOR#Diamond Valley|Diamond Valley]]","faction":"None","role":"Mayor of [[Ashmoor]]","chapters":[null],"tags":["character","mayor","traitor","stillborn-star","loyalist"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 13:52:42"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_soria.png religion: "[[Word of the Stillborn Star]]" status: Alive location: "[[ASHMOOR]]" territory: "[[Ashmoor]]" district: "[[ASHMOOR#Diamond Valley|Diamond Valley]]" faction: None role: "Mayor of [[Ashmoor]]" chapters: - tags: - character - mayor - traitor - stillborn-star - loyalist --- # SORIA LANGSTON-CLAY > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[soria.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** The Mayor of [[Ashmoor ]] **Alias/Nickname:** The Silk Viper **Home Location:** [[ASHMOOR]] **Public Reputation:** Elegant, Dangerous, Manipulative **Gender:** Female **Spouse:** [[Jacoban Clay]] **Age:** 34 **Height:** 5'9" **Weight:** 130 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 13th of Dusktide, 2152 **Occupation:** Mayor of [[ASHMOOR]] **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** The Duke’s Inner Circle **Known Associates:** **Faith:** [[Word of the Stillborn Star]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“Loyalty is a matter of leverage. Nothing more.”

The only daughter of Threshton's oldest and most revered rancher, [[Harp Langston]], Soria was raised amid grit, cattle, and the stubborn code of rancher pride. But she was never interested in crops or community. She wanted influence — power wrapped in silk, not soil. Years ago, when whispers of rebellion stirred in the fields and ranchers began secretly feeding starving citizens, Soria made a choice. One night, she slipped away and told a group of Loyalist Guards exactly who was involved. It was betrayal. Of blood and home. And it paid off. [[The Duke]], ever hungry for loyalty and leverage, brought her to [[The Silo]]. Soria’s sharp tongue and sharper mind caught his eye. She became his scribe, organizing his affairs, drafting his decrees. Some say she seduced him. Others say she simply outmaneuvered every other vulture in the room. When [[Ashmoor]]’s previous mayor drowned in his own bath under “peculiar circumstances,” The Duke didn’t hesitate. He appointed Soria as mayor — elegant, merciless, and loyal only to herself. She now presides over the wealthiest, most reconstructed part of [[United Tribucia]], where she hosts opulent galas while the rest of the land starves. Her citizens loathe her. The Duke trusts her. And her father — if he's still alive — likely wishes he had strangled her in the crib. ## Personality **Temperament:** Charming, cunning, and quietly venomous. Always composed — never shows anger, only disapproval. **Vices:** Control, vanity, and the thrill of betrayal. Seduction is both a tool and a weapon. **Abilities:** Political maneuvering, manipulation, and flawless rhetoric. She can dismantle a room without raising her voice — or lifting a finger. **Secrets:** Maintains a secret ledger of every bribe, betrayal, and favor owed inside The Silo — including dirt on The Duke himself. She’s preparing for something bigger. **Beliefs:** Power is beauty. Loyalty is transactional. Weakness is a sin. Everyone is replaceable — even blood. ## Role in Disgraceland [[Soria Langston-Clay]] is the ruthless architect of Ashmoor’s political machine. Though she owes her rise to The Duke, her ambitions stretch beyond mere servitude. She embodies everything her father despised — a traitor cloaked in velvet. Her enemies call her poison in perfume. Her allies know better than to call her anything at all. ## Appearances

187.title: Marla Rusk
187.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Marla Rusk]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"player","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_marla.png","religion":"[[Church of the Ember Saint]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[THRESHTON]]","territory":"[[Threshton]]","district":"[[THRESHTON#Split Rest|Split Rest]]","faction":"None","role":"Mayor of [[Threshton]]","chapters":[null],"tags":["character","mayor","threshton","individual","ember-saint"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/09 10:59:35"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: player NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_marla.png religion: "[[Church of the Ember Saint]]" status: Alive location: "[[THRESHTON]]" territory: "[[Threshton]]" district: "[[THRESHTON#Split Rest|Split Rest]]" faction: None role: "Mayor of [[Threshton]]" chapters: - tags: - character - mayor - threshton - individual - ember-saint --- # MARLA RUSK > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[marla.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** The Mayor of Threshton **Alias/Nickname:** The Hog of Threshton **Home Location:** [[THRESHTON]] **Public Reputation:** Gluttonous, Ruthless, Corrupt **Gender:** Female **Spouse:** None **Age:** 36 **Height:** 5'3" **Weight:** 367 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 1st of Searsun. 2150 **Occupation:** Mayor of [[THRESHTON]] **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** Loyal to [[The Duke]] **Known Associates:** None trusted **Faith:** [[Church of the Ember Saint]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“What’s mine is mine. And what’s yours... is mine too, if I want it.”

The farmland of [[Threshton]] was supposed to be the breadbasket of United Tribucia—rolling crops, fat cattle, and grain enough to feed a thousand. Instead, it's a graveyard of hunger, and at the top of the food chain sits Mayor [[Marla Rusk]], bloated and smug, gnawing on roasted drumsticks while her people scrape mold off potato skins. Rusk wasn’t elected. Hell, she wasn’t even picked. She offered herself up to [[The Duke]] as a loyal pair of eyes and ears—specifically aimed at the [[Rancher Collective]]. She promised to keep them in line, expose secret trades, and sniff out disloyalty like a truffle pig. In return, she demanded two things: immunity from oversight, and the right to “reclaim” any food she found. And oh, did she find food. Rusk hoards it all—grain, meat, fresh fruit, pickled goods, root cellars stacked to the rafters in the mayor’s estate while the rest of [[Threshton]] suffers under her rule. Her slaves, the largest number in all of DISGRACELAND, are forced to work her private farms with nothing but thin broth and beatings for fuel. Anyone who questions her gets shackled or disappears into the cornfields. She rules with greed and gossip. No one trusts her, not even The Duke’s other mayors. But she doesn’t need trust. She’s useful. She watches the ranchers—especially [[Turner Anderson]] and [[Freddy Blanchard]], who she resents deeply. She keeps a ledger of what goes in and out of every farm, tracking everything like a bloated tax hawk. If someone’s feeding citizens under the table, Rusk finds out. Her mansion, the Gullet House, is a grotesque palace of overindulgence. Roasting pits run day and night. Servants fan her while she eats. Pigs are fattened, then killed for entertainment. She throws Feast Nights where Loyalist guests watch slaves fight for scraps while Rusk laughs with a turkey leg in each hand. But the land remembers. And so do the people. And if hunger doesn’t kill her, rage might. ## Personality **Temperament:** Boastful, petty, and dangerously paranoid. Quick to punish, quicker to indulge. **Vices:** Gluttony, greed, voyeurism. Addicted to power and full plates. **Abilities:** Obsessive recordkeeping, cruel manipulation, political blackmail. She knows what everyone eats and who fed them. **Secrets:** Keeps secret trade records on every rancher, including past betrayals by [[Soria Langston-Clay]]. May have poisoned a Rancher Collective member years ago to earn her spot. **Beliefs:** Hunger is control. Everything can be owned. Generosity is treason. ## Role in Disgraceland [[Marla Rusk]] rules [[Threshton]] with a stomach full of stolen grain and an ego too fat to fail. Her value to The Duke lies in her ability to track every seed and slaughter—no matter how small. But her reign isn’t built to last. If the people ever rise, she’ll be the first to fall. ## Appearances

188.title: Gorren Brile
188.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Gorren Brile]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"player","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_gorren.png","religion":"[[Word of the Stillborn Star]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[CHARSPIRE]]","territory":"[[CHARSPIRE]]","district":"[[CHARSPIRE#Burnt Coast|Burnt Coast]]","faction":"None","role":"Mayor of [[Charspire]]","chapters":[null],"tags":["character","mayor","charspire","individual","none"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 13:52:22"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: player NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_gorren.png religion: "[[Word of the Stillborn Star]]" status: Alive location: "[[CHARSPIRE]]" territory: "[[CHARSPIRE]]" district: "[[CHARSPIRE#Burnt Coast|Burnt Coast]]" faction: None role: "Mayor of [[Charspire]]" chapters: - tags: - character - mayor - charspire - individual - none --- # GORREN BRILE > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[gorren.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** The Mayor of Charspire **Alias/Nickname:** The Gut of Charspire **Home Location:** [[CHARSPIRE]] **Public Reputation:** Corrupt, Cruel, Unmovable **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** 43 **Height:** 5'4" **Weight:** 276 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 21st of Rainsun, 2143 **Occupation:** Mayor of [[CHARSPIRE]] **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[RedForce]], [[The Duke of Disgraceland]] **Known Associates:** [[Cricket Granger]], [[Marco Murray]], [[Francis Murray]], [[Nico Murray]], **Faith:** [[Word of the Stillborn Star]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“Hope don’t run a furnace. Fear does.”

In the smog-strangled hellscape of [[Charspire]], where molten runoff glows in the gutters and the air tastes like burning metal, Mayor [[Gorren Brile]] sits fat and content atop a mountain of suffering he helped build. He didn’t rise to power through merit. He slithered his way into it—feeding [[The Duke]] a steady diet of intelligence pulled from the slums, the mills, and the whispers of the desperate. For years, Brile was a name no one said out loud, just a shadow that passed coin for secrets and disappeared before the screaming started. When the old foreman-mayor “vanished” during a boiler explosion, Brile was already waiting in a fresh suit with a new title. Now, as Duke-appointed mayor, he oversees [[Charspire]] with bloated arrogance, a snake-headed cane in one hand and a smoldering cigar in the other. He keeps the mines running, the mills churning, and the death toll climbing. But it’s not Brile himself that people fear. It’s his [[RedForce]]. A handpicked squad of bruisers, burnouts, and sadists in blood-red armor—the RedForce are more gang than guard. Bankrolled by the Loyalist Guard, they wear dark leather dusters with crimson plates over their chests, and helmets shaped like steel-welded frowns. Their job is simple: enforce, extract, erase. They drag "disloyal" workers into the streets and make examples of them. They storm homes in the middle of the night. They torture rebels in boiler rooms and chain corpses to smokestacks as warnings. The RedForce doesn’t arrest. They punish. Brile watches it all from his brass office above the slagfields—pockets lined, trousers stained, and ego swollen. He makes regular visits to [[GUTTER ROW]], always under heavy escort, to indulge in the red-light vices with sickening pride. His appetites are legendary, and his reputation just as filthy. No one loves Mayor Gorren Brile. But no one dares remove him either. Not yet. Because in Charspire, fear still outvotes hope. ## Personality **Temperament:** Lecherous, loud, and quick to anger. Treats fear like applause. **Vices:** Sex, violence, gluttony, cruelty. Keeps a collection of gold rings he’s taken off corpses. **Abilities:** Bribery, blackmail, and brutal intimidation. Doesn’t need to be smart—just needs to know who to break. **Secrets:** Keeps a hidden tunnel from his office to a Gutter Row brothel. Maintains secret recordings of Duke meetings for leverage. Claims to have dirt on every other mayor. **Beliefs:** Fear gets results. Loyalty is a lie people tell to stay alive. The strong survive, the useful thrive, and the rest burn. ## Role in Disgraceland [[Gorren Brile]] rules [[Charspire]] with bloated pride and violent indulgence, relying on the infamous [[RedForce]] to crush opposition before it can breathe. He is everything wrong with the industrial world made flesh—a greedy pig wrapped in silk and soot. But The Duke needs his brutality, and the factories need to run, so Brile stays in power… for now. ## Appearances

189.title: Ellis Westmount
189.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Ellis Westmount]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"player","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_ellis.png","religion":"[[El Santo]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[STEELTOWN]]","territory":"[[Steeltown]]","district":"[[Steeltown#Barton|Barton]]","faction":"None","role":"Mayor of [[Steeltown]]","chapters":[null],"tags":["character","neutral","mayor","steeltown","el-santo"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 13:52:11"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: player NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_ellis.png religion: "[[El Santo]]" status: Alive location: "[[STEELTOWN]]" territory: "[[Steeltown]]" district: "[[Steeltown#Barton|Barton]]" faction: None role: "Mayor of [[Steeltown]]" chapters: - tags: - character - neutral - mayor - steeltown - el-santo --- # ELLIS WESTMOUNT > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[ellis.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** The Mayor of Steeltown **Alias/Nickname:** Mayor Westmount **Home Location:** [[STEELTOWN]] **Public Reputation:** Firm, Tough, Intimidating **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** **Age:** 52 **Height:** 6'2" **Weight:** 198 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 2nd of Frozensun, 2134 **Occupation:** Mayor of [[STEELTOWN]] **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** None **Known Associates:** [[Turner Anderson]] **Faith:** [[El Santo]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“They don’t have to love me. Just fear me enough not to act.”

Once a union-buster, always a traitor. Ellis Westmount was a corporate enforcer before the bombs ever dropped—a man who made his fortune breaking the backs of blue-collar workers while pretending to protect them. When the men and women of Steeltown tried to reclaim their future by unionizing the steel plants, Westmount sold them out to the Loyalist Guard before the ink was even dry on their demands. The Duke rewarded him with the mayorship like a dog gets a bone for baring its teeth. Now Ellis runs Steeltown from behind iron walls and the barrels of Loyalist rifles. He wears a three-piece suit like he’s above the soot, but the people know better. He’s hated. Not disliked. Not distrusted. Hated. He can’t walk through Steeltown without a wall of bodyguards. Most days, he doesn’t try. He rules through surveillance, propaganda, and brute force. The factories run day and night, and anyone caught whispering the word “strike” ends up in the Blacksmoke Tunnels beneath the plant—if they’re lucky. But Ellis doesn’t care if they like him. He cares about results. About being feared. And in a town built on sweat and fire, fear is the only currency he trusts. The former mayor was killed in a riot following the death of a Wrecking Crew member, and deep down Westmount knows he’s sharing power in this city with the Wrecking Crew whether he likes it or not.** ## Personality **Temperament:** Ruthless, calculating, and cold. Never raises his voice—he doesn't need to. Every word is a threat. **Vices:** Power addiction, sadism, and a deep contempt for the working class. Drinks privately but never shows weakness in public. **Abilities:** Master manipulator and tactician. Expert in surveillance, psychological warfare, and crushing dissent before it takes root. He doesn’t fight himself—but he always knows who will. **Secrets:** Still receives direct orders from The Duke through an encrypted comms line—something even the Loyalist Guard captains aren’t aware of. Also keeps files on every Wrecking Crew member, waiting for the moment he can move against them. **Beliefs:** Order is worth more than freedom. Fear keeps people alive. Loyalty is earned through domination, not trust. ## Role in Disgraceland Ellis Westmount rules [[Steeltown]] with an iron grip, installed by [[The Duke]] after selling out the city’s workers during the last days of the steel unions. Though he holds the mayor’s title, real power is contested—[[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]] looms large, and Westmount knows any wrong move could turn the city against him overnight. He’s the face of oppression in a city built on rebellion. ## Appearances

190.title: Cricket Granger
190.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Cricket Granger]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":"player","NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_cricket.png","religion":"none","status":"Alive","location":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","territory":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","district":"[[GUTTER ROW#Crossyork|Crossyork]]","faction":"None","role":"Mayor of [[Gutter Row]]","chapters":[null],"tags":["character","mayor","individual","none"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 13:51:56"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: player NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_cricket.png religion: none status: Alive location: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" territory: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" district: "[[GUTTER ROW#Crossyork|Crossyork]]" faction: None role: "Mayor of [[Gutter Row]]" chapters: - tags: - character - mayor - individual - none --- # CRICKET GRANGER > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[cricket.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** The Mayor of [[Gutter Row]] **Alias/Nickname:** The Rat King **Home Location:** [[GUTTER ROW]] **Public Reputation:** Perverse, Untouchable, Unsettling **Gender:** Male (fluid presentation) **Spouse:** None **Age:** 47 **Height:** 5'10" **Weight:** 142 lbs. **Date of Birth:** **Occupation:** Mayor of [[GUTTER ROW]] **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** Unknown—claims none **Known Associates:** Various brothel owners, blackmail victims **Faith:** None **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“The difference between a secret and a weapon is what I’m willing to do with it.”

Nobody voted for [[Cricket Granger]]. Hell, most folks in [[GUTTER ROW]] didn’t even know he was a candidate. One day, he was just there—lounging in the velvet chair behind the mayor’s desk, drink in one hand, bruised lipstick on his neck, smiling like a cat in a slaughterhouse. People whisper he caught [[The Duke]] of Disgraceland in a compromising position deep in the red-lit halls of Gutter Row years ago. A drunken night, a wrong room, maybe a lover with the wrong kind of secrets. And Cricket? He kept the receipt. Blackmail? Leverage? Who knows. What’s certain is this: no one touches Cricket Granger. Now he’s the Mayor of Gutter Row, and his "office" is the most depraved whorehouse in [[DISGRACELAND]]. He doesn’t hide it. He flaunts it. His estate is a den of velvet couches, incense smoke, and moaning voices behind silk curtains. The place stinks of perfume, sweat, and something darker. Sex work isn’t just permitted in [[GUTTER ROW]]—it’s government-funded. Everyone knows if you walk into the mayor’s estate, you’re not there for permits. Granger’s tastes are limitless and lawless. Men, women, non-binary, twins, masked figures, chained lovers—he’s seen it all, done most of it, and talks about it like he’s sharing tea. He’ll shake your hand with the same fingers that were inside someone fifteen minutes earlier and never break eye contact. But he’s not just a pervert. He’s a survivor. [[Cricket Granger]] knows everything. Every secret, every kink, every betrayal. He’s got dirt on guards, soldiers, mayors, ranchers—hell, maybe even the [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]. He doesn’t need a militia. He’s got blackmail and blowjobs as weapons. He runs [[GUTTER ROW]] not by force, but through deals, favors, and fear of exposure. Criminals leave him alone. So do Loyalists. Even [[Gorren Brile]] steps carefully when he visits the Row, watching the shadows, knowing Cricket might’ve seen him beg once. And through it all, Granger smiles—like he’s always two steps ahead, like he’s already imagining how you’ll look naked and crying. But even rats drown when the sewer floods. And in [[GUTTER ROW]], storm clouds are gathering. ## Personality **Temperament:** Playful, filthy, always smiling. Switches from charming to chilling in a heartbeat. **Vices:** Every single one. Carnal, chemical, emotional, power-based—you name it. **Abilities:** Blackmail, seduction, disguise, infiltration. Cricket is an information hoarder with no shame and no limits. **Secrets:** Keeps encrypted recordings of every major figure in [[DISGRACELAND]], including potentially damning footage of The Duke. Has a hidden exit under his brothel that leads to the sewers. **Beliefs:** Control isn’t taken—it’s leaked. Everyone has a weakness. The trick is loving yours before someone else does. ## Role in Disgraceland [[Cricket Granger]] is the unholy pulse of [[GUTTER ROW]]—a creature of filth, lust, and secrets. He thrives in corruption and trades in vulnerability. He may not have the army others do, but he holds their futures in his fingers. And one day, he just might squeeze.

191.title: Nico Murray
191.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Nico Murray]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":null,"NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_nico.png","religion":"[[Church of the Ember Saint]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","territory":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","district":"[[GUTTER ROW#Vileby|Vileby]]","faction":"[[Murray Boys]]","role":"[[Marco Murray]]'s Son","chapters":["04 - Glowing Darkness","05 - Sight Unseen"],"tags":["character","antagonist","murray","chapter04"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 13:53:52"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_nico.png religion: "[[Church of the Ember Saint]]" status: Alive location: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" territory: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" district: "[[GUTTER ROW#Vileby|Vileby]]" faction: "[[Murray Boys]]" role: "[[Marco Murray]]'s Son" chapters: - 04 - Glowing Darkness - 05 - Sight Unseen tags: - character - antagonist - murray - chapter04 --- # NICO MURRAY > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[nico.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** **Alias/Nickname:** The Little Prince **Home Location:** Vileby, [[Gutter Row]] **Public Reputation:** Annoying **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** **Age:** 19 **Height:** 6'2" **Weight:** 184 lbs. **Date of Birth:** April 24th, 2167 **Occupation:** **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Murray Boys]] **Known Associates:** [[Marco Murray]], [[Rosa Murray]], [[Francis Murray]] **Faith:** [[Church of the Ember Saint]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“Relax. You really think anything bad could happen to a Murray?”

Nico Murray grew up wanting for nothing, the only child of [[Marco Murray|Marco]] and [[Rosa Murray|Rosa]]. With two powerful parents and a taste for the high life, Nico has never known the struggle that shaped his family. He was sent to the best schools, always had the best clothes, and never missed a party worth being seen at. Spoiled by luxury and cushioned from real danger, Nico’s world is flashy—filled with expensive watches, fast rides, and the kind of trouble you can usually buy your way out of. Cocky, charming, and quick with a joke, Nico has always thought of himself as untouchable—a prince of Disgraceland’s underworld, even if he’s just started learning what that actually means. Recently, though, cracks have started to show in his golden world. Nico’s parents are slowly letting him in on the family business. He likes the taste of power, but he still treats it like a game—more interested in the thrill and attention than the danger. He boasts about things he barely understands, flirts with anyone who’ll listen, and imagines himself as the future king—even as the real wolves circle closer than he realizes. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Brash, overconfident, and witty. He’s quick to charm and quicker to show off, but deep down he’s still just a kid, a little in over his head. **Vices:** Fast cars, women, gambling, and living above his means. Nico loves being the center of attention, even when it gets him in trouble. **Abilities:** Naturally charismatic, street-smart (to a point), and good at talking himself out of trouble. He can be clever and resourceful when he has to be, but hasn’t faced any real consequences—yet. **Secrets:** Nico’s started to notice the danger his parents face, and sometimes wishes he could walk away. He keeps a stash of cash and an old revolver hidden in his room—just in case. He’s already made promises to a rival gang, thinking he can play both sides. **Beliefs:** He thinks he’s invincible, believes he’s destined for greatness, and has a soft spot for his mother, though he hides it under bravado. ## Role In Disgraceland Nico is the cocky heir apparent of the [[Murray Boys]], strutting through [[Gutter Row]] and [[Charspire]] like he owns the place—protected by his last name, but dangerously unaware of how quickly fortunes change in Disgraceland.

192.title: Rosa Murray
192.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Rosa Murray]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":null,"NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_rosa.png","religion":"[[Church of the Ember Saint]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","territory":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","district":"[[GUTTER ROW#Vileby|Vileby]]","faction":"[[Murray Boys]]","role":"[[Marco Murray]]'s Wife, [[Jimmy Douglass]]'s ex","chapters":["04 - Glowing Darkness"],"tags":["character","antagonist","murray","chapter04"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 13:54:18"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_rosa.png religion: "[[Church of the Ember Saint]]" status: Alive location: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" territory: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" district: "[[GUTTER ROW#Vileby|Vileby]]" faction: "[[Murray Boys]]" role: "[[Marco Murray]]'s Wife, [[Jimmy Douglass]]'s ex" chapters: - 04 - Glowing Darkness tags: - character - antagonist - murray - chapter04 --- # ROSA MURRAY > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[rosa.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Treasurer in the [[Murray Boys]] **Alias/Nickname:** The Enforcer **Home Location:** Vileby, [[Gutter Row]] **Public Reputation:** Cougar **Gender:** Female **Spouse:** [[Marco Murray]] **Age:** 39 **Height:** 5'7" **Weight:** 131 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 19th of Greensun, 2141 **Occupation:** Treasurer for the Murray Boys **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Murray Boys]] **Known Associates:** [[Marco Murray]], [[Jimmy Douglass]], [[Gorren Brile]], [[Cricket Granger]], [[Jacoban Clay]], [[Soria Langston-Clay]] **Faith:** [[Church of the Ember Saint]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“Men start fires. Women decide who gets burned.”

Rosa grew up on the tough streets of [[Steeltown]], the daughter of a steelworker and a mother who ruled the house with iron discipline. She learned to hold her own early—fighting with boys, taking dares, and running wild with her neighborhood crew. [[Jimmy Douglass]] was one of those kids—her first crush, her first fistfight, maybe even her first real heartbreak. When her family moved to [[Charspire]] at sixteen so her father could work the mines, Rosa had to start over. Charspire was meaner, colder, but Rosa was tougher. She waited tables, hustled, and quickly learned the rules of survival. That’s when she met [[Marco Murray]]—older, sharp, protective, and with a loneliness that matched her own. They married within a year. Sixteen years later, Rosa isn’t just Marco’s wife—she’s his most trusted partner and the backbone of the [[Murray Boys]]. She handles the books, smooths over deals, keeps the officials happy, and makes sure nobody in the crew gets sloppy. She knows where every slug is hidden and isn’t afraid to put someone in their place—politely, or not. Rosa is fiercely loyal to Marco, but there’s still a little corner of her heart reserved for memories of [[Jimmy Douglass]]. Old letters, faded photos, and silent “what ifs” she’ll never speak aloud. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Confident, poised, and unflappable. Rosa has nerves of steel and a razor-sharp tongue when needed. She’s warm and protective with her family, but icy and formidable when the business calls for it. **Vices:** Red wine, classic soul records, and the thrill of keeping secrets. She loves expensive shoes and occasionally bets big at the tables—she always bets on herself. **Abilities:** Expert with numbers, master at reading people, and has an instinct for danger. Rosa can bluff her way through any situation, and nobody’s ever caught her in a lie. **Secrets:** She keeps an old photograph of her and [[Jimmy Douglass]] tucked away. Sometimes she discreetly tips Jimmy off if it won’t put Marco at risk. She’s also stashing money on the side—just in case she ever needs a quick exit. **Beliefs:** Family comes first. Loyalty is earned, every single day. Never let anyone see you bleed. ## Role In Disgraceland Rosa Murray is the [[Murray Boys]]’ silent power—everyone who matters knows she’s the one who keeps the operation smooth, the books clean, and the local politicians loyal. She’s the calm in the storm and the last word in any crisis.

193.title: Marco Murray
193.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Marco Murray]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":null,"NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_marco.png","religion":"[[Church of the Ember Saint]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","territory":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","district":"[[GUTTER ROW#Vileby|Vileby]]","faction":"[[Murray Boys]]","role":"Don of the [[Murray Boys]]","chapters":["04 - Glowing Darkness"],"tags":["character","antagonist","murray","chapter04"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:06","modified":"2025/06/05 17:07:55"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_marco.png religion: "[[Church of the Ember Saint]]" status: Alive location: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" territory: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" district: "[[GUTTER ROW#Vileby|Vileby]]" faction: "[[Murray Boys]]" role: "Don of the [[Murray Boys]]" chapters: - 04 - Glowing Darkness tags: - character - antagonist - murray - chapter04 --- # MARCO MURRAY > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[marco.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Don of the [[Murray Boys]] Crime Family **Alias/Nickname:** The Don Mega **Home Location:** Vileby, [[Gutter Row]] **Public Reputation:** Feared **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** [[Rosa Murray]] **Age:** 52 **Height:** 6'0" **Weight:** 264 lbs. **Date of Birth:** August 11th, 2134 **Occupation:** Head of the Murray Boys, Drug runner **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Murray Boys]] **Known Associates:** Francis Murray, [[Gorren Brile]], [[Cricket Granger]] **Faith:** [[Church of the Ember Saint]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“People talk about luck, but luck’s just a knife in your back waiting for you to turn around. I make my own chances.”

Marco Murray grew up fast and hard in the alleys of [[Gutter Row]]. Orphaned before he hit his teens, Marco did whatever it took to keep his younger brother alive—odd jobs, hustling, petty theft, never trusting the system that chewed up his parents and spat out their bones. [[Gutter Row]]’s filth and violence became his school. Marco learned to keep his head down, keep his hands quick, and never, ever let the [[Loyalist Guard#Blackforce|Blackforce]] get close. As a young man, Marco found his true calling in the city’s shadows. The Luxyn trade started small—just a way to put food on the table, a little light in the dark. But Marco had a knack for reading people, for sniffing out opportunities and weaknesses. In time, what began as survival turned into a business. He brought his brother Francis in when the money got too heavy for one man to carry. The Murray Boys ran their outfit smart: low profile, high profit, never greedy enough to get noticed by the big players—until Mayor [[Cricket Granger]] caught wind. Instead of a death sentence, it turned into the deal of Marco’s life. With Granger as silent partner, Marco could scale up, spreading Luxyn across [[Gutter Row]] and beyond, laundering slugs into legitimate fronts. When Granger joined forces with Brile in [[Charspire]], Marco adapted again, managing supply lines between mines and streets with the kind of precision that made even the Loyalist Guards look clumsy. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Cautious, coldly logical, and slow to trust. Marco is patient and deliberate, rarely showing anger or excitement. He speaks little but always listens—calculating the angles before making any move. He treats loyalty like gold and betrayal like a death sentence. **Vices:** Cigars, expensive liquor, and the illusion of control. Marco doesn’t touch his own product but spends big to look the part. His real addiction is power and the quiet thrill of beating the odds. **Abilities:** Master manipulator, sharp negotiator, and ruthless tactician. He’s an expert at staying invisible—never leaves a trail, never loses his temper. Runs a tight crew and inspires absolute loyalty or total fear. **Secrets:** Marco still hides money and a false identity, just in case he needs to disappear. He keeps a list of everyone who’s ever crossed him. He knows about Granger’s secret dealings with Brile before anyone else did—and quietly keeps leverage on both men. **Beliefs:** He believes family comes first, no matter the cost. The world is a cruel place, and only the smart, careful, and loyal survive. Trust is a weapon, and hope is a weakness. ## Role In Disgraceland Marco Murray is the true face behind [[Gutter Row]]’s drug trade and the [[Murray Boys]]’ growing empire. He operates in the shadows, never flaunting his power but pulling strings that reach from the darkest alleys to the mayors’ offices. No one moves Luxyn in [[Gutter Row]] or [[Charspire]] without his blessing—and everyone knows it.

194.title: Francis Murray
194.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Francis Murray]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":null,"NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_francis.png","religion":"[[Church of the Ember Saint]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","territory":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","district":"[[GUTTER ROW#Vileby|Vileby]]","faction":"[[Murray Boys]]","role":"Enforcer in the [[Murray Boys]]","chapters":[null],"tags":["character","antagonist","murray"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:06","modified":"2025/06/03 13:53:03"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_francis.png religion: "[[Church of the Ember Saint]]" status: Alive location: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" territory: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" district: "[[GUTTER ROW#Vileby|Vileby]]" faction: "[[Murray Boys]]" role: "Enforcer in the [[Murray Boys]]" chapters: - tags: - character - antagonist - murray --- # FRANCIS MURRAY > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[francis.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Enforcer in the [[Murray Boys]] **Alias/Nickname:** The Enforcer **Home Location:** Vileby, [[Gutter Row]] **Public Reputation:** Feared **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** **Age:** 46 **Height:** 5'10" **Weight:** 251 lbs. **Date of Birth:** May 19th, 2141 **Occupation:** Enforcer of the Murray Boys, Drug runner **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Murray Boys]] **Known Associates:** [[Marco Murray]], [[Gorren Brile]], [[Cricket Granger]], [[Jacoban Clay]], [[Soria Langston-Clay]] **Faith:** [[Church of the Ember Saint]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“Some folks hustle to survive. Me and Marco? We hustle so we don’t have to anymore.”

Francis Murray owes everything to his brother Marco—and he knows it. Marco shielded Francis from the worst of Gutter Row, scraping together enough to keep him clothed, fed, and (mostly) safe. Where Marco learned survival in the gutter, Francis got a taste of ambition. As a teenager, Francis went straight, working the floor at Clay Millwrights in Charspire, where his sharp mind and quick charm caught the eye of Jacoban Clay himself. Francis rose through the ranks fast, becoming plant manager by his late twenties. He learned the art of management, the politics of the factory floor, and how to get what he wanted without making enemies. But blood is blood—when Marco’s side business ballooned into a criminal empire, Francis walked away from the Millwrights without a word, throwing his loyalty and skills behind his brother. Francis now handles the front-facing side of the Murray Boys: laundering money, striking deals, and keeping the operation just legit enough to keep the guards off their backs. He still meets Jacoban Clay for drinks every month, spinning stories about side businesses and investments—never once letting slip that he and Marco are the men behind Luxyn. For Francis, friendship is sacred, but family is absolute. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Smooth, charming, and socially gifted. Francis is diplomatic, a natural schmoozer who can talk his way out of trouble or into any boardroom. He’s fiercely loyal to Marco but doesn’t let that make him naive—he’s learned to read a room and strike first when necessary. **Vices:** Gambling, expensive suits, and a taste for high-stakes risk. Francis loves the thrill of outmaneuvering competitors. He drinks too much and sleeps around, but keeps these out of the business. **Abilities:** Expert negotiator, accomplished liar, and financial whiz. Francis is the public face of the Murray Boys, keeping books clean, fronts legal, and guards distracted. He’s also well-connected in Charspire’s industrial circles. **Secrets:** Francis has a private fund stashed in case the business ever collapses. He still feels guilty for leaving Clay Millwrights, especially knowing how much Jacoban trusted him. He’s also quietly tracked down their parents’ killer, but keeps it to himself. **Beliefs:** Francis believes loyalty is everything—first to Marco, then to those who’ve earned his trust. He sees Disgraceland as a rigged game but believes he and Marco can beat it if they stick together and play smart. ## Role In Disgraceland Francis Murray is the Murray Boys’ clean face and chief operator, running their finances, fronts, and public affairs from Charspire. His charm and connections allow the Murray Boys to expand without drawing heat—unless you cross him, in which case the charm vanishes and you’re left dealing with Marco. ## Appearances

Broadcasting throughout Disgraceland 5 night a week, Scottyard is a popular figure around Tribucia. faction: None role: Anchor of [[TTV Evening News]] chapters: - tags: - character - individual - protagonist - news --- # WARREN SCOTTYARD > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[ws.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** **Alias/Nickname:** **Home Location:** [[ASHMOOR]] **Public Reputation:** Popular **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** 39 **Height:** 6'0" **Weight:** 177 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 22nd of Embersun, 2147 **Occupation:** Anchor of the [[TTV Evening News]] **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** **Known Associates:** [[Jacoban Clay]],[[ Morris Gable]] **Faith:** [[Word of the Stillborn Star]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

"Truth is like a fine suit. It’s not about what fits — it’s about what sells."

[[Warren Scottyard]] is the dashing, immaculately-groomed anchor of the _TTV Evening News_, the state-approved nightly broadcast in United Tribucia. With his rich, velvety voice and perfect hairline, he brings calm to the chaos with every segment, summarizing war, disaster, and civil unrest with an easy charisma that leaves viewers oddly reassured. He was personally handpicked by [[The Duke]] after a private audition in The Silo — a meeting shrouded in speculation, but one that sealed Warren’s rise as the most trusted voice in the nation. Since then, he’s become a nightly presence in every home, even in the poorest districts where static-riddled broadcasts are the only source of light. Born in the ashes of post-Tetra Ashmoor to an affluent family of land surveyors and property speculators, Warren rose through the ranks of TTV faster than most, thanks in part to his social circle. He’s a familiar face at high-society galas, private club dinners, and those strange elite functions where the wine flows endlessly and nothing is ever spoken of afterward. He resides in a pristine estate in **Diamond Valley**, rubbing shoulders with the ruling class. Despite his comfort and elite status, the public oddly still likes him — or maybe they’re just hypnotized by that voice. Warren is close with [[Morris Gable]], and the two men are often seen together at exclusive functions or caught whispering just before air. He also shares a business-minded camaraderie with [[Jacoban Clay]], occasionally hosting “special interest” segments that just so happen to feature Clay Industries or Loyalist initiatives in a glowing light. ## Personality **Temperament:** Smooth, diplomatic, and unfailingly composed. Warren rarely loses his cool and has mastered the art of being both likable and untouchable. He knows how to make someone feel seen while revealing nothing about himself. **Vices:** Fine scotch, vanity, and a quiet but enduring addiction to influence. He collects rare books, not to read them, but to impress the kind of guests who would notice. **Abilities:** Expert orator with hypnotic tone and perfect timing. Political survivalist — always knows the safest stance. Deep connections in TTV, Ashmoor politics, and the elite power web. **Secrets:** He once broadcast a heavily edited report that led to a militia being wiped out in Threshton. He knew it would happen. He keeps a burner radio tuned to the pirate frequency of [[The Blackwire]], claiming it’s “for awareness.” He’s heard messages that rattled him. Occasionally slips messages into broadcasts — invisible to the masses, but encoded for someone. **Beliefs:** Warren believes in control, in order, in the power of image. He doesn’t care who rules, so long as the lights stay on and the cameras stay rolling. Public emotion is something to be managed, like weather or traffic. ## Role In Disgraceland The perfectly-groomed public face of Loyalist truth and civility. He soothes the citizens, comforts the regime, and keeps the blood off the news desk.

196.title: Tyren Will
196.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Tyren Will]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":null,"NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_tw.png","religion":"[[Word of the Stillborn Star]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[Gutter Row]]","faction":"None","role":"Owner of the [[Ha Ha Hole]]","chapters":[null],"tags":["character","individual","protagonist","stillborn-star"],"created":"2025/05/28 11:19:41","modified":"2025/06/03 11:03:44"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_tw.png religion: "[[Word of the Stillborn Star]]" status: Alive location: "[[Gutter Row]]" faction: None role: "Owner of the [[Ha Ha Hole]]" chapters: - tags: - character - individual - protagonist - stillborn-star --- # TYREN WILL > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[tyren.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Owner of the [[Ha Ha Hole]] **Alias/Nickname:** **Home Location:** [[Gutter Row]] **Public Reputation:** Eccentric, Beloved **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** 67 **Height:** 5'8" **Weight:** 152 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 28th of Greensun, 2119 **Occupation:** Prison Warden **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** None **Known Associates:** **Faith:** [[Word of the Stillborn Star]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“I’ve been kissed by kings and slapped by cowards, but nobody ever left this club without feeling something. That’s power, darling, and it scares the hell outta tyrants.”

[[Tyren Will]] is the legendary founder and master of ceremonies at the infamous [[Ha Ha Hole]] comedy club in Savage Hill, [[Gutter Row]]. A towering, slender man with wild white hair and a knack for showmanship, he’s a local hero and cultural icon, often described as the heart of Gutter Row’s spirit. He opened the club back in the 2140s as a defiant beacon of free expression when laughter itself had become rare. Now almost 70 years old, [[Tyren Will]] remains as sharp as ever, always perched at the bar in his signature robe with a cigarette burning between his fingers, watching the next generation of comics take the stage. He refuses to leave the club even during violent crackdowns in Gutter Row. His presence is a statement. His laughter — shrill and contagious — still commands the room. Though [[The Duke]] despises him and what the club represents, he dares not move against Tyren or the [[Ha Ha Hole]]. To do so would risk open revolt in the district. Despite persistent rumors about his sexuality, Tyren brushes off questions with a sly grin, often quipping that his “one true love is the punchline.” Whether he’s a relic from a forgotten era or the soul of Gutter Row made flesh depends on who you ask — but no one denies his impact. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Playful but unshakably principled. Tyren is theatrical, sharp-tongued, and endlessly curious, with an almost mystical calm beneath his flamboyant surface. He’s kind to underdogs, merciless to bigots, and impossible to intimidate. **Vices:** Chain-smokes unfiltered cigarettes. Addicted to performance — can’t stand silence. Has a habit of goading Loyalist officials just to see how far he can push them **Abilities:** Masterful orator and crowd manipulator. Encyclopedic memory of jokes, stories, and underground history. Has deep connections to black market information networks (disguised as comedy bookings) **Secrets:** Once had a clandestine romantic relationship with a Loyalist officer who later disappeared **Beliefs:** Comedy is the last weapon of the free. ## Role In Disgraceland [[Tyren Will]] serves as the living pulse of rebellion in Gutter Row. Through the Ha Ha Hole, he nurtures subversive thought disguised as entertainment. He is proof that resistance doesn’t always come with a gun — sometimes it walks on stage in a robe and goggles and tells a dirty joke. ## Appearances

197.title: The Grim Man
197.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[The Grim Man]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":null,"NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_grim.png","religion":"None","status":"Alive","location":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","territory":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","district":"[[GUTTER ROW#Vileby|Vileby]]","faction":"None","role":"Vigilante Hero","chapters":["03 - The Devil In The Row"],"tags":["character","individual","protagonist","chapter03"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 11:03:31"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_grim.png religion: None status: Alive location: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" territory: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" district: "[[GUTTER ROW#Vileby|Vileby]]" faction: None role: Vigilante Hero chapters: - 03 - The Devil In The Row tags: - character - individual - protagonist - chapter03 --- # GRIM MAN > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[grim.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** The Grim Man **Alias/Nickname:** The Dark Angel **Home Location:** [[GUTTER ROW]] but appears all over Disgraceland **Public Reputation:** A vigilante hero **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** Unknown **Height:** 6'2" **Weight:** 207 lbs. **Date of Birth:** Unknown **Occupation:** Assassin, Vigilante **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** None **Known Associates:** Unknown **Faith:** None **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

"If you hear the chain, it’s too late." — overheard in the tunnels beneath Gutter Row

The boy had no name by the time the fire took everything. The [[Loyalist Guard]] stormed through [[Steeltown]] Sector 9 just before dawn, enforcing a tax no one could pay and silencing mouths that asked why. His father tried to fight — with a rusted hammer and bad knees. His mother screamed as they were dragged into the street. His little sister never made it out of the crawlspace. He hid under the porch, face pressed to ash, listening to the house burn. Listening to the boots. The silence. The laughter. When it was over, he climbed into the wreckage and found his sister’s doll, blackened but still intact. He didn’t cry. There was no time for grief in Disgraceland. The next week was snow and blood and starvation. He wandered south — limping, fevered — until the city changed around him. Until the buildings sagged lower, and the smoke smelled different, more alive. Until people stopped looking him in the eye. That’s when he crossed into [[Gutter Row]]. [[Gutter Row]] didn’t offer sanctuary. Just indifference. He slept in the sewers beneath the [[Three Nail Market]], where black market traders sold flesh and fungus in equal measure. He learned the alleys. Learned the language. Watched how a man could get stabbed, stripped, and forgotten in under a minute — and how no one would say a thing. He spoke to no one. He simply watched. Waited. Collected every scream, every kick, every whisper behind the slave cages and drug dens. And then, one night, a chain went missing from a slaughterhouse. A spike followed, torn from the center of a disassembled meat press. The next night, a slaver known for collecting children turned up outside the Glassneedle Bar, hanging from a pipe, his tongue nailed to his chest with a spike driven through his ribs. The doll — the same scorched doll — was tied to his belt. That’s when the tapping began. You hear it before you see him. Tap. Tap. Tap. The end of the chain dragging over stone. A signal. A warning. A countdown. He moves like smoke — slow until it’s too late. Appearing in doorways, behind dumpsters, beneath subway grates. Some say he walks through walls. Others say he becomes the wall. He never speaks. Never. But the blood tells stories. He kills without hesitation — rapists, slavers, gang enforcers, crooked guards. Always the worst. Always the ones who thought the Row had forgotten them. The people of Gutter Row don’t call him a hero. They just say, “The Grim Man walks.” He’s their shadow. Their reckoning. Their nightmare that protects them from worse. The Loyalists claim he’s an urban legend, a scare tactic, propaganda. But they still don’t patrol Gutter Row at night. Not alone. And though his chain was born in the blood of the Row, his ghost walks far. They say he’s been seen in Threshton, in the fields behind the Red Night Ranch. In the smoke stacks of Charspire. Even once — once — outside the gates of The Silo. The Grim Man doesn’t care where you sin. Only that you did.** --- ## Personality > [!infobox] > > ![[grimbrile.png|260]] **Temperament:** Silent. Calculated. Unforgiving. He does not react — he decides. There is no negotiation, no rage, no mercy. He doesn’t kill in anger — he kills like it’s a ritual. **Vices:** None known. Doesn't drink, smoke, or speak. May not even sleep. If pain is a vice, he carries it like armor. **Abilities:** Stealth bordering on supernatural — moves without sound when he chooses. Master of improvised weapons, particularly chain-and-spike. Expert in urban terrain: alleys, sewers, rooftops. Possibly impervious to fear, intimidation, or pain. **Secrets:** May have once trained under the Unseen Widows, or simply survived them. Knows underground paths others don’t — possibly even access routes into The Silo **Beliefs:** Justice is dead; only reckoning remains. The system cannot be fixed — it must be punished ## Role In Disgraceland The Grim Man is the walking judgment of Disgraceland — a myth made flesh. His presence weaves through every region like a whispered warning. He doesn't lead. He doesn't follow. He _hunts_. No one is safe from him, and no one is innocent enough to summon him. But when he appears, the guilty know exactly why.
