## Affiliation
- [[El Santo]] Faith
- Title: **Grand Mascara** (157th holder)

## Summary
The **Grand Mascara** is the supreme spiritual leader of the [[El Santo]] faith, a secretive and powerful figure chosen by the High Council, known as the [[Senior Enmascarados]], upon the death of the previous leader. His true identity is unknown to the public. He is both revered and feared.

## Appearance
- Wears flowing white and silver ceremonial robes with golden accents
- Always masked in a traditional silver luchador mask
- Draped in a dark silver cape
- Carries an amulet engraved with the sacred mask symbol of El Santo

## Known Traits
- Never removes his mask in public
- Charismatic, solemn, and unwavering
- Commands respect across all of [[DISGRACELAND]]
- Speaks with deliberate conviction
- Treats the mask as sacred — to remove it is to surrender the faith

## Beliefs and Teachings
- "To wear the mask is to carry the burden of the people."
- Preaches **strength in the face of oppression**
- Encourages followers to help the less fortunate and defend the weak
- Believes the mask makes all equal — rich, poor, noble, or slave

## Succession
- The Grand Mascara is chosen only upon death
- Selection process handled in secret by the [[Senior Enmascarados]]
- The chosen one disappears from public life and is reborn as **Mascara**

## Current Status
- The 157th Grand Mascara
- Believed to have been appointed shortly after the Long Winter
- Seen occasionally at major temples or during sacred rites
- Suspected to have political influence beyond the church

## Notes
- Rumors circulate that he was once a champion luchador before taking the vows
- Some say he speaks to the Mask of Santo itself
- The phrase **“The Mask Endures”** is often associated with his rule

199.title: Shana
199.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Shana]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":null,"NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_shana.png","religion":"[[Word of the Stillborn Star]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[Hollow House]]","territory":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","district":"[[GUTTER ROW#Red Light District|Red Light District]]","faction":"None","role":"Owner of [[Hollow House]] Brothel","chapters":["03 - The Devil In The Row"],"tags":["character","individual","protagonist","stillborn-star","chapter03"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 11:02:41"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_shana.png religion: "[[Word of the Stillborn Star]]" status: Alive location: "[[Hollow House]]" territory: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" district: "[[GUTTER ROW#Red Light District|Red Light District]]" faction: None role: "Owner of [[Hollow House]] Brothel" chapters: - 03 - The Devil In The Row tags: - character - individual - protagonist - stillborn-star - chapter03 --- # SHANA > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[shana.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Proprietor of The [[Hollow House]] Strip Club **Alias/Nickname:** The Rat Queen **Home Location:** Red Light District, [[GUTTER ROW]] **Public Reputation:** Powerful, local folk hero **Gender:** Female **Spouse:** None **Age:** 31 **Height:** 5'6" **Weight:** 145 lbs. **Date of Birth:** June 21st, 2155 **Occupation:** Madame **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** Only herself. **Known Associates:** Unknown **Faith:** [[Word of the Stillborn Star]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“You’d be surprised how much truth slips out when the lights are low and the drinks are cold.”

A decade ago, **Shana** stepped into **[[GUTTER ROW]]** with nothing but a cracked mirror compact, a bullet scar on her thigh, and the quiet resolve of a woman who'd survived too many men with too many promises. No one knows where she came from. Some say she danced for Loyalists in [[Ashmoor]]. Others whisper she slit a governor’s throat with her garter clasp and never looked back. What’s known is this: she found a rotting tenement at the edge of the Red Light District and turned it into **[[Hollow House]]** — a burlesque lounge, a pleasure den, a confessional in disguise. No neon. No stage lights. Just velvet curtains, bruised perfume, and a firm house code: _her girls come first._ She started with three women — all discarded, wounded, or in hiding. She gave them food, safety, and a cut that didn’t reek of exploitation. Word spread. Quickly. One by one, other women came — runaways, rebels, ex-slaves, ex-killers — and each found more than survival under Shana’s roof. They found **power**. She never advertised. She didn’t need to. **Her name moved through the filth like fire** — the madame who didn’t sell her girls, didn’t let them get hurt, and didn’t care who you were if you broke her rules. Now The [[Hollow House]] is legend. Men come for pleasure. Women come for shelter. Everyone leaves with fewer secrets. And while Gutter Row eats most who try to rise, **Shana thrives**. She’s more than a business owner. She’s **a quiet queen** in a district of rats — red curls, top hat, and eyes that see through silk and lies. She’s got dirt on half the mayors in Disgraceland, and they all know better than to come knocking uninvited. They say The Hollow House is named for what’s left of the people who leave it. But those who stay? They don’t feel hollow. They feel **safe**. And in Gutter Row, that’s a miracle. --- ## Personality > [!infobox] > > ![[shanabeau.png|260]] **Temperament:** Warm smile, sharp mind. She’s velvet on the surface, razors underneath. Knows when to flirt, when to intimidate, and when to vanish. Plays the fool sometimes — just long enough to see who’s stupid enough to believe it. **Vices:** Smokes rare roseleaf tobacco. Has a taste for secrets, good wine, and expensive perfume. Occasionally disappears for days without telling anyone. Always returns sharper than when she left. **Abilities:** Master manipulator, listener, and reader of people. Keeps hidden ledgers tracking debts, favors, lies — not for blackmail, but for survival. Has dirt on _every mayor, gang captain, and Loyalist officer_ who’s stepped into her lounge. Knows what’s coming before it hits the streets. **Secrets:** Has an arrangement with one of the Rustwater Raiders — reason unknown. Keeps a locked room in the back of the lounge. No one enters but her. **Beliefs:** Men think they run the world. They don’t even run their own hands. ## Role In Disgraceland Shana is the flame at the center of the Red Light District — the woman everyone underestimates until it’s too late. She owns and runs the most notorious, tightly controlled burlesque lounge in Gutter Row — a place where bodies dance and lips loosen. She’s not a spy, but she knows **everything**. And that’s why she’s still breathing.

200.title: Tate Faulkner
200.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Tate Faulkner]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":null,"NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_tate.png","religion":"[[Faith of Mirella]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","faction":"None","role":"[[Salem Quinn]]'s Assistant","territory":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","district":"[[GUTTER ROW#Nailstooth|Nailstooth]]","chapters":["Visions In The Night"],"tags":["character","individual","protagonist","mirella","bside03"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/04 10:33:14"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_tate.png religion: "[[Faith of Mirella]]" status: Alive location: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" faction: None role: "[[Salem Quinn]]'s Assistant" territory: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" district: "[[GUTTER ROW#Nailstooth|Nailstooth]]" chapters: - Visions In The Night tags: - character - individual - protagonist - mirella - bside03 --- # TATE FAULKNER > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[tate.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** **Alias/Nickname:** The Blind Seer **Home Location:** Vileby, [[GUTTER ROW]] **Public Reputation:** Eccentric **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** 35 **Height:** 6'3" **Weight:** 264 lbs. **Date of Birth:** December 30th, 2151 **Occupation:** Bodyguard **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** Accompanies [[Salem Quinn]] **Known Associates:** [[Salem Quinn]] **Faith:** [[Faith of Mirella]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“I don’t need to see the fire. I trust the man holding the match.”

Tate Faulkner used to wear a badge. Worked checkpoint patrol near the [[Ashmoor]] perimeter during the early days of the Loyalist unification. He was known for two things: following orders _exactly_, and hitting harder than a horse kick. But everything changed the day he encountered [[Salem Quinn]]. Salem was just a blind man in a red suit then — quiet, strange, bleeding from the nose. But when Salem spoke, Tate listened. The things the old man described hadn’t happened yet… but within six months, every detail came true. A raid. A bridge collapse. The death of Tate’s entire unit. All except him. After that, Tate left his post and found the Seer. He never went back. No orders. No explanation. Just started walking beside him, watching his back, clearing the way. Over time, Tate became more than a bodyguard — he became **Salem’s interpreter**, organizer, translator, protector. He writes down every vision, studies patterns, checks dates, and warns locals when he can. Tate doesn’t believe in fate. But he believes in **[[Salem Quinn]]**. And if whatever’s coming is as bad as Salem says it is… Tate plans to meet it head-on — clipboard in hand, teeth bared. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Grim. Efficient. Intimidating. Speaks in short, clear bursts like he’s giving field orders. Rarely jokes, but has a dry, savage wit when cornered. Has no patience for nonsense, cruelty, or poetry. **Vices:** Caffeine. Precision. Control. May enjoy violence more than he admits. Refuses to read fiction. **Abilities:** Expert in hand-to-hand combat and crowd control. - Memorizes every detail — routes, rations, names, faces. Shoots to wound unless Salem says otherwise. Keeps detailed notes of Salem’s visions and interpretations. **Secrets:** Was once a Loyalist security officer… until he saw one of Salem’s visions come true. Keeps a tattered photo of a young girl in his pocket — never talks about her. Once broke a man’s spine for insulting Salem in front of children **Beliefs:** The Seer sees. His job is to make sure he **gets to where he needs to be.**. ## Role In Disgraceland Tate Faulkner is the rock that follows the storm. He’s not a mystic. He doesn’t see visions. But he **believes** in Salem Quinn with a conviction that’s downright terrifying. While Salem moves through Disgraceland as a whisper, Tate is the **crack of thunder** right behind him — clipboard in one hand, sidearm in the other. He handles the world so Salem doesn’t have to. ## Appearances

201.title: Scumbag
201.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Scumbag]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":null,"NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_scum.png","religion":"None","status":"Alive","location":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","territory":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","district":"[[GUTTER ROW#Nailstooth|Nailstooth]]","faction":"None","role":"Danger on the streets","chapters":["Hymn From A Dead Girl","07 - The Spotlight Lies"],"tags":["character","individual","antagonist","bside1","chapter07"],"created":"2025/05/28 09:48:09","modified":"2025/06/09 09:33:45"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_scum.png religion: None status: Alive location: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" territory: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" district: "[[GUTTER ROW#Nailstooth|Nailstooth]]" faction: None role: Danger on the streets chapters: - Hymn From A Dead Girl - 07 - The Spotlight Lies tags: - character - individual - antagonist - bside1 - chapter07 --- # SCUMBAG > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[scum.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** The Villian of Gutter Row **Alias/Nickname:** **Home Location:** [[GUTTER ROW]] **Public Reputation:** None **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** Unknown **Height:** 6'2" **Weight:** Unknown **Date of Birth:** Unknown **Occupation:** Unknown **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** **Known Associates:** **Faith:** None **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“Every scream's got its own note, you just gotta listen close. Some of 'em? Real pretty.”

**[[Scumbag]]** is an open wound walking. Nobody knows his real name, and nobody asks. He’s one of Gutter Row’s most feared creatures — a man so utterly depraved that even the hardened slavers of Three Nail Market cross the street when they see him. He’s not a crime boss, not even a proper gang member. He’s a wildcard, a freak, and a sadist. He walks with a swagger soaked in blood and shit, because nobody’s ever put him down for good. He’s raped, murdered, mutilated, and laughed through it all. Cops? He mocks them. The market bosses? He spits in their stalls. Loyalist Guard? He disappears into the grime like a cockroach when they come sniffing, then reappears days later like nothing happened. Some say he cuts deals. Others say he knows things. But the truth is simpler: the city’s rotted, and it lets its worst creatures live so long as they cause the right kind of chaos. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Wildly unstable. He swings from eerie calm to maniacal frenzy in seconds. He talks to himself, to objects, to shadows. Everything’s a joke to him — especially pain. He loves to toy with people psychologically before unleashing violence. **Vices:** All of them. He indulges in sadism, rape, mutilation, torture, arson, cannibalism, and drug abuse — particularly Luxyn. He also collects “trophies” from his victims: fingers, eyeballs, tongues. Keeps them in his coat pockets like candy. **Abilities:** Extremely agile and fast in close quarters. Masters unpredictability — throws off even seasoned fighters. Savvy with hiding, blending in, and escaping. Pain tolerance is off the charts, almost inhuman **Secrets:** He’s killed multiple Loyalist officers, but their deaths were covered up to avoid panic. **Beliefs:** He believes the world ended after the Tetra bomb, and everything now is a twisted afterlife. There is no right or wrong, just _performance._ People are meat with makeup. Pain is the only truth. He thinks [[The Grim Man]] is a bedtime story, a joke — but a _funny one._ ## Role In Disgraceland **[[Scumbag]]** is the unpunished evil that everyone endures. He haunts Gutter Row as a symbol of the regime’s failure — or complicity. His existence dares someone, anyone, to rise up and stop him. But no one has. Yet. ## Appearances > - [[Hymn From A Dead Girl]]

The only newspaper in circulation in Disgraceland. role: Owner of the [[Tribucia Tribute]] chapters: - tags: - character - individual - protagonist - news - ember-saint --- # ROYCE SINCAYD > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[royce.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Owner & Editor of the [[Tribucia Tribute]] **Alias/Nickname:** **Home Location:** Dog City, [[CHARSPIRE]] **Public Reputation:** Well-liked **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** **Age:** 60 **Height:** 5'9" **Weight:** 154 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 23rd of Frostsun, 2126 **Occupation:** Owner of the [[Tribucia Tribute]] **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** **Known Associates:** **Faith:** [[Church of the Ember Saint]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“Sometimes survival means knowing when to hit 'delete' instead of 'print.'”

Once a firebrand of post-war journalism, **Royce Sincayd** founded the *[[Tribucia Tribute]]* with nothing but a broken printing press, a pocket full of ink cartridges, and a vision: truth above all. In the early years after the Long Winter, he was revered as a voice of resistance and integrity — exposing corruption, giving voice to the starving, and holding fledgling regional powers accountable. But time wears on even the sharpest ideals. Decades of veiled threats, missing colleagues, and slow, suffocating pressure from [[The Duke]] chipped away at Royce’s resolve. These days, he still calls the shots in the newsroom, but everyone knows the *Tribute* won't publish anything directly negative about The Duke. He tells himself it’s survival. That it’s better to bend than break. He walks the halls of his paper with an old man’s limp and a heavy conscience, watching as younger, hungrier reporters like [[Rachel Gold]] test the boundaries he no longer has the strength to push. The presses still roll. But what they print isn’t always the truth anymore — just the truth he’s allowed to tell. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Measured, weary, calculating. Royce used to speak in fire; now he speaks in sighs. **Vices:** Cheap cigars, self-pity, and willful ignorance when it suits him. **Abilities:** Master editor and political survivor. Knows how to shape a story — or bury it. **Secrets:** Keeps a locked drawer of unpublished exposés, including a damning file on [[Jacoban Clay]] and internal TTV memos. He may have been directly warned by [[The Duke]] years ago — and caved. **Beliefs:** Still believes in truth, deep down. But believes more in staying alive to print another day. ## Role In Disgraceland A once-proud truth-teller turned compromised gatekeeper of the press. His silence props up The Duke as much as his old words once challenged him. ## Appearances

203.title: Salem Quinn
203.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Salem Quinn]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":null,"NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_salem.png","religion":"[[Faith of Mirella]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","territory":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","district":"[[GUTTER ROW#Nailstooth|Nailstooth]]","faction":"None","role":"Popular Prophet","chapters":["Visions In The Night"],"tags":["character","individual","protagonist","mirella","bside03"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/04 14:44:11"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_salem.png religion: "[[Faith of Mirella]]" status: Alive location: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" territory: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" district: "[[GUTTER ROW#Nailstooth|Nailstooth]]" faction: None role: Popular Prophet chapters: - Visions In The Night tags: - character - individual - protagonist - mirella - bside03 --- # SALEM QUINN > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[salem.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** **Alias/Nickname:** The Blind Seer **Home Location:** [[GUTTER ROW#Nailstooth|Nailstooth]], [[GUTTER ROW]] **Public Reputation:** Eccentric **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** 51 **Height:** 5'11" **Weight:** 165 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 2nd of Frostsun, 2135 **Occupation:** Unknown **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** None; Pilgrim Seer traveling north through Disgraceland **Known Associates:** [[Tate Faulkner]] **Faith:** [[Faith of Mirella]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“I see clearer than the ones who build thrones. I see what waits behind the mirror. And brother… it’s already moving.”

No one knows where **Salem Quinn** was born, and he doesn't offer the story. Some say he was once a scholar in the Old Capitol, a physician-psychic hybrid whose insight was so precise it bordered on supernatural. Others claim he emerged from the Ash Dunes after the Tetra Bomb fell, eyes burned shut by divine wrath. What is known is this: he walks north, alone, wearing the same blood-red suit and carrying a gold-handled cane that never strikes a pebble wrong. His eyes are pale, milked-over, but unscarred. He is blind — completely — yet he never stumbles. Salem’s visions began long before the world was cracked open. He saw fire in the skies as a boy. Saw fields drown, people vanish, and cities become bones. He didn’t understand them then. He tried to ignore them. Tried to live small, quiet. But the visions didn’t stop — they sharpened. Became louder. Now they come in fits, in dreams, in static whispers between heartbeats. Sometimes they leave him convulsing. Sometimes just weeping. He keeps walking anyway. He has no faction, no banners, no weapons. And yet wherever he goes, people move aside. Even gang lords and smugglers hush their tongues when he passes. In every town between **Gutter Row** and **Ashmoor**, someone always recognizes him. They call him _The Blind Seer_, or _The Walking Warning_. Children bring him water. Elders beg him for insight. He answers rarely, and only in riddles. But Quinn isn’t wandering. He’s on a mission — one only he seems to fully understand. His goal is singular: gain an audience with **[[The Duke of Disgraceland]]**. To stand before the tyrant in his Silo throne and deliver the words that burn behind his blind eyes. Whether the message is salvation or damnation, even Quinn isn’t sure. But he knows this: if the Duke ignores it, something worse than war is coming. Some say Salem has met **[[Veerah]]**, the prophet of the Unseen Widows, and that the two shared a vision that nearly broke them both. Others whisper that Salem already knows how Disgraceland ends — he’s just giving the world a chance to prove him wrong. --- ## Personality > [!infobox] > > ![[sqq.png|300]] **Temperament:** Quiet. Unshakably calm. His words come slow, each one measured like they cost something. He doesn’t argue. He just speaks — and lets the silence do the rest. **Vices:** None apparent. He neither eats in public nor asks for shelter. Some swear he walks barefoot through snow and glass. Others say he weeps blood when no one is watching. Truth is, nobody’s sure where he sleeps… or if he sleeps at all. **Abilities:** Blind, yet walks without assistance — even through minefields and ruins. Receives visions in dreams or seizures — often apocalyptic, symbolic, or maddeningly cryptic. Can sense a person’s emotional state through voice and posture alone. **Secrets:** Has seen visions of the Tetra bomb before it fell. Shares a psychic resonance with [[Veerah]] — though neither one fully understands it. - His blindness may not be natural. Rumors suggest it was _taken_ from him — as payment. **Beliefs:** Disgraceland’s time is nearly up ## Role In Disgraceland **Salem Quinn** is a prophet out of time — a man blind to the world, yet cursed to see too much. He travels slowly but purposefully, walking from the rot of [[GUTTER ROW]] toward the tyranny of [[Ashmoor]], seeking one thing: an audience with [[The Duke]]. His message is unknown, but the look on his face suggests it’s already too late. ## Appearances

metadata.info: Star reporter at the Tribucia Tribute. Her in-depth, pull no punches articles and exposes are appreciated by the people of Disgraceland.

Her in-depth, pull no punches articles and exposes are appreciated by the people of Disgraceland.","location":"[[CHARSPIRE]]","faction":"None","role":"[[Tribucia Tribute]] Reporter","chapters":[null],"tags":["character","individual","protagonist","ember-saint","news"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/03 10:58:40"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_rachel.png religion: "[[Church of the Ember Saint]]" status: Alive cover: zz_media/rg1.png info: Star reporter at the Tribucia Tribute. Her in-depth, pull no punches articles and exposes are appreciated by the people of Disgraceland. location: "[[CHARSPIRE]]" faction: None role: "[[Tribucia Tribute]] Reporter" chapters: - tags: - character - individual - protagonist - ember-saint - news --- # RACHEL GOLD > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[rachel.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Lead investigative journalist at the _Tribucia Tribute_ **Alias/Nickname:** **Home Location:** Dog City, [[CHARSPIRE]] **Public Reputation:** Popular, truth-teller **Gender:** Female **Spouse:** None **Age:** 26 **Height:** 5'8" **Weight:** 135 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 9th of Ambertide, 2160 **Occupation:** Unknown **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** The story **Known Associates:** [[Marlon Lambert]], [[Royce Sincayd]] **Faith:** [[Church of the Ember Saint]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“You don’t scare me. I’ve been threatened by better men, and they all ended up in my footnotes.”

**Rachel Gold** was born in a pressroom — ink on her hands before she could write. Her parents ran an underground news flyer during the early years of the Loyalist consolidation, smuggling stories across borders and burning presses before raids. When the Tetra bomb fell, her father disappeared and her mother went silent. Rachel never stopped chasing the story. Now, she writes for the **[[Tribucia Tribute]]**, the last printed paper in Disgraceland. Most reporters just rewrite Loyalist briefings or publish puff pieces about grain yields. Not Rachel. She digs. She exposes. She names names. Her coverage of **[[Gorren Brile|Mayor Brile]]’s torture camps**, **[[Sgt. Rottwyler]]’s black market raids**, and **slave trafficking in [[Gutter Row]]** made her both a hero and a target. Her column, _Gold’s Truth_, runs front page more days than not. And every time it does, someone in power loses sleep. Her editors constantly warn her to **stay away from The Duke**, and so far, she has — _publicly_. But there’s a folder buried in her filing cabinet. A thick one. With red string and ink stains. And one day, that story’s going to break. And when it does… Disgraceland won’t be ready for it. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Quick-witted, relentless, and unapologetically direct. She's got no patience for bullshit, small talk, or weak coffee. She’ll listen to your story — but only if you get to the point. **Vices:** Caffeine, long nights, confrontation. Smokes only when she’s about to publish something risky. Keeps a loaded recorder in her boot and a pair of brass knuckles in her desk drawer — just in case. **Abilities:** Master investigator — knows how to bribe, charm, or blackmail the truth out of anyone. Carries an old, beat-up press badge that’s saved her life more than once. Can type a full article in one sitting, no edits needed. **Secrets:** Keeps a hidden file on The Duke — dozens of leads, names, and clues no one’s allowed to see. Has an informant inside The Silo, though even she doesn’t know their real name. **Beliefs:** The truth matters — even if no one believes it ## Role In Disgraceland Rachel Gold is Disgraceland’s **last real reporter** — a fast-talking, hard-punching journalist who digs where she shouldn’t and prints what no one else will. She’s the kind of woman who asks the dangerous questions, writes the answers in bold, and _signs her name at the bottom_. Her exposés have rattled mayors, exposed corruption, and nearly got her killed more than once. She’s beloved by the public, hated by the powerful, and barely tolerated by her own editors. ## Appearances

205.title: Ora Razchek
205.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Ora Razchek]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":null,"NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_ora.png","religion":"None","status":"Alive?","location":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","territory":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","district":"[[GUTTER ROW#Pisstown|Pisstown]]","faction":"None","role":"The Reaper","chapters":["01 - Main Event Shadows","07 - The Spotlight Lies"],"tags":["character","individual","antagonist","none"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/09 10:33:12"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_ora.png religion: None status: Alive? location: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" territory: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" district: "[[GUTTER ROW#Pisstown|Pisstown]]" faction: None role: The Reaper chapters: - 01 - Main Event Shadows - 07 - The Spotlight Lies tags: - character - individual - antagonist - none --- # ORA RAZCHEK > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[ora.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** **Alias/Nickname:** The Reaper of Reapton **Home Location:** Reapton, [[GUTTER ROW]] **Public Reputation:** A living nightmare **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** Unknown **Height:** 6'1 **Weight:** 145 lbs. **Date of Birth:** Unknown **Occupation:** Unknown **Status:** Alive? **Affiliation:** None **Known Associates:** Unknown **Faith:** None **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“I am proof that death is an obstacle, not an end. Soon, Disgraceland will understand the cost of true immortality.”

Long ago, during the chaos of the dark years, Ora Razchek was just another brilliant scientist trying to save his own skin. Working in secret, he developed a radical, invasive AI—one designed to replace failing brain tissue, rewrite memory, and eventually take over the entire mind. He called it the “Continuum Protocol.” He tested it on himself, right before the world fell apart. The experiment _killed_ him… but he got back up. The human part of Ora Razchek died on that table, but what woke up was something else—a hybrid consciousness, a cold, calculating mix of Ora’s memories, instincts, and an ever-adapting artificial mind. He has taken the young [[Hella]] under his wing. **Now, Ora cannot die—** at least, not as long as his brain (and its implanted AI) remains intact. He doesn’t age. He doesn’t sleep. He barely feels pain. And as his humanity slips further away, all that remains is the drive for power, and a sick curiosity: _How many others can he remake in his image?_ ### **His Mission:** - He “perfected” himself, but now he wants to claim dominion over Disgraceland. No more hiding in the shadows. - He’s building an army of AI-brain monsters, all ultimately controlled by his own will—a network of living weapons, each one a reflection of his own immortal experiment. - When the time is right, he’ll unleash his “children” to wipe out the city’s leaders, topple the Duke, and take his seat as the true ruler—a god among insects. ### **Unbeknownst to all:** - **Nobody knows Razchek is already dead.** To the world, he’s just a weird, reclusive old man in goggles. - His army waits below, perfectly still until the signal comes—a dark, silent hive beneath the city. - Only one thing can kill Ora Razchek: destroying the AI core in his brain. Anything less, he survives—rebooting, rebuilding, learning from every failure. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Detached. Inhumanly calm. Observes more than he speaks — if he speaks at all. He carries the unsettling serenity of someone who already knows how and when you’ll die. **Vices:** Obsession with immortality, disregard for human life, compulsive need to “improve” humanity. **Abilities:** Superhuman intellect, inhuman patience, neural network control over all his creations, can transfer some of his consciousness to other AI brains if needed. **Secrets:** He’s already dead. If his brain is destroyed, the entire army loses connection—instant, chaotic failure. **Beliefs:** Death is a sickness, and he is the cure. Humanity is a species that must evolve or perish, and he alone can drive that evolution. ## Role In Disgraceland While every other bastard’s fighting over scraps, Ora Razchek is quietly getting ready to turn the entire world upside down. The scariest part? Nobody suspects a thing. Not yet.

206.title: Owen McCready
206.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Owen McCready]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":null,"NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_owen.png","religion":"None","status":"Alive","location":"[[CHARSPIRE]]","territory":"[[CHARSPIRE]]","district":"[[CHARSPIRE#Gravenwild|Gravenwild]]","faction":"None","role":"[[TTV Studios]] Station Manager","chapters":["07 - The Spotlight Lies"],"tags":["character","individual","neutral","stillborn-star","chapter07"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/06 19:56:22"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_owen.png religion: None status: Alive location: "[[CHARSPIRE]]" territory: "[[CHARSPIRE]]" district: "[[CHARSPIRE#Gravenwild|Gravenwild]]" faction: None role: "[[TTV Studios]] Station Manager" chapters: - 07 - The Spotlight Lies tags: - character - individual - neutral - stillborn-star - chapter07 --- # OWEN 'SWITCH' McCREADY > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[owen.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Station Manager of [[TTV Studios]] **Alias/Nickname:** **Home Location:** Gravenwild, [[CHARSPIRE]] **Public Reputation:** None **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** 51 **Height:** 5'10" **Weight:** 224 lbs. **Date of Birth:** August 6th, 2135 **Occupation:** Station Manager **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** **Known Associates:** [[Morris Gable]] **Faith:** None **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“I don’t care who’s running the show, long as I get paid and nobody screws with my tower. You want the truth? Don’t look for it on TV.”

Owen “Switch” McCready is the reluctant lifeblood of [[TTV Studios]], the last broadcast engineer in a world that barely remembers television. Fifty-eight but looks older, he’s wiry, stoop-shouldered, with permanent bags under his eyes and nicotine-stained fingers. His voice is hoarse, his wit sharper than the broken glass around the [[CHARSPIRE#Gravenwild|Gravenwild]] streets. He was running illegal radio, hiding from every government and corporation until [[The Duke]]’s people found him and gave him an offer he couldn’t refuse: fix the tower, run the shows, and keep his head down. Switch is seen as a necessary evil by the regime and an enigma to the citizens — a guy who seems to exist in the walls, always lurking behind cables or vanishing into the static. He’s never at ease except when buried in tangled wires or soldering something by flashlight. Most folks have no idea if he’s loyal, broken, or just too tired to care. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Blunt, antisocial, and unflappable under pressure. Switch is not mean, but he’s got no patience for small talk or bullshit. Prefers silence to company, except for a late-night drink with one of the crew who actually knows which end of a soldering iron gets hot. If you waste his time, he’ll let you know. If you show up to help, he’ll grumble but let you stay. **Vices:** Bourbon, hand-rolled cigarettes, and scavenged painkillers. Sleeps in the equipment room more nights than not, bottle in hand. His biggest vice, though, is isolation: Switch avoids people, feelings, and especially hope, burying himself in work and routine. **Abilities:** A natural with anything electrical or mechanical, from broadcast towers to shortwave radios and analog security cams. Can fix almost anything with spare wire, scrap metal, and tape. Has an uncanny knack for reading a situation — he can smell trouble before it happens, and knows how to keep a low profile when the wrong people are sniffing around. **Secrets:** Keeps a private shortwave set tuned to “forbidden” frequencies — sometimes intercepts rebel transmissions or pirate music, never says a word. He secretly recorded The Duke’s first address at TTV, stashing the original tape in a hidden box “for insurance.” Once helped a resistance runner sneak out by faking a signal blackout. Most dangerous secret: he’s got enough dirt on the Loyalist Guards to ruin several careers, but no desire to be a hero. **Beliefs:** Trusts machines more than people, and believes survival means staying invisible. Cynical about politics; sees The Duke as “just another bastard in charge.” Deep down, though, Switch believes in freedom of information — but he’s convinced trying to fight the system outright just gets you killed. ## Role In Disgraceland Switch is the only reason the signal reaches every home, bar, and bunker in Tribucia. He keeps TTV running, not out of loyalty, but because nobody else can. Both The Duke’s men and the general public leave him alone — he’s too useful to threaten, too strange to befriend. ## Appearances

207.title: Morris Gable

metadata.role: Host of [[Night Time with Morris Gable]]

207.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Morris Gable]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":null,"NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_morris.png","religion":"[[Word of the Stillborn Star]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[CHARSPIRE]]","territory":"[[CHARSPIRE]]","district":"[[CHARSPIRE#Gravenwild|Gravenwild]]","faction":"None","role":"Host of [[Night Time with Morris Gable]]","chapters":["07 - The Spotlight Lies"],"tags":["character","individual","neutral","stillborn-star","chapter07"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:07","modified":"2025/06/08 17:47:48"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_morris.png religion: "[[Word of the Stillborn Star]]" status: Alive location: "[[CHARSPIRE]]" territory: "[[CHARSPIRE]]" district: "[[CHARSPIRE#Gravenwild|Gravenwild]]" faction: None role: "Host of [[Night Time with Morris Gable]]" chapters: - 07 - The Spotlight Lies tags: - character - individual - neutral - stillborn-star - chapter07 --- # MORRIS GABLE > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[morrisgable.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Host of [[Night Time with Morris Gable]] **Alias/Nickname:** **Home Location:** Gravenwild, [[CHARSPIRE]] **Public Reputation:** Eccentric, charasmatic **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** 54 **Height:** 5'11" **Weight:** 184 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 14th of Searsun, 2132 **Occupation:** Television host **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Loyalist Guard]] **Known Associates:** [[Jacoban Clay]], [[Soria Langston-Clay]], [[Warren Scottyard]], [[The Duke]], [[Owen McCready]], [[Jaden Kade]] **Faith:** [[Word of the Stillborn Star]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“You’ve got Morris now. And as long as I’m with you… everything’s going to be just fine.”

Morris Gable is the face you see when the rest of Disgraceland goes dark. Five nights a week, at the stroke of midnight, he welcomes the weary, the desperate, and the damned to _Night Time with Morris Gable_ — a talk show turned tranquilizer, beamed into every home by government mandate. With his perfectly sculpted hair and voice smooth as melted wax, Morris offers calm in the chaos. He never stumbles, never sweats, and never speaks a word that hasn’t been rehearsed. His past is a carefully airbrushed mystery. Official records suggest he was once a radio performer in the Capital Crescent, though no recordings survive. Others claim he worked as a magician, a failed actor, or even a Ministry interrogator with a knack for persuasion. What’s known is that when The Duke’s Loyalists began expanding media control, Morris was already waiting — a volunteer eager to become the voice of the new age. Morris now lives in a heavily guarded estate in **South-East Gravenwild**, one of the few clean and comfortable corners of **Charspire**. The studio itself is a concrete tower of humming wires and static screens deep in **Gravenwild proper**, cloaked in smoke and steel. From there, he broadcasts manufactured joy, one chuckle at a time, under the glowing banner of Clay Millwrights. No one knows what he believes. Maybe he believes nothing. Or maybe he believes too much. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Charming, composed, unfailingly polite. He never loses his cool — not on screen, not in public, not even alone. His calm feels practiced, like a man who’s buried his nerves so deep they forgot how to shake. **Vices:** Vanity. He’s obsessed with his appearance, his image, his legacy. Drinks alone most nights. Keeps a hidden stash of preserved cosmetics and vintage cologne. Whispers his own name into the mirror when he’s sure no one’s listening. **Abilities:** Master of tone, pacing, and presence — hypnotic speech. Can read any cue card like it was carved from his soul. Knows how to pivot, deflect, and redirect any question. Allegedly has a photographic memory. **Secrets:** He keeps a box under his bed with recordings of himself trying to tell the truth. He’s never aired them. **Beliefs:** Morris doesn’t believe in The Duke. He believes in _order_. In _calm_. In keeping the screaming down to a dull murmur. He believes the truth is a poison and that people want to be lied to — kindly, nightly, beautifully. ## Role In Disgraceland Morris Gable is the midnight voice of state-sponsored comfort — a propaganda host designed to keep the people soothed, distracted, and loyal. He is loved by many, trusted by most, and truly known by no one. ## Appearances

208.title: Marlon Lambert

Second to Rachel Gold but very competent as a journalist. faction: "None" role: "[[Tribucia Tribute]] Reporter" chapters: - tags: - character - individual - protagonist - ember-saint --- # MARLON LAMBERT > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[marlon.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Investigative reporter at the _Tribucia Tribute_ **Alias/Nickname:** **Home Location:** Dog City, [[CHARSPIRE]] **Public Reputation:** Driven **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** 27 **Height:** 5'11" **Weight:** 165 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 11th of Bloomsun, 2159 **Occupation:** Reporter/Journalist **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** None **Known Associates:** [[Rachel Gold]] **Faith:** [[Church of the Ember Saint]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“I’m not trying to win. I’m just trying to make sure someone tells the truth after the fire.”

Marlon Lambert grew up in **Threshton**, raised by a father who printed grain receipts and a mother who ran messages for the Rancher Collective. He learned to read on old ration slips and grew up knowing that what people _write down_ matters more than what they say. He moved to [[CHARSPIRE]] to work for the _Tribucia Tribute_, where he quickly made a name for himself digging into agricultural corruption and Loyalist zoning scandals. Then **[[Rachel Gold]]** showed up — and the bar moved. She wrote fire. He wrote fact. She was headline ink. He was page three. Instead of resenting her, he fell for her. Not instantly, not with flowers — but with long nights watching her retype whole paragraphs, yelling at the press chief, storming out of the archive room muttering about “cover-ups and cowards.” He’s still in love. But he stays quiet. He’s also become a regular at **The Hollow House**, where **Shana** feeds him breadcrumbs and occasionally lets him sleep in the back room when someone’s chasing him for asking the wrong questions. Marlon isn’t trying to be the best. He’s just trying to make sure **someone remembers the truth** when Rachel’s gone. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Reserved, thoughtful, slightly awkward. He doesn’t interrupt. He listens. Always scribbling in his notepad like he’s transcribing your soul. The kind of guy who knows exactly what’s going on — and pretends he doesn’t until it’s too late for you. **Vices:** Cigarettes. Whiskey. [[Rachel Gold]]. He visits the **[[Hollow House]]** weekly — sometimes for a drink, sometimes for a tip, sometimes just to see **[[Shana]]** smirk when he asks the wrong questions. **Abilities:** Investigative journalist with deep connections in [[Threshton]], [[Gutter Row]], and [[Ashmoor]]. Can blend into a room and make people forget he’s there — until his article drops. Keeps a coded shorthand that only he understands. **Secrets:** Has written drafts of love letters to Rachel that he never sends. Keeps a personal journal separate from his reporting — filled with observations about Rachel, Shana, and the growing unrest. Fears the day Rachel disappears chasing a story, because he won’t survive it **Beliefs:** The story matters more than the byline. Rachel deserves to be protected — even if she’d never ask for it ## Role In Disraceland Marlon Lambert is **Disgraceland’s second-best journalist** — and he knows it. Working in the same newsroom as **[[Rachel Gold]]**, he’s talented, respected, and entirely overlooked… which makes him **very dangerous** in his own way. He’s a quiet operator. He asks the right questions, earns the right trust, and knows how to disappear until the headline drops. He’s also hopelessly in love with Rachel — and has been for years. She doesn’t know. And if she does, she’s too focused on the story to care. So Marlon does what he always does: lights a smoke, follows the lead, and keeps the flame buried under copy edits. ## Appearances

Well-respected by the people. faction: None role: Co-Anchor of [[TTV Evening News]] chapters: - tags: - character - individual - protagonist - news --- # LAYLA HAWK > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[lh.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** **Alias/Nickname:** **Home Location:** [[ASHMOOR]] **Public Reputation:** Popular **Gender:** Female **Spouse:** None **Age:** 28 **Height:** 5'8" **Weight:** 126 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 22nd of Embersun, 2158 **Occupation:** Anchor of the [[TTV Evening News]] **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** **Known Associates:** [[Warren Scottyard]], [[Owen McCready]], [[Mark Jeffrey]] **Faith:** [[Word of the Stillborn Star]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

"Sometimes the truth doesn’t scream. Sometimes it just slips in the back door and sits real quiet until someone notices."

[[Layla Hawk]] wasn’t supposed to survive [[Gutter Row]]. Orphaned young after a mugging turned slaughter left her alone in a world that eats the weak, she grew up learning to mask pain with poise and bury rage beneath reason. She was book-smart, quick with her tongue, and relentless in pursuit of the truth. After clawing her way into the [[Tribucia Tribute]] as a junior reporter, she built a reputation for fearless journalism, earning cautious admiration from editors and quiet fear from corrupt bureaucrats. Her stories cut deep — until the wrong one made the right person nervous. That’s when [[Owen McCready]] came calling. Plucked from the Tribute by McCready and installed as the co-anchor of [[TTV Evening News]] beside the ever-smooth [[Warren Scottyard]], Layla was polished up and paraded out — the perfect symbol of progress, of diversity, of opportunity. What The Duke never realized was that Layla wasn’t just playing along. Every night, as she smiles through stories crafted to maintain the Loyalist illusion, she slips in tiny seeds of resistance — careful word choices, pointed phrasing, silent glances. Enough to stir suspicion in the right minds. Enough to remind the oppressed that someone up there sees them. Warren knows what she’s doing. It gnaws at him, but he hasn’t ratted her out — yet. Whether it’s respect, fear, or something deeper, neither of them talks about it. ## Personality **Temperament:** Calm, clever, and sharp as a scalpel. Layla speaks softly but never aimlessly. She knows how to mask fury with a smirk and is more dangerous with a sentence than most are with a blade. **Vices:** She drinks alone after broadcasts, writes poetry she never shares, and sometimes sabotages her own safety just to feel in control again. **Abilities:** Razor-sharp intuition for subtext and danger. Master communicator — able to say ten things without saying one. Deep investigative instincts. She still has old Tribute sources who feed her real news. **Secrets:** Keeps a hidden journal cataloging Loyalist crimes and corruption. **Beliefs:** Freedom must be fought for, even in silence. Words are weapons, and truth is only dangerous when people are ready to hear it. ## Role In Disgraceland The voice behind the velvet curtain, Layla is the quiet rebellion inside TTV — a survivor turned signal flare, broadcasting hope with every breath.

210.title: Lash Hawkins
210.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Lash Hawkins]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":null,"NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_lash.png","religion":"[[Church of the Ember Saint]]","status":"Missing","location":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","faction":"None","role":"[[Gutter Row]] [[Luxyn]] Dealer","chapters":["04 - Glowing Darkness","07 - The Spotlight Lies"],"tags":["character","individual","protagonist","chapter04"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:06","modified":"2025/06/09 10:33:21"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_lash.png religion: "[[Church of the Ember Saint]]" status: Missing location: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" faction: None role: "[[Gutter Row]] [[Luxyn]] Dealer" chapters: - 04 - Glowing Darkness - 07 - The Spotlight Lies tags: - character - individual - protagonist - chapter04 --- # LASH HAWKINS > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[lash.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** **Alias/Nickname:** **Home Location:** Savage Hill, [[GUTTER ROW]] **Public Reputation:** Tough **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** 21 **Height:** 5'11" **Weight:** 165 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 21st of Frostsun, 2165 **Occupation:** [[Luxyn]] dealer **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** None **Known Associates:** **Faith:** [[Church of the Ember Saint]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“Tell your boss if he wants a real beating, he can come down here himself. I’ll leave the lights on.”

Ray Hawkins, better known as “Lash” on the street, grew up in the crumbling tenements of [[Gutter Row]], dodging debt collectors and guards since he was old enough to run. Unlike the kids with powerful families, Lash fought for every inch—learning early that if you wanted to survive, you needed to hit fast and never back down. Lash started small, hustling stolen goods and fake IDs before cooking up his own [[Luxyn]] recipe. A frequent customer of [[Hollow House]], His product hit the streets strong, cleaner and safer than the [[Murray Boys]]’ usual cut, and word spread quick. Dealers lined up, and the cutthroat corners of [[Charspire]] began to shift. He made just enough enemies to stay sharp, but just enough friends to never be alone. [[Nico Murray]] tried to flex on him once—showed up with an entourage, mouthing off in front of a crowd. Lash didn’t even let him finish talking. The beating was quick, public, and left Nico bleeding and humiliated in front of his date and his friends. Since then, Nico’s hated him, but can’t touch him—the product is too good and the streets too loyal. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Wiry, quick-witted, and unshakable. Lash doesn’t bluff—he moves first. He laughs off threats and never overplays his hand. **Vices:** Card games, cheap whiskey, and picking fights with people who think they’re untouchable. **Abilities:** Fast fists, a brilliant cook when it comes to [[Luxyn]], and a master at turning a crowd in his favor. He can take a punch, but usually doesn’t have to. **Secrets:** Keeps his family out of Gutter Row, sending most of his earnings home. He’s got an escape plan if things ever get too hot. Secretly respects Marco Murray, but will never admit it. **Beliefs:** You make your own luck. Loyalty is earned, never bought. The best way to win is to make them laugh before you lay them out. ## Role In Disgraceland Ray “Lash” Hawkins is the upstart threat shaking up [[Charspire]]’s [[Luxyn]] market—outshining the [[Murray Boys]] on their own turf, and daring anyone to take him down.

211.title: Katarina Volkoff
211.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Katarina Volkoff]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":null,"NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_kata.png","religion":"[[Word of the Stillborn Star]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[Coffin Island]]","faction":"None","role":"Warden of [[Coffin Island]] Prison","chapters":[null],"tags":["character","individual","antagonist","stillborn-star"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:06","modified":"2025/06/03 10:56:47"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_kata.png religion: "[[Word of the Stillborn Star]]" status: Alive location: "[[Coffin Island]]" faction: None role: "Warden of [[Coffin Island]] Prison" chapters: - tags: - character - individual - antagonist - stillborn-star --- # KATARINA VOLKOFF > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[kata.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Warden of [[Coffin Island]] Prison **Alias/Nickname:** The Warden **Home Location:** [[Coffin Island]] **Public Reputation:** Powerful, intimidating, strict **Gender:** Female **Spouse:** None **Age:** 39 **Height:** 5'8" **Weight:** 152 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 28th of Greensun, 2147 **Occupation:** Prison Warden **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** None **Known Associates:** [[The Duke]] **Faith:** [[Word of the Stillborn Star]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“Mercy isn’t a weakness. It’s just an option I never choose.”

Warden of [[Coffin Island]] Prison, **Katarina Volkoff** runs the facility with ruthless precision and cold detachment. After the mysterious and brutal murder of the previous warden, Katarina submitted her own name for the role — a bold move that caught the attention of [[The Duke]]. Rumors swirled about what she had to offer in exchange for his approval, and while nothing has ever been proven, whispers of “private meetings” behind sealed Silo doors haven't quieted since. Raised by a career soldier in the embers of the Long Winter, Katarina never learned softness. Her father drilled into her a strict moral code, a love for order, and an understanding that power is taken, not given. She applied that teaching with brutal efficiency in every security job she held until her transfer to Coffin Island. Since taking over, prisoner death rates have tripled — officially due to “resistance” and “non-compliance.” Unofficially, she’s been purging the place. Staff fear her. Inmates fear her more. But The Duke sees her as an asset — one who keeps his island gulag quiet, clean, and overflowing with bodies to fuel his machine. She’s an icy presence in a boiling world, and she likes it that way. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Hard, unyielding, and calculated. Katarina doesn’t waste words or sympathy. She commands respect through force, not charisma, and believes emotion is a liability. Her rare moments of warmth are disarming and usually strategic. **Vices:** Katarina has a habit of overusing prescription stimulants to maintain alertness — something left over from her early guard days. She also has a taste for pain — both inflicting it and, to a degree, receiving it — something she keeps buried beneath her crisp uniform. **Abilities:** Expert in crowd control, tactical containment, and psychological manipulation. She knows how to read a room, break a man without touching him, and turn people into informants with just a look. She’s also trained in military hand-to-hand combat and isn’t afraid to get her hands bloody. **Secrets:** Katarina didn't just petition for the job — she orchestrated the former warden’s downfall by leaking his financial records to a resistance group inside Coffin Island. When the chaos started, she made sure she was nearby — the one who “discovered” the body, the one who “restored order.” She also keeps a personal dossier of intel on every major figure in Disgraceland… including The Duke. **Beliefs:** She believes in strength, control, and utility. Loyalty is meaningless unless it serves a purpose. Pain is not only a teaching tool — it’s a truth serum. People show you who they are when they’re desperate. She trusts that more than any oath. ## Role In Disgraceland Katarina oversees [[Coffin Island]], where enemies of The Duke disappear. She maintains the prison as a place of extraction, punishment, and silence. Her loyalty to The Duke is public — her own motives are not. ## Appearances

Notorious for his in-game trash talking and ability to deek out the larger defensemen. faction: None role: Poundball Player chapters: - tags: - character - individual - protagonist - sport --- # DUSTY DILLON > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[jay.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** **Alias/Nickname:** The Slipghost **Home Location:** [[STEELTOWN]] **Public Reputation:** Popular [[Poundball]] player **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** 25 **Height:** 5'9" **Weight:** 144 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 22th of Greensun, 2161 **Occupation:** [[Poundball]] Player **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** **Known Associates:** **Faith:** [[Church of the Ember Saint]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

"They can’t hit what they can’t catch — and they sure as hell can’t catch me."

Born in the soot-choked backstreets of [[Steeltown]], **[[Jay Dillinger]]** was a flash of motion in a city built on rust. Raised by his older sister after their parents vanished working the mills, Jay grew up hustling, betting, and dodging trouble — usually faster than anyone else. By twelve, he was already a street legend, running pickup [[Poundball]] games against grown men twice his size. By sixteen, he was drafted into the [[Steeltown Wreckers]] after leaping a wall mid-game and scoring blind off a ricochet. Jay's small frame and explosive speed earned him the name _Slipghost_, a phantom on the field who could twist through cracks in the line like water through busted concrete. Fans say he doesn’t run — he glides. His signature plays blur by in seconds, but the fallout lasts much longer. Opposing defenders end up tasting gravel, and goalies often get nothing but wind in their face. He plays with swagger, a chipped grin under his dented helmet, and always seems one step ahead — not just of defenders, but of fate itself. Whether he's flipping the ball off his elbow into the trashcan or slipping through a wall of bodies untouched, **[[Jay Dillinger]]** plays like the whole damn world’s watching, and he’s got something to prove. ## Personality **Temperament:** Charming, fast-talking, and cocky, but rarely cruel. Lives for the spotlight. Keeps his cool under pressure and has a wicked sense of humor, even in the middle of a brawl. **Vices:** Gambles compulsively — not just coin, but dares, challenges, even secrets. Drinks rustshine before games as a “luck charm.” Addicted to adrenaline. Craves danger off the field almost as much as on it. **Abilities:** Unmatched agility and foot speed. No one cuts or jukes like Jay. Ridiculous spatial awareness — can pass or score from angles that seem impossible. Plays like he has eyes in the back of his head and springs in his knees. Elite trash-talker. Throws defenders off before he even moves. **Secrets:** Carries a crumpled, water-stained letter from his father — found years after his disappearance. Never told his sister. Is partially deaf in one ear from a blow he took during a Wreckers riot. Hides it well. **Beliefs:** Thinks Poundball is the only honest thing left in Disgraceland. ## Role In Disgraceland Jay Dillinger is a folk hero to the undercity. He represents hope, rebellion, and survival — a living reminder that sometimes the little guy not only survives, but wins. He’s the fastest damn thing in a place where nothing moves unless it’s burning.

Jaden is a popular but troubled figure in Disgraceland. faction: None role: "Rock Star, Lead Singer of [[The Wanderers]]" chapters: - 07 - The Spotlight Lies tags: - character - individual - protagonist - stillborn-star - music - chapter07 --- # JADEN KADE > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[jaden.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Lead singer of [[The Wanderers]] **Alias/Nickname:** Phoenix **Home Location:** Gravenwild, [[CHARSPIRE]] **Public Reputation:** Rock star **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** [[Cassidy LaRue ]] **Age:** 26 **Height:** 6'1" **Weight:** 174 lbs. **Date of Birth:** October 20th, 2160 **Occupation:** [[Night Time with Morris Gable]] House Band **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** **Known Associates:** **Faith:** [[Church of the Ember Saint]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“I don’t smile for ghosts. I just sing loud enough to drown ‘em out.”

Jaden Kade was born under the rusted towers of South [[Charspire]] — the son of a failed steelworker and a mother who vanished into the factories when he was seven. He grew up in alley fires and empty warehouses, learning guitar from a drunk ex-sound tech who once toured with real bands, back when real bands could tour. Jaden’s voice broke early and never quite healed right — now it drips with gravel and hurt, raw and unforgettable. He formed **[[The Wanderers]]** as a street act, playing for scraps and coins in makeshift markets across the regions. The band caught fire in the undercurrent — word-of-mouth spread fast, and eventually they became the pulse of backroom bars and outlaw safehouses. But everything changed the night [[Morris Gable]] showed up unannounced at a [[Gutter Row]] speakeasy, leaned against the wall, and watched them play three full sets. The next morning, Jaden was offered a deal: become the house band on [[Night Time with Morris Gable]]. Food. Shelter. National exposure. And complete creative control — as long as they didn’t "go too far." Jaden accepted. Not for fame, not for comfort — but for reach. His rebel soul still burns, but he’s learned how to play quiet in a world built to crush noise. Every time [[The Wanderers]] perform, he pushes the edge a little further — testing how much truth he can slip past the sensors. A lyric here. A look there. One day, maybe more. He despises Morris — calls him “the vulture in velvet” when he’s drunk — but they have an unspoken understanding. Morris gets the ratings. Jaden gets the stage. And Disgraceland gets the only real heartbeat left on the air. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Reckless but calculated. Passionate but tightly wound. Keeps his rage buried under smirks and silence until the mic’s hot — then he lets the notes bleed it out. Doesn’t say much during interviews. Keeps his answers vague, his tone flat. The fire comes out only in the music. **Vices:** Stims and chews (to stay focused on long broadcast nights). Often disappears into Gutter Row for days at a time with no explanation. Has an unresolved habit of sabotaging other artists he believes are regime puppets. **Abilities:** Plays multiple instruments (guitar, synth, harmonica, lapsteel). Voice like “torn velvet soaked in whiskey” — unmistakable. Writes all The Wanderers' songs, many of which are laced with coded anti-Duke metaphors. Extremely persuasive when he wants to be. **Secrets:** Jaden’s older brother was executed by Redforce in Charspire years ago — part of a failed uprising. He’s been slowly funneling slugs earned from the show toward funding illicit broadcasts and pirate signals. **Beliefs:** The Duke is a coward who hides behind glass and screens. Music is more than sound — it’s memory, it’s code, it’s war. He knows Morris Gable is a liar, but he respects the man’s _control_. Even snakes have rhythm. ## Role Details **Jaden Kade** is the unspoken voice of unrest in Disgraceland — a rebel hiding in plain sight, using the nation’s most-watched stage to echo resistance through rhythm. To the regime, he’s just the singer on a late-night show; to the people, he’s the last song that still feels honest. ## Appearances

214.title: Hella
214.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Hella]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":null,"NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_hella.png","religion":"None","status":"Alive","location":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","territory":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","district":"[[GUTTER ROW#Pisstown|Pisstown]]","faction":"None","role":"Assistant to [[Ora Razchek]]","chapters":["01 - Main Event Shadows","04 - Glowing Darkness","07 - The Spotlight Lies"],"tags":["character","individual","antagonist","chapter04"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:06","modified":"2025/06/09 10:33:32"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_hella.png religion: None status: Alive location: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" territory: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" district: "[[GUTTER ROW#Pisstown|Pisstown]]" faction: None role: "Assistant to [[Ora Razchek]]" chapters: - 01 - Main Event Shadows - 04 - Glowing Darkness - 07 - The Spotlight Lies tags: - character - individual - antagonist - chapter04 --- # HELLA > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[hella.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** **Alias/Nickname:** **Home Location:** [[Gutter Row]] **Public Reputation:** **Gender:** Female **Spouse:** None **Age:** 21 **Height:** 5'9" **Weight:** 114 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 25th of Searsun, 2165 **Occupation:** Body grabber **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Ora Razchek]] **Known Associates:** **Faith:** None **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“Everybody in Gutter Row gets a second chance. Some just don’t recognize it until it’s too late.”

Once just another forgotten girl working Gutter Row’s filthiest corners, **Hella** survived where others vanished—by learning to read the monsters, and, when it mattered, becoming one. When Ora Razchek found her, instead of running or pleading, she _saw him_—for what he was, and what he could offer. She bargained, bled, and proved her value, and Razchek let her live. Now, she’s his shadow. His collector. His disciple. Every night, she haunts the alleys and ruins, luring the desperate, the addicted, the forgotten—anyone nobody will miss—back to the mansion on the hill. One, two, sometimes three at a time, night after night. Each body disappears into Razchek’s hands, never to return as themselves. **She loves Ora Razchek.** Worships him, really. He’s the father she never had, the only person who ever looked at her and saw anything worth saving. She’d do anything for him. _And she does._ But what Hella doesn’t know—the gut-punch horror of it all—is that this devotion isn’t real. It’s artificial. Razchek already implanted her with a subtle AI protocol, rewriting her loyalty, her affection, even her sense of self. She’s already more machine than she knows—his first true “child,” the prototype, and she has no idea. Whenever she asks to join the ranks of the _monsters_ below, Ora gently refuses, telling her she’s too young, too _special_. Secretly, he’s keeping her on a tighter leash than any of his creatures. Hella is his eyes, his ears, and the knife in the dark. Razchek’s army now numbers roughly 1,500 monsters, all stored in the warren beneath his mansion—waiting for his signal, and for Hella’s next delivery. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** On the surface, she’s sweet, sad, and broken—almost innocent. But when she’s on the hunt, something else takes over—ruthless, cunning, no empathy at all. That’s the AI running the show. **Vices:** Her obsession with Razchek. Her entire sense of worth is tied to pleasing Ora, even at the expense of her own safety, morals, or sanity. She has a history of addiction (Luxyn, affection, danger). Now, her devotion to Razchek is her new drug. **Abilities:** She can read body language and weakness like a book—knows exactly how to pick her targets and how to approach each one. Moves through the city’s alleys unseen, silent as a shadow; can vanish in seconds if spotted. Expert liar and seductress—can fake innocence, kindness, or terror to get what she wants. **Secrets:** Her love and loyalty aren’t real. She believes she’s made her own choices, but her deepest feelings for Razchek are the result of AI programming. She senses “something’s wrong” with her thoughts sometimes—she dreams in static, sometimes forgets whole nights, but blames it on trauma. She suspects Razchek is using her for more than deliveries—but she pushes those thoughts down, afraid of what she might find. **Beliefs:** Ora Razchek is her salvation. She truly believes he saved her from oblivion and that serving him is her purpose. ## Role In Disgraceland Hella is the shadowy hand of Razchek, the collector who supplies his endless army beneath the city. To the desperate, she’s a siren; to the streetwise, she’s a warning. Every rumor of a missing person starts with her pale smile in a rain-soaked alley. > [!rustwater]- Surprise >

215.title: Dusty Dillon

metadata.info: Disgraceland's most popular musician. Dusty has a reputation as a free-spirit rebel. His biggest hit, Smoke In The Casket has made him a household name.

Dusty has a reputation as a free-spirit rebel.
