Dusty has a reputation as a free-spirit rebel. His biggest hit, Smoke In The Casket has made him a household name. faction: None role: Rock Star chapters: - tags: - character - individual - protagonist - music --- # DUSTY DILLON > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[dusty.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** **Alias/Nickname:** **Home Location:** [[Gutter Row]] **Public Reputation:** Beloved Rock Star **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** None **Age:** 25 **Height:** 5'11" **Weight:** 154 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 22th of Greensun, 2161 **Occupation:** Musician **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** **Known Associates:** **Faith:** [[Church of the Ember Saint]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“They can silence the radios. They can cut the wires. But they can’t stop the sound of a thousand throats singin’ truth in the dark.”

Born in the furnace-shadowed ruins of [[Steeltown]], **Dusty Dillon** grew up with ash in his lungs and rhythm in his blood. His father, Royce Dillon, was a known hardliner at the mill — refused to pay bribes, refused to work drunk, refused to bow to the local enforcers. When the furnace roof “accidentally” collapsed, Royce died still holding the pick. But Dusty eventually learned the truth: it wasn’t an accident. The collapse was ordered by a mill foreman tied directly to [[Ellis Westmount]], Steeltown’s Duke-appointed mayor and longtime union-buster. That discovery lit something in Dusty. Not just sorrow. Not just rage. Purpose. Music became more than mourning — it became a weapon. At the funeral fire, Dusty sang for the first time. The crowd wept. That night, a song was born that would echo through scrapyards and broken halls for decades: _Smoke on the Casket_. From then on, Dusty walked the path of an outlaw troubadour — performing at black-market clubs, rooftop vigils, even whisper-houses where songs were traded like sacred relics. Every performance carried the heat of loss and the chill of truth. While [[Jaden Kade]] and **[[The Wanderers]]** enjoyed the spotlight — cleaned up and televised on _[[Night Time with Morris Gable]]_ — Dusty’s shows were wild, unsanctioned eruptions of real grief and rebellion. Jaden, who had always thought himself the voice of the people, began to feel eclipsed. Where Jaden had polish, Dusty had soul. Where Jaden followed coded rebellion, Dusty bled on stage and dared people to sing with him. Jaden would never admit it publicly — not under [[The Duke]]’s eye — but privately, he watches Dusty’s rise with a gnawing resentment. Because deep down, he knows: **Dusty Dillon is everything Jaden wishes he still had the courage to be.** ## Personality **Temperament:** Dusty is intense but grounded. He’s not loud offstage — he saves his fire for the mic. Thoughtful, poetic, stubborn as rust. He listens more than he speaks, and when he does speak, people shut up and listen. He doesn’t chase fame — it chases him. There’s grief behind his grin and thunder behind his calm. **Vices:** Whiskey. Regret. Late-night walks alone in dangerous places. He sleeps with fans, but never the same one twice — like he’s scared to leave fingerprints on anyone’s life. He smokes Luxyn occasionally, mostly when the ghosts get too loud. **Abilities:** Charismatic to a fault — he can hold a riot together with three chords and a look. Can fight — grew up scrapping in Steeltown alleys — but prefers words and rhythm over fists. Has an ear for lies. He reads a room like a preacher, feels moods shift before they rise. **Secrets:** His father’s death wasn’t an accident — Dusty has proof that it was ordered by a Steeltown foreman loyal to [[Ellis Westmount]]. **Beliefs:** The Duke’s empire is hollow, and hollow things eventually collapse. ## Role In Disgraceland Dusty Dillon is the most beloved outlaw musician in Disgraceland — a voice of the broken, the bitter, and the brave. His music moves through the regions like wildfire, banned in official channels but sung by the people with trembling fists and tear-filled eyes. ## Smoke In The Casket ![[smoke.mp3]]

216.title: Cassidy LaRue

metadata.info: A talented artist in her own right, Cassidy seems to live in the shadow of her on-again, off-again boyfriend, Jaden Kade.

216.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Cassidy LaRue]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":null,"NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_jcass.jpg","cover":"zz_media/cr.png","religion":"None","status":"Alive","info":"A talented artist in her own right, Cassidy seems to live in the shadow of her on-again, off-again boyfriend, Jaden Kade.","location":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","territory":"[[CHARSPIRE]]","district":"[[CHARSPIRE#Dog City|Dog City]]","faction":"None","role":"[[Jaden Kade]]'s Muse","chapters":["07 - The Spotlight Lies"],"tags":["character","individual","neutral","stillborn-star","music","chapter07"],"created":"2025/05/05 19:34:06","modified":"2025/06/08 17:47:11"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_jcass.jpg cover: zz_media/cr.png religion: None status: Alive info: A talented artist in her own right, Cassidy seems to live in the shadow of her on-again, off-again boyfriend, Jaden Kade. location: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" territory: "[[CHARSPIRE]]" district: "[[CHARSPIRE#Dog City|Dog City]]" faction: None role: "[[Jaden Kade]]'s Muse" chapters: - 07 - The Spotlight Lies tags: - character - individual - neutral - stillborn-star - music - chapter07 --- # CASSIDY LaRUE > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[cassidy.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** **Alias/Nickname:** **Home Location:** Somewhere in [[GUTTER ROW]] **Public Reputation:** Rebellous **Gender:** Female **Spouse:** [[Jaden Kade ]] **Age:** 22 **Height:** 5'5" **Weight:** 115 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 11th of Frozensun, 2164 **Occupation:** Groupie **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[Jaden Kade]] **Known Associates:** [[The Wanderers]] **Faith:** None **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“Fuck you, you bitch! You filthy little gutter rat!” - Cassidy to Soria Langston-Clay

Cass LaRue is the last girl you’re supposed to bring home and the first to drag you out when you should be sleeping. She’s got peroxide-blonde hair hacked off at the chin, eyes like melting chrome, and a laugh that always sounds a little too close to screaming. Born in the gutter-alleys of Gutter Row, she started out running amphetamines for the Calavera Union and wound up singing backup in backroom bands that played for liquor and leftover pills. Cass’s voice is sweet, but her mouth is poison — she’s never learned to back down, never cared to apologize, and never let heartbreak slow her down for more than a night. Cass and Jaden met at a blackout party in a half-collapsed speakeasy, and by dawn they’d broken up twice, kissed four times, and stolen a cop’s boots together. She moves through his life like a storm: always one step ahead of the law, always one drink away from disaster, always looking for the next thrill. She’s Jaden’s biggest mistake and his favorite muse. She feeds his wildest instincts — and he’s never written a better song since she showed up. Some say she’s trouble, some say she’s cursed, but nobody ever forgets her. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Chaotic, impulsive, fearless. Cass laughs at danger, spits at authority, and treats every moment like it’s her last. She’s volatile as hell but can turn soft and affectionate in private — especially when she thinks nobody’s looking. Wildly protective of her friends, but just as likely to screw them over if the mood suits her. **Vices:** Anything that burns, buzzes, or blurs the world — liquor, pills, cheap amphetamines, and raw adrenaline. Gets off on breaking into forbidden places. Never met a drug she wouldn’t try once. Loves starting fights with people twice her size. > [!infobox] > > ![[jadencassidy.png|224]] **Abilities:** Sharp-tongued singer with a voice that can flip from velvet to razor wire. Expert at sneaking, lying, and finding hidden ways into any building in Disgraceland. Knows every fence, runner, and dealer from Steeltown to Charspire. Plays dirty harmonica, mean backup guitar, and can turn a riot into a party — or the other way around. **Secrets:** Cass once double-crossed the Calavera Union on a major drug deal and barely escaped with her life. She’s living under a fake name, and there’s still a bounty out for her — only a handful know her real past. She’s haunted by a year she can’t remember, spent in some “clinic” outside Ashmoor — and every so often, she has gaps in her memory she can’t explain. **Beliefs:** The world is doomed, so live while you can. Trust no one, especially lovers, but die for your friends if you have to. Music is the last honest thing left in Disgraceland, and every note is a middle finger to The Duke. If there’s a hell, it probably looks a lot like home. ## Role In Disgraceland Cass is the fire Jaden can’t quit — muse, partner-in-crime, and sometimes the only thing keeping him from burning out for good. Together, they’re the heartbeat and headache of Disgraceland’s outlaw scene, legends in the making, or on their way to self-destruction. ## Appearances > [!rustwater]- Surprise >
> >

217.title: Geo Huxley
217.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[Geo Huxley]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":null,"NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_geo.png","cover":"zz_media/ja.png","religion":"[[El Santo]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","territory":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","district":"[[Gutter Row#Crossyork|Crossyork]]","info":null,"faction":"None","role":"Private Investigator, owner of [[Geo's P.I.]]","chapters":null,"tags":["character","individual","protagonist","stillborn-star"],"created":"2025/06/09 10:46:26","modified":"2025/06/09 11:13:40"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_geo.png cover: zz_media/ja.png religion: "[[El Santo]]" status: Alive location: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" territory: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" district: "[[Gutter Row#Crossyork|Crossyork]]" info: faction: None role: Private Investigator, owner of [[Geo's P.I.]] chapters: tags: - character - individual - protagonist - stillborn-star --- # GEO HUXLEY > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[geo.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** Owner of Geo's P.I. **Alias/Nickname:** **Home Location:** [[Charspire#Crossyork|Crossyork]], [[CHARSPIRE]] **Public Reputation:** Well liked and trusted **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** **Age:** 37 **Height:** 6'0" **Weight:** 184 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 17th of Bloomsun, 2149 **Occupation:** Private and Independent Investigator **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** **Known Associates:** **Faith:** [[El Santo]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

"If you’re looking for justice, call a preacher. If you want answers, close the door and pour a drink."

[[Geo Huxley]] was born into the ash and clanging chaos of [[Steeltown]], the son of a boilermaker and a mother who vanished when he was nine. He grew up among soot-choked alleys and broken floodlights, learning how to read a room faster than he could read a book. When the mill whistle blew, the screams usually followed. He learned not to flinch. By sixteen, he was drifting through [[Gutter Row]], running petty errands for dealers, junkers, and worse. Never joined a gang. Never pledged to the [[Loyalist Guard]]. Never looked for trouble — but it kept finding him. He was the kind of kid who noticed things others didn’t. The kind of man who didn’t ask questions — until he started. He found his calling the day a half-dead girl collapsed in his doorway. She’d escaped from a transport van near [[Three Nail Market]], beaten and branded. No one was looking for her. No one cared. He got her to safety, tracked the route she came from, and burned the warehouse down with the men still inside. After that, people started coming to him. Missing daughters. Murdered drifters. Loyalist cover-ups. [[Geo Huxley]] never asked for coin upfront — if you were desperate enough to find him, he figured you were already broke. He built his office above a pawnshop in Vileby, and filled the walls with case notes, tattered maps, and the sound of rain hitting busted glass. His reputation grew in the shadows. The man who didn't smile. Who always asked the right question. Who sometimes left with a knife and came back bloody but silent. He doesn’t carry a badge. Doesn’t need to. And he only straps on a sidearm when he knows he’s walking into hell. But he’s walked into hell before — and these days, he walks in without blinking. There’s talk that he’s building something. A private ledger of every quiet atrocity swept under the rug in [[Disgraceland]]. A case too big for any one man. But he keeps at it, one truth at a time, one body at a time, one final answer at the end of the trail. Because [[Geo Huxley]] doesn’t care if justice is dead. He’s chasing ghosts anyway. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Quiet but razor-edged. [[Geo Huxley]] is always two steps ahead in a conversation, watching for the lie behind the eyes. Speaks with deliberate pauses, as if measuring every word for weight and consequence. Doesn’t bluff. Doesn’t rattle. Uses sarcasm like a blade, but never wastes it. Trusts no one, but listens to everyone. **Vices:** Chain-smokes hand-rolled bitterroot cigs. Keeps a bottle of contraband charcoal whiskey under his desk, "for insomnia." Collects unsolved case files and reads them like scripture. Has a self-destructive habit of poking into Loyalist business just to see who twitches. **Abilities:** Exceptional investigator — sharp memory, pattern recognition, and bullshit detection. Knows the city’s underground better than most crime lords. Proficient in knife fighting, ambush tactics, and going completely unnoticed. Keeps an old voice recorder on him to document every case and confession. **Secrets:** Still haunted by a girl he couldn’t save in [[Threshton]] — her name shows up in the margins of every notebook. Once worked briefly for the Loyalists as a contract snitch, before turning on them after uncovering what they did to his handler. There’s a bounty on his head in [[Ashmoor]], quietly authorized by someone high up. **Beliefs:** Justice is dead, but truth still limps around out there — and it matters. The Duke’s world is built on fear, and fear makes people stupid. People don’t need saving, they need someone who’ll walk through fire to find the goddamn matches. ## Role Details **[[Geo Huxley]]** is the unofficial bloodhound of [[Disgraceland]] — a relic of a better conscience. He’s not a revolutionary, not a hero, just a man obsessed with the truth and the cracks where it hides. When a mother loses her son, when a worker vanishes in [[Charspire]], when a Loyalist says it was a suicide but you know better — you go to Geo. He’ll listen. He’ll find them. And if someone’s responsible, they’ll pay.

218.content:

“Lucha's happen all over. We might as well sell some tickets to it.”

[[Flint Garritt]] is the owner of one of the largest mines in [[Charspire]], with his reach extending through scrapyards, foundries, and industrial facilities all across [[TRIBUCIA MAP]]. Everything falls under his banner: **FlintCo** — an empire built from slag, sweat, and grit. He's been locked in bitter competition with [[Jacoban Clay]] for decades. The two men dominate the industrial elite of Disgraceland, yet can barely stand to be in the same room. Clay builds for power and profit; Garritt builds for legacy. They both know there’s only room for one king. A lifelong fan of **Lucha Libre**, Flint revived the long-dead [[World Lucha Libre]] ten years ago, believing that Tribucia’s beaten-down population needed more than just food and fuel — they needed something to believe in. Under his leadership, WLL rose from the ash like an old god, draped in masks and glory. It quickly became one of the only remaining spectacles left in Disgraceland, a roaring echo of the world that was. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Bold and brutal. Charismatic when it suits him, but quick to anger. He commands like a general and negotiates like a gambler. He’s not interested in being liked — he’s interested in being remembered. **Vices:** Smokes too much, drinks even more. Keeps company with fighters, ex-cons, and steelworkers. Rumors swirl about an underground pit-fighting league run through his scrapyards. Probably true. **Abilities:** Expert negotiator and industrial tactician. Has a near-photographic memory for names, debts, and deals. Trained wrestler in his youth — still spars in private. **Secrets:** His end goal is to get Jacoban Clay into the ring. **Beliefs:** Power earned through legacy is stronger than power taken through fear. ## Role In Disgraceland Industrial titan and cultural revivalist. Flint Garritt is the founder of **FlintCo** and the man responsible for resurrecting **World Lucha Libre (WLL)** — giving the people of Tribucia their fight back.

His undefeated reign is the stuff of legend in Disgraceland. chapters: - 01 - Main Event Shadows tags: - character - individual - antagonist - ember-saint - chapter01 - sport --- # BOBBY "THE IRON BULL" CUTMAN > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[cutman.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** [[World Lucha Libre|WLL]] World Champion **Alias/Nickname:** The Iron Bull **Home Location:** Piss Town, [[Gutter Row]] **Public Reputation:** Dangerous, Intimidating, Tough, Violent **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** **Age:** 36 **Height:** 6'6" **Weight:** 344 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 23rd of Searsun, 2150 **Occupation:** Fighter **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** **Known Associates:** **Faith:** [[Church of the Ember Saint]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“I don’t fight for free. I fought for survival once — never again.”

Standing 6'9" and weighing 350 lbs, **[[Bobby Cutman]]** is a mountain in motion — feared, revered, and never beaten. Bald-headed, with a thick black beard like a wall of steel wire, he looks like he was carved out of the mines of [[Charspire]] themselves. Signed by [[Flint Garritt]] nearly a decade ago on size alone, Cutman proved himself more than just muscle. He dominated the inaugural WLL tournament, flattening every opponent in his path. Since that day, he has remained the undefeated champion with a staggering **163-0** record. The people call him *The Iron Bull*, and they don’t say it lightly. He moves like a freight train and hits like one too. Though beloved by fans and children alike, there’s always a hush when he walks into a room — because even in peace, he radiates danger. He is one of the few celebrities left in Disgraceland, a symbol of indestructibility. But when asked to settle a dispute or handle a grudge outside the ring, he simply says: “I only lucha for money now.” --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Calm. Reserved. Intimidating. He rarely speaks and never boasts. His silence speaks louder than any promo. He’s not interested in drama — only dominance. **Vices:** Keeps to himself. Drinks expensive whiskey in private. Occasionally disappears for days with no explanation. Never answers questions about the world before WLL. **Abilities:** Near-unstoppable brute strength. Shockingly fast reflexes for his size. **Secrets:** May have ties to underground pit-fighting circuits in the early post-bomb years. **Beliefs:** The ring is the last honest place in Disgraceland. ## Role In Disgraceland Undisputed champion of the **World Lucha Libre (WLL)**. A living myth in the ring — and a silent warning outside of it. Cutman is what happens when pain meets purpose.

Current #1 contender for the WLL World Championship. role: "[[World Lucha Libre|WLL]] Fighter & #1 Contender" chapters: - 01 - Main Event Shadows - 06 - Showdown In Gage Park tags: - character - individual - protagonist - chapter01 - ember-saint - sport --- # BASTIAN REDD > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[redd.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** [[World Lucha Libre|WLL]] #1 Contender **Alias/Nickname:** Giant Redwood **Home Location:** Bloodroot Canyons, [[Threshton]] **Public Reputation:** Dangerous, Stoic, Tough **Gender:** Male **Spouse:** **Age:** 39 **Height:** 6'8" **Weight:** 325 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 3rd of Searsun, 2147 **Occupation:** Fighter **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** [[World Lucha Libre|WLL]] **Known Associates:** [[Flint Garritt]] **Faith:** [[Church of the Ember Saint]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

“This is the last time. Win or lose, only one of us walks forward.”

**[[Bastian Redd]]** was born beneath the blood-orange sky of the Bloodroot Canyons, where legends say the rocks remember every soul buried in the sand. Orphaned young and raised by wandering kinfolk and quiet storms, he learned to fight not in gyms or rings, but on cliff edges, under torchlight, with nothing but bone and grit. He carries the silence of that land with him — heavy, holy, and unforgiving. Painted in sacred ochre and bearing the sigils of forgotten tribes, Bastian doesn’t just step into the [[World Lucha Libre|WLL]] ring — he _arrives_ like an omen. Wrapped fists. Bare chest. Eyes like fire before a lightning strike. His entrance is a ritual. His opponents don’t just lose — they fall like sinners in a sermon. No music. No pyrotechnics. Just that red pouch swaying on his neck — rumored to contain the ashes of someone important, though no one dares ask who. He’s not chasing fame, belts, or broadcast deals. He’s fighting because something calls him to. Some say it’s ancestral duty. Others think he’s haunted by a vision he won’t speak aloud. One thing is certain: when [[Bastian Redd]] fights, the whole arena feels it in their teeth — like thunder rolling under their ribs. **Bastian Redd** is a towering native of the Bloodroot Canyons, in west [[Threshton]]. Standing 6'8" and weighing 325 lbs, he's a mountain of a man — stoic, scarred, and spiritual. He entered the [[World Lucha Libre|WLL]] late in life after dominating outlaw pits and tribal gauntlets. His presence in the ring is mythic. War drums echo as he walks barefoot through the arena, red ochre paint across his shoulders, chest bare, face marked in ritual. Chanting crowds fall into reverent silence as he steps into the light. He has no entourage. No mask. No gimmicks. Just a purpose. **Record:** 94-3 **Losses:** - One clean loss to [[Bobby Cutman]] in a brutal, close match - One controversial DQ (many call it rigged) — also to Cutman - One early-career loss in an outlaw fight Now, with a third and final title shot sanctioned by [[Flint Garritt]] himself, Bastian returns not just to fight — but to finish something that never ended. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Bastian Redd is slow to speak and quick to move. He’s quiet, focused, and always composed, like a man who’s already visualized every outcome before he steps into the ring. He doesn’t flinch, doesn’t taunt, and doesn’t play for the crowd — he fights like he’s in a sacred rite, because to him, he is. **Vices:** He holds grudges the way others hold breath — deep, long, and silent. He doesn’t trust the [[World Lucha Libre|WLL]] or the business behind it, refusing all sponsorships, public interviews, or endorsements. Off-camera, he lives simply and avoids the spotlight. But those who cross him — especially those who disrespect the ceremony of the fight — don’t get second chances. **Abilities:** Bastian’s strength is raw and terrifying, but it’s his composure that truly breaks opponents. He never rushes. Every strike is intentional, every grapple exact. He can weather pain with inhuman endurance and finish fights in silence. More than once, he’s been accused of fighting in a trance — like he’s somewhere else entirely. **Secrets:** He never speaks of his childhood, but some claim he was trained in a hidden tradition that fuses combat with spiritual vision. He wears a small red leather pouch around his neck at all times — no one knows what’s inside. And before every fight, he vanishes for three days with no explanation, no handlers, no word. **Beliefs:** Bastian believes pain is a sacred offering and that a true fight is a test of spirit, not just muscle. To him, wrestling is not sport — it is war ritual. He sees [[Bobby Cutman]] not as a rival, but as the only man capable of completing the prophecy he believes was given to him by the land itself. He does not fear death in the ring. He expects it. ## Role In Disgraceland Bastian Redd is the immovable force returning to test the unstoppable champion. He’s the only man who’s ever shaken [[Bobby Cutman]] — and in this final match, he intends to bring more than pain. He intends to bring meaning.

NOTE TITLE: [[Ava Victoria]] METADATA:{"obsidianUIMode":"preview","NoteIcon":null,"NoteStatus":"New","thumbnail":"zz_media/th_ava.png","religion":"[[Church of the Ember Saint]]","status":"Alive","location":"[[Gutter Row]]","territory":"[[GUTTER ROW]]","district":"[[GUTTER ROW#Vileby|Vileby]]","faction":"None","role":"[[Lash Hawkins]] girl","chapters":["05 - Sight Unseen"],"tags":["character","individual","protagonist","ember-saint","chapter04"],"created":"2025/05/25 14:46:47","modified":"2025/06/03 10:52:50"} NOTE BLOCK CONTENT: --- obsidianUIMode: preview NoteIcon: NoteStatus: New thumbnail: zz_media/th_ava.png religion: "[[Church of the Ember Saint]]" status: Alive location: "[[Gutter Row]]" territory: "[[GUTTER ROW]]" district: "[[GUTTER ROW#Vileby|Vileby]]" faction: None role: "[[Lash Hawkins]] girl" chapters: - 05 - Sight Unseen tags: - character - individual - protagonist - ember-saint - chapter04 --- # AVA VICTORIA > [!NOTE|clean no-i right]+ ‎Character Portrait > ![[ava.png|400]] ## Overview **Titles:** **Alias/Nickname:** **Home Location:** Vileby, [[Gutter Row]] **Public Reputation:** Unknown **Gender:** Female **Spouse:** None **Age:** 26 **Height:** 5'7" **Weight:** 139 lbs. **Date of Birth:** 11th of Greentide, 2160 **Occupation:** Unknown **Status:** Alive **Affiliation:** **Known Associates:** [[Lash Hawkins]], [[Nico Murray]], [[Ninepack]], [[Shana]] **Faith:** [[Church of the Ember Saint]] **Appearances:** ```dataview list from "DISGRACELAND" where contains(this.chapters, file.name) sort file.name asc ``` --- ## Biography >

"This city's full of ghosts and goddamn scum. I ain't afraid of either."

[[Ava Victoria]] grew up where the saltwater met the sludge in [[Gutter Row]], daughter of a dockside jazz singer and a stevedore who vanished one payday night and never came back. She was raised behind locked doors and smoky curtains, the kind of kid who learned early to clock a man’s intent by the tilt of his glass. The streets gave her steel, the music gave her soul, and the men she didn’t bury gave her lessons. By sixteen, she was running dice tables and patching up bleeding friends with a cigarette hanging off her lip. She was beautiful, sure, but more dangerous than she looked — because she knew the city _saw_ her, and she knew how to use it. She's had offers. The kind that come with diamonds, or contracts. She took none of them. Said she'd rather die on her own feet than live kneeling under someone's dream. Now she floats between scenes — part-time bartender, full-time observer, with her ear to the bricks and her eye on everything. Folks think she’s just another local fixture. But underneath the gold and denim and smirk, there’s a fuse burning short. The moment [[Lash Hawkins]] vanishes, she stops being background. And starts being the storm. --- ## Personality **Temperament:** Calm until she’s not. Holds her tongue like a blade. Doesn’t lash out — she strikes. **Vices:** Cigarettes. Punching men who talk slick. Running toward the gunfire instead of away from it. **Abilities:** Reads a room like scripture. Streetwise, sharp reflexes, fast with a blade and faster with a lie. Can talk her way out of anything, or fight her way out if she prefers. **Secrets:** Once killed a man in another city. Never told a soul. Keeps the ring he was wearing in a velvet pouch in her jacket lining. **Beliefs:** You only get one shot to do right by people. Blood isn’t thicker than loyalty. And no one gets out clean — but some deserve the chance to try. ## Role In Disgraceland Initially appears as a minor figure in Chapter 4, greeting [[Lash Hawkins]] at the pier. But when Lash disappears, Ava becomes the first to notice, the first to care, and the first to start pulling on threads. Eventually, she becomes the reluctant hero of the search.

## 📆 Weekdays

| Real-World Day | Disgraceland Day | Meaning |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Sunday | **Alphaday** | The beginning. Renewal. First step forward. |
| Monday | **Moonday** | A day under the quiet pull of the moon. Planning and reflection. |
| Tuesday | **Temperday** | A day for forging strength: work, training, conflict. |
| Wednesday | **Middleday** | Midpoint of the week. Markets and major decisions. |
| Thursday | **Burnday** | Day of action, fire, conquest. |
| Friday | **Restday** | Intended for recovery and religious observance. |
| Saturday | **Omegaday** | The end of the cycle. Reflection, final judgments. |

---
## 🗓️ Months of the Year

| Real-World Month | Disgraceland Month |
|:--|:--|
| January | **Frostsun** |
| February | **Frozensun** |
| March | **Rainsun** |
| April | **Bloomsun** |
| May | **Greensun** |
| June | **Highsun** |
| July | **Searsun** |
| August | **Redsun** |
| September | **Ambertide** |
| October | **Hollowtide** |
| November | **Dusktide** |
| December | **Whitetide** |

---

## 🌱 Seasons

| Season Name | Months | Description |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **The Silencing** | Whitetide, Frostsun, Frozensun | Frozen world, starvation, death waits. |
| **The Stirring** | Rainsun, Bloomsun, Greensun | Earth thaws, rain and life return. |
| **The Scorching** | Highsun, Searsun, Redsun | Brutal heat, crops burn, survival hardens. |
| **The Withering** | Ambertide, Hollowtide, Dusktide | Crops die, world fades into death. |

---

# 📜 Disgraceland Holidays & Events

---

## 🧊 1st of Frostsun — New Year's Day

**Type:** Survival Celebration  
**Meaning:** Marks the first day of the new year. Unlike pre-fall celebrations, Disgraceland's New Year is grim — a hard-earned survival marker, not a party.  
**Common Practices:** Fires are lit. Families gather quietly if they can. Simple meals are shared. Thanks are given for surviving another brutal year.  
**Cultural Notes:** In poor territories, it's seen as a somber day. In [[Ashmoor]], elites sometimes hold small balls or ceremonies.

---

## 🥊 15th–20th of Rainsun (Every 4 Years) — Noche de Lucha

**Type:** Fighting Tournament  celebrating [[El Santo]]
**Meaning:** A brutal one night, 16 man, single elimination tournament where champions from across Disgraceland battle for the title of **Grand Luchador**.  A festival celebrating [[El Santo]] takes place in the days before and after.
**Common Practices:** Street festivals, underground gambling, regional pride matches.  
**Cultural Notes:** Winning [[Noche de Lucha]] brings instant fame, wealth, and influence. It's the single most-watched event in Disgraceland, broadcast even into the poorest zones.

---

## 🏛️ 14th of Bloomsun — Ashmoor Festival

**Type:** Propaganda Celebration  
**Meaning:** Celebrates the official founding and rebuilding of [[Ashmoor]] by [[The Duke]].  
**Common Practices:** Parades, concerts, speeches praising The Duke and Ashmoor’s prosperity.  
**Cultural Notes:** Mostly celebrated by the rich and loyal. Poorer citizens in other regions see it as a sick joke.

---

## ⚫ 23rd of Searsun — Blackshift Massacre Memorial Day

**Type:** Day of Mourning  
**Meaning:** Remembrance of the workers and miners slaughtered by [[Final Force]] during the [[Blackshift Massacre]].  
**Common Practices:** Silent marches. Black flags hung over doors. Work stoppages (illegal but widespread).  
**Cultural Notes:** Especially honored in [[Charspire]] and [[Steeltown]]. [[Ashmoor]] officials pretend to recognize it but barely mention it.

---

## ☢️ 4th of Ambertide — Anniversary of the Tetra Bomb

**Type:** Global Remembrance  
**Meaning:** Marks the catastrophic detonation of the [[Tetra Bomb]], which ended the [[Water Wars]] but shattered the world.  
**Common Practices:** Bells toll at noon. Some regions observe full-day fasts. Others light black candles in memory.  
**Cultural Notes:** Bitterness, resentment, and anti-Duke sentiment runs high on this day. Guard patrols are quietly doubled in vulnerable cities.

---

## 🌾 30th of Ambertide — Harvest Festival

**Type:** Survival Feast  
**Meaning:** Final harvest feast before The Withering season begins. Families and communities gather to celebrate the earth’s last bounty.  
**Common Practices:** Large feasts. Marriages and pacts often made. Debts are expected to be settled before sundown.  
**Cultural Notes:** If harvests are bad, tensions and violence can break out during or after the festival.

---

## ⚒️ 18th of Hollowtide — Worker's Day (Steeltown & Charspire Only)

**Type:** Labor Honor Day  
**Meaning:** Celebrates the contributions — and exploitation — of laborers who keep Disgraceland functioning.  
**Common Practices:** Speeches, rallies, strikes (often illegal).  
**Cultural Notes:** Only officially recognized in [[Steeltown]] and [[Charspire]]. Heavily monitored. Arrests and disappearances spike after rallies.

---

## 🌑 30th of Hollowtide — Dark Night

**Type:** Forced Anarchy Observance  
**Meaning:** Marks the anniversary of a failed rebellion against [[The Duke]]. As punishment and reminder, all [[Loyalist Guard]]s are ordered to stand down for one night.  
**Common Practices:** Murders, looting, revenge killings, liberations. Citizens barricade themselves inside or participate in the chaos.  
**Cultural Notes:** [[Ashmoor]] remains protected by [[Final Force]]. Everywhere else becomes lawless.  
**Quote:** > "One night of freedom. One lifetime of chains."

---

##  Quick Notes & Ideas

### Current Threads

- The Ashmoor Festival is coming up.
- The Final Reckoning fight is coming up.
- The Unseen Widows, Raina & Risa are hunting General Colt
- The Rustwater Raiders chose to not deliver the slaves. The Duke will be pissed.
- Mark & Lyla Bonetooth maybe flirted a bit.
- Lash Hawkins has been taken by Hella and Ora Razchek and Ava Victoria is trying to find him.
- Salem Quinn had his prophecy and is on his way to warn The Duke
- Veerah had the same prophecy but interpreted it as she needs to kill men.

### Notes:


- Nico goes to the Third Row for help moving Luxyn. Samson and the Row tell Nico that they are loyal to Lash Hawkins and suspect the Murray's to be involved. They won't help them.
- Raina & Risa assassinate General Colt. The Duke is furious and demands a full investigation
- Expand POUNDBALL more
- Raiders in Steeltown
- Ashmoor Festival
- Final Reckoning

- [[Bastian Redd]] will return as one of [[Ora Razchek]]'s A.I monsters.

- [[Hella]] is [[The Grim Man]]'s long lost sister. 

- Electricity is controlled by [[The Duke]].  
  
- Slavery is legal in Disgraceland, but loathed by the citizens. Slavery isn’t race-centric. Anybody can be a slave if born into it, sentenced to it, agreed to be purchased (which people would do for money for their families.), etc.

- Fuel is sold by The Duke only, though theft is a problem for him. The Duke recently began a large tax on the fuel he sells to his citizens. Hurting an already poor populace.  
  
- Most of Disgraceland is dirty and poor. With families living in make-shift homes or moving into old ruins.  
  
- Over the years construction and rebuilding has occurred, but The Duke focused most of the funds on Ashmoor and his home territory.  
  
- The Duke has insisted every residence have one Duke issued standard crt television that only broadcasts messages from The Duke. When the broadcast isn’t live, It’s showing images of The Duke.  

- The Duke’s Loyalist Guards have begun cracking down on dissenters and protestors more lately. People have gone missing and things are getting tense.

- There is a daily newspaper handled by a small printshop in Gutter Row. The Duke allows it because the owner has agreed to not speak poorly of The Duke. It’s called the Tribucia Tribute.

- Food is rationed to each family, or single person, twice a week at local markets sponsored by The Duke. It is illegal to grow your own food. Food is forcibly purchased at huge discounts from the Rancher Collective.
  
- CRT TV’s get hi-jacked by rebels at some point. Maybe Wrecking Crew? Not sure yet.

- CRT TV’s maybe sometimes flash random images of something?

- There’s a location somewhere with mysterious qualities.

#### Overall Outline
- Political turmoil spreads across Disgraceland as [[The Duke]] raises already high taxes on basic necessities like fuel and food. The Duke and his wealthy, elite circle get richer as the people struggle and get poorer. Deals start to be made behind [[The Duke]]s back and when he finds out, [[The Duke]] cracks down hard. Causing a rebellion in [[Charspire]] that spreads to [[Gutter Row]]. The [[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]] and the [[Rustwater Raiders]] make an uneasy alliance to stop The Duke's [[Loyalist Guard]] and protect the people. Civil War breaks out in [[Charspire]] and [[Gutter Row]] officially.

- [[Rachel Gold]] will discover secret documents claiming [[The Duke]] will sign an act declaring any undesirables as slaves from henceforth.

- [[Salem Quinn]] and [[Prophet Veerah]] will have the same vision of the A.I. Frankensteins. Quinn believes it's a warning and is trying to warn [[The Duke]]. Veerah believes it's a prophecy and she is being instructed to kill men to bring the return of [[Faith of Mirella|Mirella]].

- [[Bobby Cutman]] kills [[Bastian Redd]] in their rematch. [[Abel May Jr.]] signs with [[World Lucha Libre]] and agrees to fight Cutman. May Jr. is also challenged by Raider [[Blacktide Cray]]. [[Bastian Redd]]'s body disappears after the fight.

- [[Morris Gable]] is assassinated on live tv by [[Hella]] or [[The Grim Man]], maybe?

- [[The Grim Man]] assassinates [[Gorren Brile]]

- Someone, maybe [[Emily Burton]] will assassinate [[The Duke]] and claim power for themselves. 

- In the finale, [[Ora Razchek]] will release his army of A.I-Frankensteins that include a dead [[Bastian Redd]] to unleash hell on a warring nation. Indiscriminately killing everyone. Ora and [[Hella]] will arrive at [[The Silo]] and murder whoever The Duke/Duchess is at the time. Claiming [[TRIBUCIA MAP]] as their dark world.

226.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[OUTLINES]]

METADATA:{"cover":"zz_media/002.png","tags":["title"],"created":"2025/05/13 20:12:44","modified":"2025/06/09 18:11:04"}

NOTE BLOCK CONTENT:

(cont'd) ## Chapter 3 - The Devil In The Row
  
  - ### **Part 1**: 
    Shana, the owner of Hollow House takes a break from managing her girls and steps out back for a cigarette in the night air. Two clearly drunk loyalist guards appear acting like assholes and ask her for a smoke and start harrassing Shana, but Shana is cool and confident and does what she can to try and calm things. Eventually one of them grabs Shana and she slaps him. The other guard grabs her and starts threatening her. Both guards drag Shana down deeper into the alley, covering her mouth as she tries to scream. 
  - ### **Part 2**: 
  Behind a dumpster the guards toss Shana, who immediately stands up and attacks but is quickly overpowered. The guards laugh and mock her as they rip at her clothes and grab at her body. They discuss what they're going to do to her and pretend to play a game as to who will take her first. Suddenly a loud CLANG is heard. The guards quickly turn their heads and see The Grim Man, standing motionless about 20 feet away in the alley holding his chain, the long spike of it resting on the ground. The guards are nervous but try to mock Grim Man, who just stands there. Finally the guards let go of Shana and stand up to face the Grim Man. They run their mouths at him and pump themselves up before slowly taking steps towards Grim Man. Grim Man just watches them advance. 
  - ### **Part 3**: 
In a flash Grim Man launches his chain spike at one of the guards, instantly impaling through his eye. The other guard freezes in shock for a moment but quickly draws his gun and fires at Grim Man. Grim Man jumps behind another dumpster as the Guard yells at him. The guard slowly advances with his gun drawn to the dumpster, finally he looks behind it but Grim Man isn't there. The guard turns around quickly but Shana is there and kicks him square in the nuts. The guard falls. Grim Man appears behind Shana and Shana gasps in fright but Grim Man just grabs the other guard, takes the guards own cuffs and cuffs the guard before throwing him into the dumpster. 
  - ### **Part 4**: 
  Shana watches the Grim Man for a moment. Finally Grim Man looks over at Shana and stops. Shana slowly steps towards him and thanks him for saving her. Grim Man nods. Shana says she has heard about him but didn't think he was real. Says people in Gutter Row call him the Grim Man. She says he's something this hell hole needs. - a person doing whats right. Shana tells him she owes him now and if he ever needs a favor to come find her. Grim Man nods again and disappears into the shadows as Shana watches him go.
  
  ---
  
## Chapter 4 - White Gold
  
  - ### **Part 1**: 
    Lash Hawkins waits, cool and calm near the Three Nail Market in Gutter Row for Nico Murray to show. Eventually Nico walks up with two girls on his arms. Lash and Nico exchange phony pleasantries before Nico asks why Lash called him out here. Lash tells Nico he's out. He's not going to be selling for the Murray Boys anymore. Lash tells Nico he's learned over the years how to manufacture his own, and recent batches are testing even more pure than Murray Luxyn. Nico is furious, telling Lash he's making a huge fuckin mistake. Does Lash realize that puts him in direct competition on the streets with The Murray Boys? Lash just grins at him, infuriating Nico even more. Nico swings at Lash but Lash is too quick and ducks, quickly slapping Nico hard in the face, telling him to smarten up, embarrassing him in front of the girls. Nico, incensed, leaves.
  - ### **Part 2**:
  Nico arrives back at the Murray House and tells Rosa and Marco, his parents, what has happened. Rosa says she never trusted that boy and Marco says he'll send word to Francis to let him know. Marco tells Nico scum like Lash will be dealt with. Marco patienly pulls on a cigar and tells Nico to settle down and remember nobody wins against the Murrays. Marco tells Nico to make contact with the leader of the Third Row gang, Samson Knight, see about brokering a meeting. Maybe having the Third Row sell Luxyn for them right out of the Three Nail Market.
- ### **Part 3**:
  Inside an unassuming shack somewhere inside Gutter Row, Lash works in his homemade lab, Night Time with Morris Gable is on the small television as Lash cooks up a fresh batch of Luxyn. Lash turns and watches Morris Gable deliver some monologue jokes as he lights up a cigarette and chuckles at the tv. There is a *ding* and Lash opens a small glass container, omitting a steam and looks at his latest batch of Luxyn, smiling widely at it. He holds it up and studies the faint glowing properties for a moment before commenting "This about to me my town now." Lash looks around for another baggy to stash it but realizes he is out. He puts things down, throws on his jacket and walks out into the cool night, locking his homemade lab shut behind him as he ventures out to the shops open at this time in the Three Nail Market.
- ### **Part 4**:
Lash walks alone down the quiet cobblestone streets in disrepair, lighting up another cigarette and plotting how best to build his empire. He passes a group of people he knows and smiles, slapping hands with them and hugging one of the girls. Lash says he'll catch them on his way back, he's just running to the shop. Lash walks on and turns down some more streets, finally he comes to a quiet corner and turns the corner. Hella is standing there about 10 feet in front of him, smiling. Lash looks at her and freezes. Lash tries to play it cool but Hella just stares at him and grins. Lash starts to get freaked out a bit and takes a step forward to get around Hella, but Hella steps in front of him. Lash warns Hella one more time but suddenly Hella spits a mist of green liquid from her mouth into Lash's face. Lash yells but falls over, unconscious. Hella looks down at Lash as she pulls out a rope.

(cont'd) ## Chapter 5 - Sight Unseen
  
  - ### **Part 1**: 
Deep in the marshes of The Drownlands, the Unseen Widow twins, Raina & Risa quietly hunt a boar foraging in the thick bush. They communicate just with their eyes and hand signals as they move to surround the boar. The boar is unaware of their presence. Slowly, Risa pulls a bow from her back and hooks an arrow up to it, launching the arrow directly into the boar. The Boar wails and runs but Raina pounces on it quickly, slicing her blade across it's throat in one quick motion. The twins are pleased as they pack the animal up. Talking about how it will be good to honor the god Mirella with a boar feast. 
They walk through the bush and return to where Riley Thorne is waiting, Riley tells the twins they did great and they are almost ready. The twins are pleased.

- ### **Part 2**:
Raina, Risa and Riley all return to the compound and are greeted by Len Vyne. Len tells the other girls to come quickly as Prophet Veerah has had another vision and has gathered the sisters. All four make their way to the sermon stand where Prophet Veerah stands looking out at about a dozen girls. Veerah sees Riley and the twins and smiles, asking them to come in. They enter and Veerah begins a monologue on the vision she had in her sleep. The vision was of a point in the near future where Ora Razchek's AI Frankenstein monsters are attacking an unknown part of Tribucia, killing indiscriminately. All Veerah sees are the monsters attacking but she has no context as she is unaware of the existence of Ora or the monsters. Because of that, she attributes her vision to the goddess Mirella and interprets it as Mirella telling Veerah that war will come to destroy everything unless Veerah and the widows stop it. 

- ### **Part 3**
After Veerah's sermon, she is in her cabin as Riley and Raina & Risa enter. Veerah asks them to sit and they do. Veerah asks Riley if the twins are ready and Riley says she believes they are. Veerah asks the twins directly if they are ready. Raina and Risa say yes. Veerah says good. Veerah stands and tells the twins to follow her. They exit the cabin with Riley following and wander down a small path until they reach a clearing on a small cliff overlooking The Drownlands. Veerah walks to a small cauldron and adds mud, grass, tree bark, bits of earth. She mixes it as she speaks. Telling them that this is the body of Mirella, that the godess Mirella is one with the land and air and sea and is everything and everywhere. Veerah asks the twins if they pledge their lives to Mirella. The twins say yes and Veerah fills two small cups with the contents of the cauldron and hands the twins a cup each. She tells them to consume the body of Mirella and once complete they will become Unseen. The twins do. Veerah and Riley are pleased. Veerah says they are now Unseen. Veerah then tells them that to become a Widow, they must first each kill one man.

- ### **Part 4**
A short time later, Raina, Risa and Riley Thorne are coming out of a clearing on the edge of The Drownlands. To their east is Grave Bay. They notice the Black Marauder sailing out in the bay in the direction of Steeltown. To their west is the Loyalist Guard Base. The group make their way along the edge of the Loyalist Base they hide and watch General Colt command a squad through multiple intense drills. They see Colt grab a whip and start beating a recruit who failed the drill apparently. The group watches him and Raina and Rise decide he will be their first kill.

(cont'd) ## Chapter 6 - Showdown In Gage Park
  
  - ### **Part 1**
A fisherman at the docks in Gage Park, Steeltown is packing up for the day, saying goodnight to friends, etc, when he notices the Black Marauder pirate ship in the Rustwater Bay. He watches it nervously for a time and realizes it is headed for the docks. He yells and people begin to notice the approaching vessel. Women grab up children and hurry them off, fishermen scurry to get out of the water and away from the docks. The first fisherman begins to run, passing by people, one of his friends from earlier bumps into him and he tells his friend he's going to inform the Wrecking Crew of the impending appearance of the Rustwater Raiders.
  
  - ### **Part 2**
On the Black Marauder, Blacktide Cray, Lyla Bonetooth and Silas Vayne stood watching the shores of Gage Park, watching the people panicking and fleeing. Blacktide says this may have been a bad idea. Silas is sure that the Wrecking Crew are going to attack them. Blacktide agrees with Silas and says we need to prepare for a fight. Salt-Eye Marloow enters and Lyla asks him how the slaves are doing. Salt-Eye says they're hangin' on, but the girl, the little one has a right bad fever. This news hits Lyla like a gutpunch, as she does not want to be moving slaves at all. Lyla orders Salt-Eye to bring the girl anything she needs. Zadie Adeyemi enters and asks Captain Bonetooth what her orders are. Lyla looks at her crew and watches the shore some more. Lyla sighs. Finally Lyla says that her and Blacktide Cray will take a dingy into shore alone, with a white flag raised and speak to the Wrecking Crew themselves. Silas is not happy about this and says the Crew will kill them, Zadie agrees with Silas, saying it's a suicide run. Lyla asks Blacktide what he thinks and Blacktide tells her that where she goes, he goes. Lyla says it's settled and to prepare the dingy.

  - ### **Part 3**
  Inside the Wrecking Crew clubhouse, Jimmy Douglass, Mark Jeffrey and Selena Matissao are sitting and watching a trashflick film comedy. Jimmy thinks it's dumb but Mark is laughing his ass off at the movie and Selena is just enjoying Mark's reactions. Behind them Abel May Jr and Rodney Blythe are playing a tense game of Sliver when there is a frantic banging on the front doors. The crew look at each other before Rodney Blythe, the large red head bodyguard of the Crew walks to the door and answers. The fisherman is standing there panting breathlessly, desperately trying to communicate. Rodney watches the man and gets annoyed and assumes he's high on Luxyn or something until Katie Kowalski, the doctor of the Crew comes over and calmly introduces herself to the fisherman. The fisherman composes himself enough and explains to Rodney and Katie that the Black Marauder is pulling into the Rustwater Bay. Katie looks shocked, Rodney turns back inside and motions for Jimmy & Mark. Jimmy comes over and Rodney repeats what the fisherman said. Mark & Jimmy look at each other. Mark gets up and rings the big bell, signaling for the crew to assemble. The other members, Joe Ameen comes in from the garages, Lincoln Jones from his room and the rest. Jimmy stands in front of them, with Mark at his side. Jimmy tells them what the Fisherman said. Jimmy says the pirates are crossing boundries they know they shouldn't be crossing. Jimmy says if the Raiders want a war, we'll give them one. Mark tells the group to keep their heads and don't fire until word from either him or Jimmy. Mark tells the Crew it's time to ride out. Outside Jimmy, Mark, Abel, Selena, Rodney, Lincoln, Joe & Katie all get on and warm up their bikes before riding off to the Gage Park docks.

  - ### **Part 4**
The Wrecking Crew arrive on their motorcycles at the crest overlooking the docks as people part to let them pass and watch their protectors get to work. - Mark tells Selena Matissao to deal with the crowd. Selena gets the attention of the people and tells them for their safety they should leave the area. Selena's good with crowd control. - Jimmy Douglass and Lincoln Jones stand at the crest watching the Black Marauder out in the water. They're discussing the purpose of the unannounced visit when Jimmy notices something in the water. They look closer and see it's the dingy carrying Lyla and Blacktide. A white flag flying off of it. Jimmy calls Mark over. - Jimmy and Mark and Lincoln stand there watching the dingy get closer. They wonder if this is a trap or a set up of some kind. Finally Jimmy turns back and gathers the Crew. - The crew gather around Jimmy. Jimmy tells them that it looks like a dingy with two people are headed towards us. A white flag flying. Abel says it could be a trap. Everybody agrees. - The dingy is near the beach now so Jimmy, Mark and Abel May Jr. head down. As they're walking Abel mentions to them that Flint Garritt has invited Abel to the Final Reckoning fight as Flint's personal guest. Mark and Jimmy are shocked. Abel tells them Flint came to him the night of the confrontation between Abel and Bobby and offered him a contract. Abel tells them he hasn't signed it, but hasn't thrown it away either. Abel says he's thinking of going. Jimmy says it's not safe for him to go alone. Mark agrees, says the Wrecking Crew rides together. - The dingy pulls into the beach and Lyla and Blacktide step out about 100 yards away from Mark, Jimmy & Abel. For a time, both sides just glare at each other. Finally Lyla and Blacktide begin walking forward. Jimmy looks up and signals to the other crew members watching from the top of the crest and Jimmy, Mark & Abel begin walking too.

229.title: OUTLINES
229.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[OUTLINES]]

METADATA:{"cover":"zz_media/002.png","tags":["title"],"created":"2025/05/13 20:12:44","modified":"2025/06/09 18:11:04"}

NOTE BLOCK CONTENT:

(cont'd) - ### **Part 5**
The two sides move closer towards each other across the open beach. - Finally once eveybody is close, Mark stops about 20 paces behind and Jimmy and Abel walk to Lyla and Blacktide. - Jimmy says "You must be Lyla Bonetooth." Lyla corrects him and says it's Captain Lyla Bonetooth. Lyla says it's a pleasure to finally meet the legend Jimmy Douglass himself face to face. - Abel and Blacktide have stared at each other the whole time. - Jimmy tells Lyla her reputation preceeds her but it's an honor. Lyla commends Jimmy on leading Steeltown towards independence against The Duke. - Jimmy asks Lyla what she's doing here. Lyla eyes Jimmy for a moment, but tells him she is there for a favor. And since the Wrecking Crew didn't attack the moment The Raiders pulled into the bay, you might as well hear us out. - Abel and Blacktide continue to stare at each other. - Jimmy is surprised that the Rustwater Raiders need help from anybody. Lyla tells him it isn't help for them. It's help for the slaves on their ship. - Jimmy gets serious and asks what she means. - Lyla tells Jimmy that The Duke summoned the Raiders to The Silo in order for the Raiders to secretely deliver a group of slaves to Steeltown. - Jimmy is shocked. Jimmy says Slavery is outlawed in Steeltown. Lyla says she knows. - Jimmy demands to know who bought the slaves but Lyla says The Duke didn't tell her. - Abel and Blacktide continue to glare at each other. - Lyla tells Jimmy she feels the same way about slaves. She tells him that they came in here this way, making a grand entrance, so the Crew would know that we're not here for a fight. We're here to talk. - Jimmy asks Lyla what she wants him to do. Lyla says she wants the Crew to take the slaves from them. - Jimmy says if he takes them he's going to free them. Lyla says she knows. Jimmy says this will put a target on her back. Lyla says she knows that too. - Abel and Blacktide continue to glare at each other. - Jimmy turns from Lyla and calls over Mark Jeffrey. Jimmy introduces Mark to Lyla. Mark says it's an honor to meet Lyla Bonetooth. Lyla corrects him and says it's Captain Lyla Bonetooth. Mark smiles and apologizes. Lyla smiles back at Mark. - Jimmy tells Mark that the Raiders are here with slaves. Mark suddenly gets serious and says slavery ain't legal here. Jimmy fills Mark in and says they're going to take them and free them. - Abel and Blacktide stare. - Jimmy tells Mark to get the rest of the Crew. Mark notices Abel and Blacktide staring at each other and asks them what the hell is going on. - Abel says Blacktide is staring at him. Blacktide says Abel is staring at him! - Jimmy, Lyla and Mark watch as the big men argue about who is staring at who. - Finally Mark says he'll go get the others and leaves. - Lyla turns to Blacktide and tells him to settle down. - Jimmy looks Abel, who also backs off a bit. - Lyla tells Jimmy that Mark is amusing. Jimmy rolls his eyes and tells her if she only knew... - Lyla signals to the Black Marauder. After a time another dingy appears with a group of discheveled looking slaves on it. - The Wrecking Crew roll up and watch the slaves approaching. Jimmy introduces the Crew to Lyla. Katie especially is a fan of Lyla. Telling her that Lyla is an inspiration for women in Disgraceland. Lyla tells Katie that she is too. Katie is flattered Lyla even knows who she is. Lyla tells Katie that the Wrecking Crew is known in every corner of Disgraceland. - The slave dingy lands on the beach and Katie, Selena and Lincoln race over and help them. Katie being the doctor gets right to work. - The Crew members work on getting the slaves looked after. - Lyla walks over to Mark and says it was an honor to meet him and thank him for his help today. Mark smiles at Lyla and says she's welcome. Mark tells her that if she ever comes across slaves, she can bring them here and the Wrecking Crew will protect them. And Lyla, if needed. Lyla looks at Mark and knows he means it. - Lyla then moves to Jimmy and thanks him for his help. Jimmy nods and wishes her luck and they shake hands. - Lyla and Blacktide board the dingy. They watch the Wrecking Crew ride off. - Blacktide asks Lyla what she thought of the Crew. Lyla says they weren't what she expected. Blacktide says he wants to beat the fuck out of the "big one."

230.content:

(cont'd) ## Chapter 7 - The Spotlight Lies
  
  - ### **Part 1**
At TTV Studios in Gravenwild, Charspire Morris Gable is preparing for that nights taping of Night Time with Morris Gable. He's at his desk on the main stage going over the notes. Morris is upset over a specific piece the station manager Owen McCready handed him. Owen tells Morris that it's a directive straight from The Duke's office. Morris is annoyed at The Duke's constant interference in his program but also knows where his bread is buttered, so goes along with everything. On the other end of the stage, the house band, The Wanderer's are tuning up. Their lead singer, Jaden Kade is watching Morris yelling at Owen. Jaden notices that Morris kept looking in his direction as Morris and Owen were talking. Owen tells Morris to do a dry-run on the new script pages and steps back. Morris turns on his stage persona and begins to read the new page The Duke insists be added. The page is detailing the upcoming Ashmoor Festival. Listing games, prizes, festivities, entertainment and so on, and ends noting there will be a special performance by The Wanderers. Jaden Kade and The Wanderers are shocked, being very anti-establishment they had no intention of attending. "Are you fucking kidding me?!" Jaden yells across the stage.
 
  - ### **Part 2**
Immediately Jaden Kade is pissed. He starts yelling at Owen McCready who pleads with Jaden that the directive came right from The Duke. Jaden tells Owen that he doesn't play music for fascists. Owen tells him he does every night. What, Jaden doesn't think fascists watch Night Time too? Jaden tells Owen The Wanderer's won't be at the Ashmoor Festival. Jaden says he thought the agreement was he'd play music for the show only. If he knew he'd be outsourced to propaganda parties he never would have taken the job. Owen tells him to take it up with The Duke because there is nothing he can do and he's sorry. He knows this goes against Jaden's principals. Owen tells Jaden to take some advice and just perform at the festival and make The Duke happy. No need to cause trouble. Jaden just shakes his head. Morris Gable was sitting at his desk watching Jaden yelling at Owen as he smoked on his cigar. He rubbed his temples and complained that he's getting too old for this shit. The Wanderer's did their job well as the house band but Jaden Kade was a bit too wild for the easy viewing program Morris strived to cultivate. Finally Morris yelled over that Owen was right and Jaden should just play the festival and move on. Jaden tells Morris to fuck off and that he's the biggest fucking sell-out in this building. Morris gets up and starts yelling back about how he's kept peace between the citizens and The Duke for almost a decade! What he does here at Night Time is important to the people! And if Jaden could pull his head out of his fucking ass for 5 seconds and think of something other than himself maybe he'd see that! Jaden yells back that Morris does his best to keep this whole nation subdued and under the thumb of the oppressive Duke. Jaden says Morris is a talking head for fascism and nothing more. Morris says the citizens deserve one hour of their day where they don't have to think about how awful their life is! Jaden sighs as he knows Morris has a point.

  - ### **Part 3**
  The door to the studios open and Warren Scottyard, the anchor for TTV Evening News walks onto the stage and says they can hear the yelling from the studio next door and if everything is alright over here? Morris tells his friend Warren that everything is good. They just received some "surprising" news is all. Warren leans closer to his friend Morris and asks if he needs any help dealing with "that one", motioning to Jaden. Morris sighs and tells Warren that Jaden reminds him of himself when he was that age. An idealistic entertainer, just trying to do right by people. Warren tells Morris people watch his show not out of obedience but because people genuinely love Morris. Morris thanks Warren and tells him sometimes he forgets that. Morris asks Warren what is on tap for the TTV Evening News tonight. Warren tells Morris "Loyalist guard and some whore dead in Gutter Row. Looks like some ritualistic killing or some such. And some dead-beat Luxyn dealer's gone missin' apparently." Morris sighs and smiles at Warren, they shake hands, Morris and Warren agree to have dinner soon and Warren leaves. Owen returns and asks Morris if he's ready for the full rehearsal. Morris says fine but both of them notice Jaden is gone. Owen says "Ember fuckin' damnit. This fuckin' kid." Morris asks how they're going to do the show with no music. Owen says he'll go talk to the rest of The Wanderers and see if they know where Jaden is. Morris goes back to his desk, smoking his cigar and reading over script notes when Owen returns saying Jaden isn't with the rest of the band and they don't know where he is. Morris is pissed off and says someone find Jaden's girlfriend, Cassidy LaRue.

231.title: OUTLINES
231.content:
NOTE TITLE: [[OUTLINES]]

METADATA:{"cover":"zz_media/002.png","tags":["title"],"created":"2025/05/13 20:12:44","modified":"2025/06/09 18:11:04"}

NOTE BLOCK CONTENT:

(cont'd) - ### **Part 4**
  High up on the rooftop of TTV Studios, Jaden Kade and his girlfriend Cassidy LaRue are in sitting in a spot that overlooks Gravenwild. A spot they've come to before. Cassidy pulls out the little baggy of Luxyn and tells Jaden that it's new stuff called "Lash's Glow" and is the strongest shit she has ever had. Jaden takes the baggy and bumps out a little line across Cassidy's mirror. He runs his nose across the fine white powder and throws his head back as the Luxyn hits his brain. He feels good. He feels better than good. He feels invincible. His eyeballs start to glow white. Cassidy smiles at him and says he looks cute when he glows. Cassidy sets up her own line and runs her nose across it, laughing as she does. Jaden and Cassidy sit there watching the city, eyes glowing high. Jaden tells Cassidy that The Duke is forcing him to perform at the Ashmoor Festival. Cassidy says fuck that and to ditch it and come be with her. Jaden says he just might do that. Jaden calls Owen and Morris two old, out of touch fuck-faces. Cassidy says if he hates it maybe he should leave the show. Jaden says he thinks that everyday, but then every Restday his slugs (money) come in and he tells himself just one more week. Cassidy tells Jaden he doesn't need the slugs, that they'd get by just fine. Maybe The Wanderer's could go on tour. Jaden and Cassidy do another bump of Luxyn. Eyes glowing even brighter. Jaden wonders if he keeps performing on Night Time, will he eventually become an old, out of touch fuck-face like Morris Gable. Cassidy laughs and kisses him. She tells him that she won't let that happen. The two laugh and make out, high on luxyn, eyes glowing. Suddenly there's a voice. "Well now. Isn't that a sweet tune." Cassidy and Jaden quickly look up and see Scumbag (Scumbag is a murderous psychopath, like The Joker.).

  - ### **Part 5**
Immediately at the sight of Scumbag, Jaden Kade stands upright, blocking the path between Cassidy and Scumbag. Jaden, eyes still glowing white, tells Scumbag he needs to get the fuck outta here. Scumbag laughs at him. He mentions how he doesn't usually find other people on the rooftops. Scumbag likes to think of the rooftops as his domain. Jaden asks him what the fuck he's talking about. Scumbag makes a joke about how he's babbling on again. Scumbag watches Jaden for a moment and it finally dawns on Scumbag that Jaden Kade is the lead singer of The Wanderers! Scumbag mock fan-girls out for meeting Jaden Kade. Scumbag says it's such a shame the beautiful music of The Wanderer's has to end tonight. Cassidy asks what that means. Scumbag says well since they've seen him, he can't let them leave, just like that. Cassidy starts to panic. Scumbag says to not blame him, he's just a product of the environment he grew up in, or so he's been told. Jaden tries to reassure Cassidy and says Scumbag has to get through him first. Scumbag suddenly goes serious and asks if Jaden is challenging him. Jaden looks at Scumbag, defiant, and says 'Take it any way you want, freak-show.' Scumbag says he chooses to take it as a challenge then. Scumbag raises his machete and steps at Jaden, but Jaden, holding the baggy of Lash's Glow, throws the powder into Scumbag's face. Scumbag is blinded by the Luxyn and Jaden throws his whole body into the larger Scumbag, sending Scumbag sprawling to the ground. Jaden quickly turns to Cassidy and grabs her, telling her to run. Cassidy runs past the downed Scumbag and to the door, as Jaden follows, Scumbag grabs his ankle. Jaden tries to fight him off but Scumbag gets back to his feet and begins hammering at Jaden with powerful fists. Jaden stunned, but tough in his own right, fights back. Blocking blows and throwing his own shots. Scumbag is laughing the whole time. Scumbag lunges for his machete and grabs it before Jaden can. Scumbag mocks Jaden and says "songs over." Scumbag gets serious and holds the machete high before a gunshot rings out over the rooftop. Scumbag and Jaden turn quickly and see Morris Gable standing there with Cassidy holding a smoking gun, pointed at Scumbag. Cassidy runs over to Jaden and Scumbag quickly darts into the shadows. Morris yells for him to stop but Scumbag has seemingly jumped off the roof and disappeared. 

  - ### **Part 6**
Minutes before showtime, people are busy backstage getting last minute details sorted before Night Time goes on the air at midnight. Jaden Kade is sitting in a small chair as a woman applies make-up to his wounds from the fight with Scumbag. Morris Gable comes over and asks Jaden how he is. Jaden says he's okay. Jaden stands up and extends his hand to Morris and thanks him for saving his ass tonight. Morris nods and shakes Jaden's hand. Morris tells Jaden the camera's won't cut to him too much tonight but the make-up looks great anyway, so he'll be okay on air. Morris asks Jaden if he knew who that guy (meaning Scumbag) was. Jaden says No. Jaden says if he ever sees him again he's going to kill him. In a small room somewhere, lit up only by a television a man in the shadows stares at the television. The voiceover is announcing that nights show and guests before Morris Gable is introduced. Morris announces The Wanderers and Scumbag steps from the shadow glaring menacingly at the television as Jaden Kade is shown playing guitar. Scumbag looks incensed and mutters, "Oh I'm comin' for you now, boy."

## Affiliation
- [[El Santo]] Faith
- Title: **Grand Mascara** (157th holder)

## Summary
The **Grand Mascara** is the supreme spiritual leader of the [[El Santo]] faith, a secretive and powerful figure chosen by the High Council, known as the Senior Enmascarados, upon the death of the previous leader. His true identity is unknown to the public. He is both revered and feared.

## Appearance
- Wears flowing white and silver ceremonial robes with golden accents
- Always masked in a traditional silver luchador mask
- Draped in a dark silver cape
- Carries an amulet engraved with the sacred mask symbol of El Santo

## Known Traits
- Never removes his mask in public
- Charismatic, solemn, and unwavering
- Commands respect across all of [[DISGRACELAND]]
- Speaks with deliberate conviction
- Treats the mask as sacred — to remove it is to surrender the faith

## Beliefs and Teachings
- "To wear the mask is to carry the burden of the people."
- Preaches **strength in the face of oppression**
- Encourages followers to help the less fortunate and defend the weak
- Believes the mask makes all equal — rich, poor, noble, or slave

## Succession
- The Grand Mascara is chosen only upon death
- Selection process handled in secret by the Senior Enmascarados
- The chosen one disappears from public life and is reborn as **Mascara**

## Current Status
- The 157th Grand Mascara
- Believed to have been appointed shortly after the Long Winter
- Seen occasionally at major temples or during sacred rites
- Suspected to have political influence beyond the church

## Notes
- Rumors circulate that he was once a champion luchador before taking the vows
- Some say he speaks to the Mask of Santo itself
- The phrase **“The Mask Endures”** is often associated with his rule

# Chapter 01: 

#### _Temperday Afternoon, 1st of [[CALENDAR|Bloomsun]], 2186_

> When the [[World Lucha Libre|WLL]] brings its blood-soaked spectacle to [[Steeltown]], tensions explode as undefeated champion **[[Bobby Cutman|Bobby “The Iron Bull” Cutman]]** disrespects the crowd, the city, and the **[[Steeltown Wrecking Crew]]**. As security duty turns personal, **[[Abel May Jr.]]** steps up and steals the spotlight, triggering a ferocious standoff that nearly ignites a riot. But while the world watches [[Bobby Cutman]] rage, a shadowy offer is made — and behind the scenes, something far more dangerous is watching both men from the dark. Glory, power, and legacy hang in the balance… and in Disgraceland, not every fight ends in the ring.

"... and Cutman stares at Abe like he's lookin at [[El Santo]] and [[El Santo]] had better traps than him." The room howled. [[Rodney Blythe]], beer in hand, slapped the bar top. [[Mark Jeffrey]] held up his drink, his grin wide and careless. [[Selena Matissao]], sitting beside him, didn’t toast so much as leaned a bit closer to Mark, brushing his shoulder with hers, smiling sideways at her boys. It wasn’t just noise—it was connection. That rare kind of bond forged from years of near-deaths, busted knuckles, and shared silences. People who'd bled together and knew how to laugh about it afterward. [[Abel May Jr.|Abel]] felt it in the room like a heartbeat under the floorboards. A home where the walls didn't need to be pretty, just strong. Abel sat there smiling at his friends. "To [[Abel May Jr.|Abel]]—our brick wall," someone shouted. "To Abel!" the room echoed, loud enough to rattle the old HVAC unit. [[Abel May Jr.|Abel]] just nodded, sipping from a battered glass, eyes heavy-lidded but tracking everything. He gave a small nod, then stood. "Appreciate it, Crew. Gonna get some air." He rose slowly and stepped outside.
The alley behind the clubhouse was all cracked pavement and rusted fences. A barrel fire crackled low, spitting sparks at the stars. [[Abel May Jr.|Abel]] lit a cigarette and leaned against the wall, shoulders relaxing slightly. Then came the shift. A presence. A flicker of motion in the dark. His hand dropped to his belt. "Oh my man, you picked the wrong fuckin’ night," he said. [[Flint Garritt|Flint]] emerged from shadow, hands clasped behind his back like a schoolmaster. He smiled like a man offering poison in a chalice. "If it was a fight I wanted, I’d have brought cameras." [[Abel May Jr.|Abel]] didn’t move but sighed lightly. Smoke curled from his lip. "Say your piece, suit." [[Flint Garritt|Flint]] stepped closer, unfazed. "You didn’t steal the spotlight tonight, Abel. You became it. Whether you meant to or not, you just became a household name across Tribucia." He pulled a folded document from his coat and handed it out. "Standard contract. WLL. Full run. Main card. Your name in lights, your fists on syndication. The crowd chants your name, and the payout? Real enough to retire every Crew vet you’ve ever called brother...if you win." [[Abel May Jr.|Abel]] took it. Didn’t open it. "I ain't one to fight for show." [[Flint Garritt|Flint]] raised an eyebrow. "Then don’t. Fight for respect. Fight for your crew. Hell, fight just to shut [[Bobby Cutman|Cutman]] the fuck up. You’ve already got the people. All you need now… is the walk. And you and I both know you have it." [[Abel May Jr.|Abel]] watched [[Flint Garritt|Flint]] moving like a snake. "It's legit, Mr May. No tricks. I saw a star today. I saw a lot of untapped potential in you." He gave a small nod, turning back to shadow. "You’ve got until the [[Bobby Cutman|Cutman]] vs. [[Bastian Redd|Redd]] fight. Come as my personal guest. Ringside seat. Name stitched into the leather." And with that, [[Flint Garritt|Flint]] vanished into the dark, leaving only the smoke and the sound of a slow-burning city. [[Abel May Jr.|Abel]] stood silent, watching the ember tip of his cigarette glow in the dark. The contract flapped lightly in the breeze. He didn’t look at it. Not yet.
# THE AFTERBURN **Earlier that day.** From the rooftops above the chaos, the chants of “STEELTOWN! STEELTOWN!” echoed like distant thunder. Flares hissed in the air. The world below burned with human heat—rage, pride, and spectacle. Two figures stood apart from it all. [[Hella]] leaned against a rusted girder, arms crossed, the glare of a magnesium flare briefly painting her pale features in white light. "Men and their stupid firecracker egos," she muttered, voice flat, unimpressed. “This is what they cheer for? This is what they live for?” [[Ora Razchek]] stood beside her, silent and still. He didn’t watch the match—he watched the men. His eyes tracked [[Abel May Jr.|Abel]] and [[Bobby Cutman|Cutman]] like a scientist noting lab rats under stress. “It keeps them distracted,” Ora replied. His voice was quiet, dangerous. “Pre-occupied, you know? Until the real work begins.” A beat passed. Just long enough for the wind to shift. [[Hella]] spat into the dust. “Which one do you want?” [[Ora Razchek]] didn’t answer with words. He smiled—tight-lipped and cold. He nodded toward the man still standing, still unmoved, even as the ring was consumed by screaming fans and frantic security. "The big one." Below, [[Abel May Jr.|Abel]] stared down [[Bobby Cutman|Cutman]] like a statue in a storm. And far above them, two shadows watched as the first thread was pulled. A flare exploded overhead. The sky blinked red. The shadows deepened.
